  IF NOT FOUND THEN PERFORM vw_err('No encontré esa camioneta.'); END IF;
  res := jsonb_build_object('device_id', un.device_id, 'nombre', coalesce(nullif(un.alias, ''), un.nombre), 'chofer', un.chofer, 'fecha', p_fecha,
    'encierro', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('lat', e.lat, 'lng', e.lng) FROM vw_rep_encierro(p_dev, p_fecha) e WHERE e.lat IS NOT NULL),
    'puntos', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(round(p.lat::numeric, 6), round(p.lng::numeric, 6), to_char(p.fix AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI:SS'), p.vel, p.encendido) ORDER BY p.fix)
        FROM (SELECT * FROM vw_gps_pos p0 WHERE p0.device_id = p_dev AND p0.fix >= (p_fecha::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') AND p0.fix < ((p_fecha + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')
               ORDER BY p0.fix LIMIT 20000) p), '[]'::jsonb),
    'km', (SELECT round(max(p.km_total) - min(p.km_total), 1) FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = p_dev AND p.km_total > 0
              AND p.fix >= (p_fecha::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') AND p.fix < ((p_fecha + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')),
    'evidencias', CASE WHEN to_regclass('public.entregas_evidencia') IS NULL THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('folio', ev.folio, 'cliente', ev.cliente,
        'tipo', ev.tipo, 'motivo', ev.motivo, 'chofer', ev.chofer, 'lat', ev.lat, 'lng', ev.lng, 'precision', ev.precision_m,
        'hora', to_char(ev.creado AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI:SS')) ORDER BY ev.creado)
      FROM entregas_evidencia ev WHERE ev.fecha = p_fecha
        AND (coalesce(un.chofer, '') = '' OR vw_norm(coalesce(ev.chofer, '')) LIKE '%' || vw_norm(split_part(un.chofer, ' ', 1)) || '%')), '[]'::jsonb) END);
  RETURN res;
END $fn$;

-- ===================== V8.04 · Más rápida =====================
-- Índices en la copia de Microsip (la crea el programa de la PC; si una tabla todavía no existe, se salta).
-- Sin estos, el tablero del dueño, las promociones y los saldos revisaban miles de renglones por cada venta.
DO $do$
DECLARE x TEXT;
BEGIN
  FOREACH x IN ARRAY ARRAY[
    'ms_ventas_det|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_ventas_det_doc ON ms_ventas_det (base, origen, docto_id)',
    'ms_ventas_det|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_ventas_det_art ON ms_ventas_det (base, articulo_id)',
    'ms_ventas|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_ventas_fecha ON ms_ventas (base, fecha)',
    'ms_ventas|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_ventas_cli ON ms_ventas (base, cliente_id)',
    'ms_articulos|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_articulos_id ON ms_articulos (articulo_id)',
    'ms_existencias|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_existencias_art ON ms_existencias (articulo_id)',
    'ms_raw|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_raw_tabla_sync ON ms_raw (base, tabla, sync_id)',
    'ms_raw|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_raw_tabla_fecha ON ms_raw (base, tabla, fecha)',
    'ms_raw|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_raw_pv_cobro ON ms_raw ((datos ->> ''DOCTO_PV_ID'')) WHERE tabla = ''DOCTOS_PV_COBROS''',
    'ms_raw|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_raw_vol_art ON ms_raw ((datos ->> ''ARTICULO_ID'')) WHERE tabla = ''DSCTOS_VOL_ARTS''',
    'ms_raw|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_raw_ligas_fte ON ms_raw ((datos ->> ''DOCTO_VE_FTE_ID'')) WHERE tabla = ''DOCTOS_VE_LIGAS''',
    'ms_raw|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_raw_ligas_dest ON ms_raw ((datos ->> ''DOCTO_VE_DEST_ID'')) WHERE tabla = ''DOCTOS_VE_LIGAS''',
    'ms_raw|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ms_raw_cargos_cli ON ms_raw ((datos ->> ''CLIENTE_ID'')) WHERE tabla = ''CARGOS_CC''',
    'vw_documentos|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_documentos_tipo_creado ON vw_documentos (base, tipo, creado)',
    'vw_documentos|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_documentos_ms ON vw_documentos (docto_id_ms)',
    'vw_documentos|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_documentos_ligado ON vw_documentos (ligado_a)',
    'vw_doc_det|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_doc_det_doc ON vw_doc_det (doc_id)']
  LOOP
    IF to_regclass('public.' || split_part(x, '|', 1)) IS NOT NULL THEN
      BEGIN EXECUTE split_part(x, '|', 2); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE NOTICE 'índice no creado: %', SQLERRM; END;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END $do$;

-- V8.04: velocidad. Valores que no cambian dentro de una misma llamada se guardan mientras dura (antes se buscaban por cada artículo)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_cache_get(k TEXT) RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$ SELECT current_setting('vw.c_' || k, true) $fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_cache_set(k TEXT, v TEXT) RETURNS VOID LANGUAGE sql AS $fn$ SELECT set_config('vw.c_' || k, coalesce(v, ''), true) $fn$;
-- la copia más reciente de una tabla de Microsip (sync_id), una vez por llamada
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_raw_sid(p_base TEXT, p_tabla TEXT) RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE k TEXT := 'sid_' || regexp_replace(lower(p_base || '_' || p_tabla), '[^a-z0-9_]', '_', 'g'); v TEXT;
BEGIN
  v := vw_cache_get(k);
  IF v IS NOT NULL AND v <> '' THEN RETURN nullif(v, '-'); END IF;
  SELECT sync_id INTO v FROM ms_raw WHERE base = p_base AND tabla = p_tabla ORDER BY actualizado DESC LIMIT 1;
  PERFORM vw_cache_set(k, coalesce(v, '-'));
  RETURN v;
END $fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_tipo_fijo(p_base TEXT, p_tipo TEXT) RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_raw r
                  WHERE r.base = p_base AND r.tabla = 'LISTA_POR_TIPO'
                    AND r.sync_id = vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'LISTA_POR_TIPO')
                    AND upper(trim(r.datos ->> 'TIPO')) = upper(trim(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_tipo, ''), '[|][TM][0-9]*$', '')))
                    AND left(r.datos ->> 'TIPO', 1) <> '@')
$fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_dscto_vol(p_base TEXT, p_art BIGINT, p_tipo_cli TEXT, p_cant NUMERIC,
  OUT lista_id BIGINT, OUT lista_nombre TEXT, OUT precio_base NUMERIC, OUT pct NUMERIC, OUT unidades NUMERIC, OUT recargo NUMERIC)
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE hoy DATE := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date; sid_pol TEXT; sid_vol TEXT; sid_lt TEXT;
  v_tar BOOLEAN := coalesce(p_tipo_cli, '') LIKE '%|T';
  v_clave TEXT := CASE WHEN coalesce(p_tipo_cli, '') LIKE '%|T' THEN '@TARJETA' ELSE upper(trim(coalesce(p_tipo_cli, ''))) END;
  v_tipo TEXT := upper(trim(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_tipo_cli, ''), '[|]T$', ''))); v_fija BOOLEAN := false;
BEGIN
  sid_lt := vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'LISTA_POR_TIPO');
  IF sid_lt IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT nullif(datos ->> 'LISTA_ID', '')::numeric::bigint, datos ->> 'LISTA' INTO lista_id, lista_nombre
      FROM ms_raw WHERE base = p_base AND tabla = 'LISTA_POR_TIPO' AND sync_id = sid_lt AND upper(trim(datos ->> 'TIPO')) = v_clave LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  IF lista_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT nullif(datos ->> 'PRECIO', '')::numeric INTO precio_base FROM ms_raw
     WHERE base = p_base AND tabla = 'PRECIOS_LISTA_TIPO' AND pk = p_art::text || ':' || lista_id::text;
  END IF;
  IF lista_id IS NULL OR (v_tar AND precio_base IS NULL) THEN
    -- sin lista propia: se usa la general; con tarjeta y sin lista TARJETA de Microsip, se le suma el recargo (3 % por omisión)
    precio_base := NULL; lista_id := NULL; lista_nombre := NULL;
    lista_id := nullif(vw_cache_get('pe_lista'), '')::bigint; lista_nombre := vw_cache_get('pe_nombre');
    IF lista_id IS NULL THEN
      SELECT nullif(datos ->> 'PRECIO_EMPRESA_ID', '')::numeric::bigint, datos ->> 'NOMBRE' INTO lista_id, lista_nombre FROM ms_raw
       WHERE base = p_base AND tabla = 'PRECIOS_EMPRESA' AND upper(trim(datos ->> 'NOMBRE')) = 'PRECIO DE LISTA' LIMIT 1;
      PERFORM vw_cache_set('pe_lista', coalesce(lista_id::text, '')); PERFORM vw_cache_set('pe_nombre', coalesce(lista_nombre, ''));
      lista_nombre := nullif(lista_nombre, '');
    ELSE lista_nombre := nullif(lista_nombre, '');
    END IF;
    IF v_tar THEN recargo := coalesce(nullif(vw_cfg('recargo_tarjeta'), '')::numeric, 3); END IF;
  END IF;
  -- los clientes con lista propia (MATERIALISTAS) tienen precio fijo: no llevan descuento por volumen
  IF sid_lt IS NOT NULL AND v_tipo <> '' THEN
    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_raw WHERE base = p_base AND tabla = 'LISTA_POR_TIPO' AND sync_id = sid_lt AND upper(trim(datos ->> 'TIPO')) = v_tipo) INTO v_fija;
  END IF;
  IF v_fija THEN RETURN; END IF;
  sid_pol := vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'POLITICAS_DSCTOS_VOLUMEN');
  sid_vol := vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'DSCTOS_VOL_ARTS');
  IF sid_pol IS NULL OR sid_vol IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  SELECT nullif(d.datos ->> 'UNIDADES', '')::numeric, nullif(d.datos ->> 'DESCUENTO', '')::numeric INTO unidades, pct
    FROM ms_raw d
    JOIN ms_raw pol ON pol.base = d.base AND pol.tabla = 'POLITICAS_DSCTOS_VOLUMEN' AND pol.sync_id = sid_pol
                   AND nullif(pol.datos ->> 'POLITICA_DSCTO_VOLUMEN_ID', '')::numeric = nullif(d.datos ->> 'POLITICA_DSCTO_VOLUMEN_ID', '')::numeric
   WHERE d.base = p_base AND d.tabla = 'DSCTOS_VOL_ARTS' AND d.sync_id = sid_vol
     AND (d.datos ->> 'ARTICULO_ID') IN (p_art::text, p_art::text || '.0')
     AND upper(coalesce(pol.datos ->> 'HABILITADA', 'N')) = 'S'
     AND (upper(coalesce(pol.datos ->> 'ES_PERMANENTE', 'S')) = 'S'
          OR ((nullif(pol.datos ->> 'FECHA_INI_VIGENCIA', '') IS NULL OR left(pol.datos ->> 'FECHA_INI_VIGENCIA', 10)::date <= hoy)
          AND (nullif(pol.datos ->> 'FECHA_FIN_VIGENCIA', '') IS NULL OR left(pol.datos ->> 'FECHA_FIN_VIGENCIA', 10)::date >= hoy)))
     AND (nullif(d.datos ->> 'PRECIO_EMPRESA_ID', '') IS NULL OR (lista_id IS NOT NULL AND (d.datos ->> 'PRECIO_EMPRESA_ID')::numeric = lista_id))
     AND (d.datos ->> 'UNIDADES')::numeric <= coalesce(p_cant, 0)
   ORDER BY (d.datos ->> 'UNIDADES')::numeric DESC, (d.datos ->> 'DESCUENTO')::numeric DESC LIMIT 1;
END $fn$;
-- V8.04: buscador más rápido. Primero se juntan los candidatos con índices de trigramas (pg_trgm) y solo a esos se les da puntaje.
-- El índice de búsqueda ya no se rearma completo: solo los artículos que cambiaron (huella md5 del texto).
ALTER TABLE vw_busca_idx ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS src_md5 TEXT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vw_busca_pal (base TEXT NOT NULL, palabra TEXT NOT NULL, articulo_id BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (base, palabra, articulo_id));
DO $do$ BEGIN
  IF to_regprocedure('similarity(text,text)') IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE 'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_busca_idx_txt_trgm ON vw_busca_idx USING gin (txt gin_trgm_ops)';
    EXECUTE 'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_busca_idx_fon_trgm ON vw_busca_idx USING gin (fon gin_trgm_ops)';
    EXECUTE 'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_busca_pal_trgm ON vw_busca_pal USING gin (palabra gin_trgm_ops)';
  END IF;
END $do$;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_busca_idx_clave ON vw_busca_idx (base, clave_n);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_busca_refrescar(p_base TEXT) RETURNS VOID LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE ult TIMESTAMPTZ; v_ids BIGINT[];
BEGIN
  SELECT valor::timestamptz INTO ult FROM vw_config WHERE clave = 'busca_idx_' || p_base;
  IF ult IS NOT NULL AND ult > now() - interval '10 minutes' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_busca_idx WHERE base = p_base) THEN RETURN; END IF;
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('vw_busca_idx')) THEN RETURN; END IF;
  -- solo lo que cambió o es nuevo
  WITH s AS (SELECT a.articulo_id, a.clave, concat_ws(' ', a.clave, a.nombre, a.linea) AS src FROM ms_articulos a WHERE a.base = p_base),
       c AS (SELECT s.* FROM s LEFT JOIN vw_busca_idx i ON i.base = p_base AND i.articulo_id = s.articulo_id
              WHERE i.articulo_id IS NULL OR i.src_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM md5(s.src) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_busca_pal w WHERE w.base = p_base AND w.articulo_id = s.articulo_id)),
       ins AS (INSERT INTO vw_busca_idx (base, articulo_id, clave_n, txt, fon, palabras, src_md5)
               SELECT p_base, c.articulo_id, vw_norm(c.clave), vw_norm(c.src), vw_fon(c.src), string_to_array(vw_norm(c.src), ' '), md5(c.src) FROM c
               ON CONFLICT (base, articulo_id) DO UPDATE SET clave_n = EXCLUDED.clave_n, txt = EXCLUDED.txt, fon = EXCLUDED.fon, palabras = EXCLUDED.palabras, src_md5 = EXCLUDED.src_md5
               RETURNING articulo_id)
  SELECT array_agg(articulo_id) INTO v_ids FROM ins;
  IF v_ids IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM vw_busca_pal WHERE base = p_base AND articulo_id = ANY (v_ids);
    INSERT INTO vw_busca_pal (base, palabra, articulo_id)
      SELECT DISTINCT p_base, w, i.articulo_id FROM vw_busca_idx i, unnest(i.palabras) w WHERE i.base = p_base AND i.articulo_id = ANY (v_ids) AND length(w) >= 3
      ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  -- artículos que ya no están en Microsip
  DELETE FROM vw_busca_idx i WHERE i.base = p_base AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_articulos a WHERE a.base = p_base AND a.articulo_id = i.articulo_id);
  DELETE FROM vw_busca_pal w WHERE w.base = p_base AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_busca_idx i WHERE i.base = p_base AND i.articulo_id = w.articulo_id);
  INSERT INTO vw_config (clave, valor) VALUES ('busca_idx_' || p_base, now()::text) ON CONFLICT (clave) DO UPDATE SET valor = EXCLUDED.valor;
END $fn$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_buscar_art(p_base TEXT, p_q TEXT, p_lim INT DEFAULT 25) RETURNS TABLE (articulo_id BIGINT, puntos NUMERIC) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE toks TEXT[]; n INT; need INT; v_trgm BOOLEAN := to_regprocedure('similarity(text,text)') IS NOT NULL; sq TEXT; sq2 TEXT; v_largo BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  PERFORM vw_busca_refrescar(p_base);
  SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT t) INTO toks FROM unnest(string_to_array(vw_norm(p_q), ' ')) t WHERE t <> '';
  n := coalesce(array_length(toks, 1), 0);
  IF n = 0 THEN RETURN; END IF;
  v_largo := EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(toks) t WHERE length(t) >= 3);
  IF v_trgm THEN PERFORM set_config('pg_trgm.similarity_threshold', '0.45', true); END IF;
  sq := $q$
    WITH t AS (SELECT tok FROM unnest($1::text[]) tok),
    alt0 AS (SELECT tok, tok AS a, 0 AS sn FROM t
            UNION SELECT t.tok, s.equivale, 1 FROM t JOIN vw_sinonimos s ON s.palabra = t.tok OR vw_fon(s.palabra) = vw_fon(t.tok)
            UNION SELECT tok, regexp_replace(tok, '(es|s)$', ''), 0 FROM t WHERE length(tok) > 3),
    alt AS (SELECT tok, a, sn, '(^| )' || a AS pat, vw_fon(a) AS fa, length(a) AS la FROM alt0),
    al AS (SELECT x.token, x.articulo_id FROM vw_busca_alias x JOIN t ON t.tok = x.token),
    -- candidatos por índice: contiene la palabra (o cómo suena), la clave exacta o lo aprendido
    ca AS (SELECT alt.* FROM alt WHERE alt.la >= 3 OR NOT $5),
    cand AS (SELECT i.articulo_id FROM ca JOIN vw_busca_idx i ON i.base = $2 AND i.txt LIKE '%' || ca.a || '%'
             UNION SELECT i.articulo_id FROM ca JOIN vw_busca_idx i ON i.base = $2 AND ca.la >= 4 AND i.fon LIKE '%' || ca.fa || '%'
             UNION SELECT i.articulo_id FROM alt JOIN vw_busca_idx i ON i.base = $2 AND i.clave_n = alt.a
             UNION SELECT al.articulo_id FROM al
             {FUZZY_CAND}),
    m AS (SELECT i.articulo_id AS aid, alt.tok, max(CASE
              WHEN i.clave_n = alt.a THEN 10
              WHEN (alt.tok, i.articulo_id) IN (SELECT token, articulo_id FROM al) THEN 3
              WHEN i.txt ~ alt.pat THEN 4 - alt.sn
              WHEN position(alt.a IN i.txt) > 0 THEN 2.5 - alt.sn * 0.5
              WHEN alt.la >= 4 AND position(alt.fa IN i.fon) > 0 THEN 2
              {FUZZY_SC}
              ELSE 0 END) AS sc
            FROM cand JOIN vw_busca_idx i ON i.base = $2 AND i.articulo_id = cand.articulo_id CROSS JOIN alt GROUP BY i.articulo_id, alt.tok)
    SELECT aid, sum(sc)::numeric FROM m GROUP BY aid HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE sc > 0) >= $3
    ORDER BY 2 DESC, aid LIMIT $4 $q$;
  sq2 := replace(replace(sq, '{FUZZY_CAND}', 'UNION SELECT w.articulo_id FROM ca JOIN vw_busca_pal w ON w.base = $2 AND ca.la >= 4 AND w.palabra % ca.a'),
                 '{FUZZY_SC}', 'WHEN alt.la >= 4 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(i.palabras) w WHERE similarity(w, alt.a) >= 0.45) THEN 1.5');
  sq := replace(replace(sq, '{FUZZY_CAND}', ''), '{FUZZY_SC}', '');
  -- primero lo rápido; la comparación por letras parecidas solo si no salió nada
  FOREACH need IN ARRAY ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT x FROM unnest(ARRAY[n, greatest(n - 1, 1), greatest((n + 1) / 2, 1)]) x ORDER BY x DESC) LOOP
    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE sq USING toks, p_base, need, p_lim, v_largo;
    IF FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
    IF v_trgm THEN
      RETURN QUERY EXECUTE sq2 USING toks, p_base, need, p_lim, v_largo;
      IF FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END $fn$;

-- V8.04: el índice de búsqueda se arma completo una vez al instalar (las siguientes veces solo lo que cambió) y se actualizan estadísticas
DO $do$ BEGIN
  UPDATE vw_config SET valor = '2000-01-01' WHERE clave LIKE 'busca_idx_%';
  IF to_regclass('public.ms_articulos') IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(vw_cfg('base'), '') <> '' THEN PERFORM vw_busca_refrescar(vw_cfg('base')); END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.ms_ventas_det') IS NOT NULL THEN ANALYZE ms_ventas_det; END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.ms_ventas') IS NOT NULL THEN ANALYZE ms_ventas; END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.ms_raw') IS NOT NULL THEN ANALYZE ms_raw; END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.ms_articulos') IS NOT NULL THEN ANALYZE ms_articulos; END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE NOTICE 'busca/analyze: %', SQLERRM;
END $do$;

-- ===================== V8.05 · Catálogo en cada equipo (solo baja lo que cambió) =====================
-- vw_cat es la foto del catálogo con precio de público: n8n la actualiza cada 5 min y a cada artículo que cambia le pone un número de versión.
-- La página guarda el catálogo y solo pide «lo que cambió después de la versión N»: buscar y meter una clave con Enter es al instante.
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS vw_cat_ver;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vw_cat (base TEXT NOT NULL, articulo_id BIGINT NOT NULL, clave TEXT, nombre TEXT, unidad TEXT, precio NUMERIC,
  activo BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true, huella TEXT, ver BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (base, articulo_id));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS vw_cat_ver_i ON vw_cat (base, ver);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_cat_refrescar(p_base TEXT, p_forzar BOOLEAN DEFAULT false) RETURNS INT LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE v_llave TEXT; v_todo BOOLEAN; n INT := 0; m INT := 0;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(p_base, '') = '' OR to_regclass('public.ms_articulos') IS NULL THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('vw_cat')) THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
  -- si cambian las listas de precios, los descuentos por volumen, los precios especiales o el día, se recalculan todos los precios
  v_llave := md5(concat_ws('|', vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'LISTA_POR_TIPO'), vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'PRECIOS_EMPRESA'), vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'POLITICAS_DSCTOS_VOLUMEN'),
               vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'DSCTOS_VOL_ARTS'), vw_raw_sid(p_base, 'PRECIOS_LISTA_TIPO'),
               (SELECT md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(g)::text, ',' ORDER BY to_jsonb(g)::text), '')) FROM vw_reglas_precio g),
               (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date::text));
  v_todo := p_forzar OR coalesce(vw_cfg('cat_llave_' || p_base), '') <> v_llave;
  WITH s AS (SELECT a.articulo_id, a.clave, a.nombre, a.unidad, coalesce(upper(a.estatus), 'A') NOT IN ('B', 'S', 'I') AS act,
                    md5(concat_ws('|', a.clave, a.nombre, a.unidad, a.estatus, a.precio_lista, a.linea, a.grupo)) AS h
               FROM ms_articulos a WHERE a.base = p_base),
       ch AS (SELECT s.* FROM s LEFT JOIN vw_cat c ON c.base = p_base AND c.articulo_id = s.articulo_id
               WHERE v_todo OR c.articulo_id IS NULL OR c.huella IS DISTINCT FROM s.h OR c.activo IS DISTINCT FROM s.act),
       up AS (INSERT INTO vw_cat (base, articulo_id, clave, nombre, unidad, precio, activo, huella, ver)
              SELECT p_base, ch.articulo_id, ch.clave, ch.nombre, ch.unidad,
                     CASE WHEN ch.act THEN round(vw_con_iva((vw_precio_regla(p_base, ch.articulo_id, NULL::bigint, NULL::int, NULL, 1)).precio), 2) END, ch.act, ch.h, nextval('vw_cat_ver')
                FROM ch
              ON CONFLICT (base, articulo_id) DO UPDATE SET clave = EXCLUDED.clave, nombre = EXCLUDED.nombre, unidad = EXCLUDED.unidad, precio = EXCLUDED.precio,
                     activo = EXCLUDED.activo, huella = EXCLUDED.huella,
                     ver = CASE WHEN (vw_cat.clave, vw_cat.nombre, vw_cat.unidad, vw_cat.precio, vw_cat.activo) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.clave, EXCLUDED.nombre, EXCLUDED.unidad, EXCLUDED.precio, EXCLUDED.activo)
                                THEN EXCLUDED.ver ELSE vw_cat.ver END
              RETURNING 1)
  SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM up;
  -- los que ya no están en Microsip
  UPDATE vw_cat c SET activo = false, ver = nextval('vw_cat_ver')
   WHERE c.base = p_base AND c.activo AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_articulos a WHERE a.base = p_base AND a.articulo_id = c.articulo_id);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS m = ROW_COUNT;
  INSERT INTO vw_config (clave, valor) VALUES ('cat_llave_' || p_base, v_llave) ON CONFLICT (clave) DO UPDATE SET valor = EXCLUDED.valor;
  INSERT INTO vw_config (clave, valor) VALUES ('cat_hora_' || p_base, now()::text) ON CONFLICT (clave) DO UPDATE SET valor = EXCLUDED.valor;
  RETURN n + m;
END $fn$;

-- lo que corre n8n cada 5 minutos: catálogo e índice de búsqueda al día, para que nadie espere a que se rearmen
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_mantenimiento_cat() RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE v_base TEXT := vw_cfg('base'); n INT;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(v_base, '') = '' THEN RETURN '{}'::jsonb; END IF;
  n := vw_cat_refrescar(v_base);
  PERFORM vw_busca_refrescar(v_base);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('cambios', n);
END $fn$;

DO $do$ BEGIN PERFORM vw_cat_refrescar(vw_cfg('base'), true); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE NOTICE 'catálogo: %', SQLERRM; END $do$;

-- folio normalizado como en el planeador (P000123 = P123)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_gps_llave(f TEXT) RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(f, ''), '[^A-Za-z]', '', 'g')) || coalesce(nullif(ltrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(f, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '0'), ''), '0')
$fn$;

-- coordenadas de un pedido: las del plan, las geocodificadas o las de la liga de Google Maps que pegaron
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_gps_coord(p_folio TEXT, p_coord JSONB) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
DECLARE r JSONB; u TEXT; m TEXT[];
BEGIN
  IF jsonb_typeof(p_coord) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p_coord) = 2 AND (p_coord ->> 0) ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$' THEN
    r := jsonb_build_object('lat', (p_coord ->> 0)::float8, 'lng', (p_coord ->> 1)::float8, 'nivel', 'plan');
  END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.ubicaciones_geo') IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('lat', g.lat, 'lng', g.lng, 'nivel', coalesce(g.nivel, 'exacta')) INTO r FROM ubicaciones_geo g
     WHERE g.lat IS NOT NULL AND upper(regexp_replace(g.clave, '\s', '', 'g')) = upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_folio, ''), '\s', '', 'g')) LIMIT 1;
    IF r IS NOT NULL AND r ->> 'nivel' NOT IN ('colonia', 'cp') THEN RETURN r; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.ubicaciones_folio') IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT f.url INTO u FROM ubicaciones_folio f WHERE upper(regexp_replace(f.folio, '\s', '', 'g')) = upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_folio, ''), '\s', '', 'g')) LIMIT 1;
    m := regexp_match(coalesce(u, ''), '(-?[0-9]{1,2}\.[0-9]{3,})\s*,\s*(-?[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{3,})');
    IF m IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('lat', m[1]::float8, 'lng', m[2]::float8, 'nivel', 'liga'); END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN r;
END $fn$;

-- la ruta confirmada de un chofer en una fecha: paradas en orden, hora planeada, coordenadas y si ya se entregó
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_gps_plan(p_fecha DATE, p_chofer TEXT) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
DECLARE det JSONB; res JSONB; k TEXT := upper(split_part(trim(coalesce(p_chofer, '')), ' ', 1));
BEGIN
  IF k = '' OR to_regclass('public.rutas_confirmadas') IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT rc.detalle INTO det FROM rutas_confirmadas rc WHERE rc.ok AND rc.fecha = p_fecha AND (rc.detalle -> 'viajes') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rc.id DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF det IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('viajes', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('vuelta', coalesce(vi.value ->> 'vuelta', '1'), 'salida', vi.value ->> 'salida', 'regreso', vi.value ->> 'regreso',
           'km', vi.value ->> 'km', 'costo', vi.value ->> 'costo',
           'paradas', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('n', pp.ordinality, 'folio', coalesce(nullif(pp.value ->> 'folio', ''), pp.value ->> 'folio_venta'), 'cliente', pp.value ->> 'cliente',
                          'zona', pp.value ->> 'zona', 'hora', pp.value ->> 'hora', 'piezas', pp.value ->> 'piezas', 'prods', pp.value -> 'prods',
                          'coord', vw_gps_coord(coalesce(nullif(pp.value ->> 'folio', ''), pp.value ->> 'folio_venta'), pp.value -> 'coord'),
                          'resultado', (SELECT er.resultado FROM entregas_resultado er WHERE to_regclass('public.entregas_resultado') IS NOT NULL AND er.fecha = p_fecha
                                          AND vw_gps_llave(er.folio) = vw_gps_llave(coalesce(nullif(pp.value ->> 'folio', ''), pp.value ->> 'folio_venta')) LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY pp.ordinality), '[]'::jsonb)
                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(vi.value -> 'paradas', '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY pp
                      WHERE NOT coalesce((pp.value ->> 'pickup')::boolean, false) AND NOT coalesce((pp.value ->> 'parte_tin')::boolean, false))) ORDER BY vi.ordinality), '[]'::jsonb))
    INTO res
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(det -> 'viajes') WITH ORDINALITY vi
   WHERE upper(coalesce(vi.value ->> 'chofer', '')) LIKE k || '%' OR k LIKE upper(coalesce(vi.value ->> 'chofer', '')) || '%';
  IF jsonb_array_length(res -> 'viajes') = 0 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  RETURN res;
EXCEPTION WHEN undefined_table OR undefined_column THEN RETURN NULL;
END $fn$;

-- ¿dónde va el pedido? (ruta confirmada de hoy): chofer, camioneta, entregas que le faltan antes y distancia
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_gps_folio(p_folio TEXT) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
DECLARE hoy DATE := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date; det JSONB; vi JSONB; pp JSONB; v_ch TEXT; i INT; v_pos INT; v_falta INT := 0; un RECORD; lp RECORD; v_c JSONB;
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.rutas_confirmadas') IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('encontrado', false); END IF;
  SELECT rc.detalle INTO det FROM rutas_confirmadas rc WHERE rc.ok AND rc.fecha = hoy AND (rc.detalle -> 'viajes') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rc.id DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF det IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('encontrado', false, 'msg', 'Hoy no hay ruta confirmada.'); END IF;
  FOR vi IN SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(det -> 'viajes') x LOOP
    i := 0; v_pos := NULL; v_falta := 0;
    FOR pp IN SELECT y FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(vi -> 'paradas', '[]'::jsonb)) y
              WHERE NOT coalesce((y ->> 'pickup')::boolean, false) AND NOT coalesce((y ->> 'parte_tin')::boolean, false) LOOP
      i := i + 1;
      IF vw_gps_llave(coalesce(nullif(pp ->> 'folio', ''), pp ->> 'folio_venta')) = vw_gps_llave(p_folio) OR vw_gps_llave(pp ->> 'folio_venta') = vw_gps_llave(p_folio) THEN
        v_pos := i; v_c := vw_gps_coord(coalesce(nullif(pp ->> 'folio', ''), pp ->> 'folio_venta'), pp -> 'coord'); EXIT;
      END IF;
      -- las de antes que todavía no tienen resultado: le faltan
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entregas_resultado er WHERE er.fecha = hoy AND vw_gps_llave(er.folio) = vw_gps_llave(coalesce(nullif(pp ->> 'folio', ''), pp ->> 'folio_venta'))) THEN v_falta := v_falta + 1; END IF;
    END LOOP;
    IF v_pos IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_ch := vi ->> 'chofer';
      SELECT * INTO un FROM vw_gps_unidades u WHERE u.activo AND coalesce(u.chofer, '') <> '' AND (upper(v_ch) LIKE upper(split_part(u.chofer, ' ', 1)) || '%' OR upper(split_part(u.chofer, ' ', 1)) LIKE upper(v_ch) || '%') LIMIT 1;
      IF FOUND THEN SELECT * INTO lp FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = un.device_id ORDER BY p.fix DESC LIMIT 1; END IF;
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('encontrado', true, 'folio', p_folio, 'chofer', v_ch, 'posicion', v_pos, 'antes', v_falta, 'hora_plan', pp ->> 'hora', 'cliente', pp ->> 'cliente', 'zona', pp ->> 'zona',
        'resultado', (SELECT er.resultado FROM entregas_resultado er WHERE er.fecha = hoy AND vw_gps_llave(er.folio) = vw_gps_llave(p_folio) LIMIT 1),
        'destino', v_c, 'device_id', un.device_id, 'camioneta', coalesce(nullif(un.alias, ''), un.nombre),
        'lat', lp.lat, 'lng', lp.lng, 'vel', lp.vel, 'fix', lp.fix, 'min', CASE WHEN lp.fix IS NOT NULL THEN floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - lp.fix) / 60) END);
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('encontrado', false, 'msg', 'Ese pedido no va en la ruta confirmada de hoy.');
EXCEPTION WHEN undefined_table THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('encontrado', false);
END $fn$;

-- Costos por camioneta / chofer en un periodo: km del GPS, gasolina (retiros de caja que dicen «gasolina <chofer>»), entregas
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_gps_costos(p_desde DATE, p_hasta DATE) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
DECLARE v_base TEXT := vw_cfg('base'); res JSONB; v_ret JSONB := '[]'::jsonb; v_ent JSONB := '[]'::jsonb; v_bco NUMERIC;
BEGIN
  -- retiros de caja con «gasolina»: a quién (la palabra después de gasolina)
  IF to_regclass('public.ms_ventas_v') IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('quien', q.quien, 'imp', q.imp, 'n', q.n)), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_ret FROM (
      SELECT upper(coalesce(nullif(trim(split_part(trim(substring(coalesce(v.descripcion, '') FROM '(?i)gasolin[a]?\s*(.*)$')), ' ', 1)), ''), 'SIN NOMBRE')) AS quien,
             round(sum(abs(coalesce(v.total, 0))), 2) AS imp, count(*) AS n
        FROM ms_ventas_v v WHERE v.base = v_base AND v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'R' AND NOT coalesce(v.cancelado, false)
         AND v.fecha BETWEEN p_desde AND p_hasta AND coalesce(v.descripcion, '') ~* 'gasolin' GROUP BY 1) q;
  END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.entregas_resultado') IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE 'SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''quien'', q.quien, ''entregadas'', q.e, ''no'', q.x, ''piezas'', q.pz)), ''[]''::jsonb) FROM (
               SELECT upper(split_part(trim(coalesce(chofer, '''')), '' '', 1)) AS quien, count(*) FILTER (WHERE resultado = ''entregado'') AS e,
                      count(*) FILTER (WHERE resultado <> ''entregado'') AS x, round(coalesce(sum(unidades) FILTER (WHERE resultado = ''entregado''), 0)) AS pz
                 FROM entregas_resultado WHERE fecha BETWEEN $1 AND $2 GROUP BY 1) q' INTO v_ent USING p_desde, p_hasta;
  END IF;
  v_bco := CASE WHEN to_regclass('public.vw_banco_movs') IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(m.cargo), 0), 2) FROM vw_banco_movs m
             WHERE m.fecha BETWEEN p_desde AND p_hasta AND m.cargo > 0 AND concat_ws(' ', m.concepto, m.contraparte, m.categoria) ~* 'gasolin') END;
  res := jsonb_build_object('desde', p_desde, 'hasta', p_hasta, 'retiros', v_ret, 'entregas', v_ent, 'banco_gasolina', v_bco,
    'unidades', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('device_id', u.device_id, 'nombre', coalesce(nullif(u.alias, ''), u.nombre), 'chofer', u.chofer,
        'km', (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(dk.km), 0), 1) FROM (SELECT max(p.km_total) - min(p.km_total) AS km FROM vw_gps_pos p
                 WHERE p.device_id = u.device_id AND p.km_total > 0 AND p.fix >= (p_desde::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') AND p.fix < ((p_hasta + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')
                 GROUP BY (p.fix AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date) dk WHERE dk.km < 600),
        'dias', (SELECT count(DISTINCT (p.fix AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date) FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = u.device_id AND p.vel >= 5
                   AND p.fix >= (p_desde::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') AND p.fix < ((p_hasta + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')),
        'desde_gps', (SELECT to_char(min(p.fix) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = u.device_id)) ORDER BY u.device_id)
      FROM vw_gps_unidades u WHERE u.activo), '[]'::jsonb));
  RETURN res;
END $fn$;

-- ---------- ayudas ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_hoy() RETURNS DATE LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$ SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date $fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_m(la1 DOUBLE PRECISION, lo1 DOUBLE PRECISION, la2 DOUBLE PRECISION, lo2 DOUBLE PRECISION) RETURNS DOUBLE PRECISION LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT 12742000 * asin(sqrt(least(1, power(sin(radians(la2 - la1) / 2), 2) + cos(radians(la1)) * cos(radians(la2)) * power(sin(radians(lo2 - lo1) / 2), 2))))
$fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_mismo(a TEXT, b TEXT) RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT split_part(vw_norm(trim(coalesce(a, ''))), ' ', 1) <> '' AND split_part(vw_norm(trim(coalesce(b, ''))), ' ', 1) <> ''
     AND (split_part(vw_norm(trim(a)), ' ', 1) LIKE split_part(vw_norm(trim(b)), ' ', 1) || '%' OR split_part(vw_norm(trim(b)), ' ', 1) LIKE split_part(vw_norm(trim(a)), ' ', 1) || '%')
$fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_h(t TEXT) RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $fn$ SELECT replace(replace(replace(coalesce(t, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>') $fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_num(k TEXT, d NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$ SELECT coalesce(nullif(vw_cfg(k), '')::numeric, d) $fn$;
-- la causa que se deduce del motivo que puso el chofer (solo lo claro; lo demás lo decide el supervisor)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_causa(m TEXT) RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(m, '') ~* 'contest|ausente|cancel|rechaz|no_estaba|no estaba|no hab|cliente' THEN 'cliente'
              WHEN coalesce(m, '') ~* 'mecan|seguridad|accidente|llanta|descompu|falla|robo' THEN 'operacion'
              WHEN coalesce(m, '') ~* 'planea|capacidad|no_cupo|no cupo|carga' THEN 'planeacion' END
$fn$;
-- camioneta de un chofer en una fecha (primero lo que se asignó ese día, si no la que tiene puesta)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_dev(p_fecha DATE, p_chofer TEXT) RETURNS INT LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT a.device_id FROM vw_rep_asig a WHERE a.fecha = p_fecha AND vw_rep_mismo(a.chofer, p_chofer) ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1),
                  (SELECT u.device_id FROM vw_gps_unidades u WHERE u.activo AND vw_rep_mismo(u.chofer, p_chofer) ORDER BY u.device_id LIMIT 1))
$fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_chofer_de(p_fecha DATE, p_dev INT) RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT a.chofer FROM vw_rep_asig a WHERE a.fecha = p_fecha AND a.device_id = p_dev ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT nullif(u.chofer, '') FROM vw_gps_unidades u WHERE u.device_id = p_dev))
$fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_hist_add(p_usuario TEXT, p_accion TEXT, p_ref TEXT, p_datos JSONB) RETURNS VOID LANGUAGE sql AS $fn$
  INSERT INTO vw_rep_hist (usuario, accion, ref, datos) VALUES (p_usuario, p_accion, p_ref, p_datos)
$fn$;
-- a quién le llegan los avisos de reparto por Telegram: dueños, quien tenga el permiso «reparto» y los chats extra de la configuración
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_chats() RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT c), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
    SELECT telegram_chat_id AS c FROM vw_usuarios WHERE activo AND coalesce(telegram_chat_id, '') <> ''
       AND (es_admin OR coalesce(((vw_permisos_default() || permisos) ->> 'reparto')::boolean, false))
    UNION SELECT trim(x) FROM unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(vw_cfg('telegram_chats'), ''), ',')) x WHERE trim(x) <> '') s
$fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_msg(p_txt TEXT) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('chat_id', c, 'text', left(p_txt, 3900), 'url', nullif(vw_cfg('url_web'), ''), 'boton', 'Abrir Reparto')), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(vw_rep_chats()) c
$fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_aviso_nuevo(p_clave TEXT) RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE n INT;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO vw_rep_avisos (clave) VALUES (p_clave) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN n > 0;
END $fn$;
-- crea una incidencia una sola vez (por clave); devuelve si es nueva
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_incid_crear(p_fecha DATE, p_tipo TEXT, p_folio TEXT, p_cliente TEXT, p_chofer TEXT, p_dev INT, p_origen TEXT, p_detalle TEXT, p_datos JSONB, p_causa TEXT, p_clave TEXT, p_lat DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT NULL, p_lng DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS BIGINT LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE v_id BIGINT;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO vw_rep_incid (fecha, tipo, folio, llave, cliente, chofer, device_id, origen, detalle, datos, causa, clave, lat, lng)
  VALUES (p_fecha, p_tipo, p_folio, CASE WHEN p_folio IS NOT NULL THEN vw_gps_llave(p_folio) END, p_cliente, p_chofer, p_dev, p_origen, p_detalle, p_datos, p_causa, p_clave, p_lat, p_lng)
  ON CONFLICT (clave) DO NOTHING RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  RETURN v_id;
END $fn$;

-- ---------- la ruta del día, parada por parada (la última ruta confirmada de esa fecha) ----------
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS vw_rep_estados(DATE);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS vw_rep_paradas(DATE);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_paradas(p_fecha DATE) RETURNS TABLE (chofer TEXT, vuelta TEXT, n INT, folio TEXT, llave TEXT, cliente TEXT, zona TEXT, hora TEXT, piezas TEXT, coord JSONB, prods JSONB, tel TEXT)
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE det JSONB;
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.rutas_confirmadas') IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  SELECT rc.detalle INTO det FROM rutas_confirmadas rc WHERE rc.ok AND rc.fecha = p_fecha AND (rc.detalle -> 'viajes') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rc.id DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF det IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT z.chofer, z.vuelta, (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY z.chofer ORDER BY z.vi_ord, z.pp_ord))::int, z.folio, vw_gps_llave(z.folio), z.cliente, z.zona, z.hora, z.piezas, vw_gps_coord(z.folio, z.coord), z.prods, z.tel
    FROM (SELECT upper(trim(coalesce(vi.value ->> 'chofer', ''))) AS chofer, coalesce(vi.value ->> 'vuelta', '1') AS vuelta, vi.ordinality AS vi_ord, pp.ordinality AS pp_ord,
                 coalesce(nullif(pp.value ->> 'folio', ''), pp.value ->> 'folio_venta') AS folio, pp.value ->> 'cliente' AS cliente, pp.value ->> 'zona' AS zona, pp.value ->> 'hora' AS hora,
                 pp.value ->> 'piezas' AS piezas, pp.value -> 'coord' AS coord, pp.value -> 'prods' AS prods, pp.value ->> 'tel' AS tel
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(det -> 'viajes') WITH ORDINALITY vi, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(vi.value -> 'paradas', '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY pp
           WHERE NOT coalesce((pp.value ->> 'pickup')::boolean, false) AND NOT coalesce((pp.value ->> 'parte_tin')::boolean, false)) z
   WHERE z.folio IS NOT NULL AND z.chofer <> '';
EXCEPTION WHEN undefined_table OR undefined_column THEN RETURN;
END $fn$;

-- cada parada con todo lo que se sabe: confirmación del cliente, lo que marcó el chofer, el resultado, la visita del GPS y el estado final
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_estados(p_fecha DATE) RETURNS TABLE (chofer TEXT, device_id INT, n INT, vuelta TEXT, folio TEXT, llave TEXT, cliente TEXT, zona TEXT, hora_plan TEXT, piezas TEXT, coord JSONB, prods JSONB, tel TEXT,
  confirma TEXT, confirma_ts TIMESTAMPTZ, ev_tipo TEXT, ev_motivo TEXT, ev_nota TEXT, ev_hora TIMESTAMPTZ, ev_foto BOOLEAN, ev_lat DOUBLE PRECISION, ev_lng DOUBLE PRECISION, ev_llego TIMESTAMPTZ,
  res TEXT, v_id BIGINT, v_llegada TIMESTAMPTZ, v_salida TIMESTAMPTZ, v_perm NUMERIC, v_en_sitio BOOLEAN, v_validacion TEXT, estado TEXT, causa TEXT, excluye BOOLEAN, inc_id BIGINT)
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
#variable_conflict use_column
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.entregas_evidencia') IS NULL OR to_regclass('public.entregas_resultado') IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT pa.chofer, vw_rep_dev(p_fecha, pa.chofer), pa.n, pa.vuelta, pa.folio, pa.llave, pa.cliente, pa.zona, pa.hora, pa.piezas, pa.coord, pa.prods, pa.tel,
         cf.estado, cf.ts, ev.tipo, ev.motivo, ev.nota, ev.creado, ev.tf, ev.lat, ev.lng, lg.llego, er.resultado,
         vi.id, vi.llegada, vi.salida, vi.perm_min, vi.en_sitio, vi.validacion,
         CASE WHEN ev.tipo = 'entregado' OR er.resultado = 'entregado' OR vi.validacion = 'entregada' THEN 'entregado'
              WHEN ev.tipo = 'no_entregado' OR er.resultado IN ('no_entregado', 'cancelado') OR vi.validacion = 'no_entregada' THEN 'no_entregado'
              WHEN er.resultado = 'reprogramado' THEN 'reprogramado'
              WHEN vi.id IS NOT NULL AND vi.validacion IS NULL AND vi.en_sitio THEN 'en_sitio'
              WHEN vi.id IS NOT NULL AND vi.validacion IS NULL THEN 'posible'
              ELSE 'pendiente' END,
         coalesce(ic.causa, vw_rep_causa(ev.motivo)), coalesce(ic.excluye, false), ic.id
    FROM vw_rep_paradas(p_fecha) pa
    LEFT JOIN vw_rep_confirm cf ON cf.fecha = p_fecha AND cf.llave = pa.llave
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.tipo, e.motivo, e.nota, e.creado, (pg_column_size(e.foto) > 4) AS tf, e.lat, e.lng FROM entregas_evidencia e
                        WHERE e.fecha = p_fecha AND e.tipo IN ('entregado', 'no_entregado') AND vw_gps_llave(e.folio) = pa.llave ORDER BY e.creado DESC LIMIT 1) ev ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(e.creado) AS llego FROM entregas_evidencia e WHERE e.fecha = p_fecha AND e.tipo = 'llegue' AND vw_gps_llave(e.folio) = pa.llave) lg ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.resultado FROM entregas_resultado r WHERE r.fecha = p_fecha AND vw_gps_llave(r.folio) = pa.llave ORDER BY r.creado DESC LIMIT 1) er ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.id, v.llegada, v.salida, v.perm_min, v.en_sitio, v.validacion FROM vw_rep_visitas v WHERE v.fecha = p_fecha AND v.llave = pa.llave ORDER BY v.llegada DESC LIMIT 1) vi ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT i.id, i.causa, i.excluye FROM vw_rep_incid i WHERE i.fecha = p_fecha AND i.llave = pa.llave AND i.causa IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 1) ic ON true
   ORDER BY pa.chofer, pa.n;
END $fn$;

-- ---------- Fase 1 · visitas detectadas por el GPS (geocerca, permanencia mínima y velocidad; solo en ubicaciones exactas) ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_detectar(p_fecha DATE) RETURNS INT LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE v_r DOUBLE PRECISION := vw_rep_num('rep_geocerca_m', 100); v_pm NUMERIC := vw_rep_num('rep_perm_min', 2); n INT := 0; v_b DOUBLE PRECISION;
  d0 TIMESTAMPTZ := p_fecha::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'; d1 TIMESTAMPTZ := (p_fecha + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City';
BEGIN
  v_b := v_r / 111000.0 * 1.5;
  WITH st AS (
    SELECT pa.chofer, vw_rep_dev(p_fecha, pa.chofer) AS device_id, pa.n AS orden, pa.folio, pa.llave, pa.cliente, pa.hora AS hora_plan, (pa.coord ->> 'lat')::float8 AS lat, (pa.coord ->> 'lng')::float8 AS lng, pa.coord ->> 'nivel' AS nivel
      FROM vw_rep_paradas(p_fecha) pa WHERE pa.coord IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(pa.coord ->> 'nivel', 'exacta') NOT IN ('colonia', 'cp')),
  fx AS (
    SELECT s.chofer, s.device_id, s.orden, s.folio, s.llave, s.cliente, s.hora_plan, s.lat, s.lng, s.nivel, p.fix, p.vel, vw_rep_m(s.lat, s.lng, p.lat, p.lng) AS dm
      FROM st s JOIN vw_gps_pos p ON p.device_id = s.device_id AND p.fix >= d0 AND p.fix < d1 AND p.lat BETWEEN s.lat - v_b AND s.lat + v_b AND p.lng BETWEEN s.lng - v_b AND s.lng + v_b
     WHERE s.device_id IS NOT NULL),
  ad AS (SELECT * FROM fx WHERE dm <= v_r),
  mk AS (SELECT ad.*, CASE WHEN lag(fix) OVER w IS NULL OR fix - lag(fix) OVER w > interval '8 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nuevo FROM ad WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY device_id, llave ORDER BY fix)),
  isl AS (SELECT mk.*, sum(nuevo) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id, llave ORDER BY fix) AS isla FROM mk),
  g AS (SELECT device_id, llave, isla, max(chofer) AS chofer, max(folio) AS folio, max(cliente) AS cliente, max(orden) AS orden, max(hora_plan) AS hora_plan, max(nivel) AS nivel, min(fix) AS llegada, max(fix) AS ultimo,
               min(vel) AS min_vel, (array_agg(vel ORDER BY fix DESC))[1] AS last_vel, min(dm) AS dmin, (array_agg(lat ORDER BY dm))[1] AS lat, (array_agg(lng ORDER BY dm))[1] AS lng FROM isl GROUP BY device_id, llave, isla),
  g2 AS (SELECT g.*, (SELECT min(p2.fix) FROM vw_gps_pos p2 WHERE p2.device_id = g.device_id AND p2.fix > g.ultimo) AS sig,
                (SELECT max(p3.fix) FROM vw_gps_pos p3 WHERE p3.device_id = g.device_id) AS ult_dev FROM g),
  g3 AS (SELECT g2.*, CASE WHEN sig IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN sig - ultimo <= interval '30 minutes' AND coalesce(last_vel, 0) < 5 THEN sig ELSE ultimo END AS salida FROM g2),
  g4 AS (SELECT g3.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id, llave ORDER BY llegada) AS vn,
                extract(epoch FROM (coalesce(salida, CASE WHEN ult_dev > now() - interval '12 minutes' THEN now() ELSE ultimo END) - llegada)) / 60.0 AS perm FROM g3)
  INSERT INTO vw_rep_visitas (fecha, device_id, chofer, folio, llave, cliente, orden, n, llegada, salida, en_sitio, perm_min, lat, lng, dist_m, nivel, hora_plan)
  SELECT p_fecha, device_id, chofer, folio, llave, cliente, orden, vn, llegada, salida, salida IS NULL, round(perm::numeric, 1), lat, lng, round(dmin::numeric), nivel, hora_plan
    FROM g4 WHERE min_vel < 8 AND perm >= v_pm::float8
  ON CONFLICT (fecha, device_id, llave, n) DO UPDATE SET llegada = EXCLUDED.llegada, salida = EXCLUDED.salida, en_sitio = EXCLUDED.en_sitio, perm_min = EXCLUDED.perm_min, lat = EXCLUDED.lat, lng = EXCLUDED.lng,
        dist_m = EXCLUDED.dist_m, chofer = EXCLUDED.chofer, hora_plan = EXCLUDED.hora_plan;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN n;
END $fn$;

-- ---------- lo que le falta a un chofer: entregas, tiempo para completarlas y para regresar, jornada que le queda ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_hm(t TEXT, d INT) RETURNS INT LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $fn$
  SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(t, '') ~ '^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$' THEN split_part(t, ':', 1)::int * 60 + split_part(t, ':', 2)::int ELSE d END
$fn$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_resto(p_fecha DATE, p_chofer TEXT) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE v_dev INT := vw_rep_dev(p_fecha, p_chofer); lp_lat DOUBLE PRECISION; lp_lng DOUBLE PRECISION; v_lat DOUBLE PRECISION; v_lng DOUBLE PRECISION; blat DOUBLE PRECISION := nullif(vw_cfg('gps_base_lat'), '')::float8; blng DOUBLE PRECISION := nullif(vw_cfg('gps_base_lng'), '')::float8;
  v_vel NUMERIC := vw_rep_num('gps_vel_kmh', 22); v_fac NUMERIC := vw_rep_num('gps_factor_calle', 1.35); v_min NUMERIC := vw_rep_num('gps_min_entrega', 15);
  rec RECORD; v_dist DOUBLE PRECISION := 0; v_sin INT := 0; v_pend JSONB := '[]'::jsonb; v_k INT := 0; v_ahora TIMESTAMP := now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'; v_comp NUMERIC; v_reg NUMERIC; v_rest INT;
BEGIN
  IF v_dev IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT p.lat, p.lng INTO lp_lat, lp_lng FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = v_dev ORDER BY p.fix DESC LIMIT 1; END IF;
  v_lat := coalesce(lp_lat, blat); v_lng := coalesce(lp_lng, blng);
  FOR rec IN SELECT e.n, e.folio, e.cliente, e.zona, e.hora_plan, (e.coord ->> 'lat')::float8 AS clat, (e.coord ->> 'lng')::float8 AS clng
               FROM vw_rep_estados(p_fecha) e WHERE vw_rep_mismo(e.chofer, p_chofer) AND e.estado IN ('pendiente', 'en_sitio') ORDER BY e.n LOOP
    v_k := v_k + 1;
    v_pend := v_pend || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('folio', rec.folio, 'cliente', rec.cliente, 'zona', rec.zona, 'hora', rec.hora_plan));
    IF rec.clat IS NOT NULL AND v_lat IS NOT NULL THEN v_dist := v_dist + vw_rep_m(v_lat, v_lng, rec.clat, rec.clng); v_lat := rec.clat; v_lng := rec.clng; ELSE v_sin := v_sin + 1; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  v_comp := v_k * v_min + v_sin * 8 + (v_dist / 1000.0) * v_fac / nullif(v_vel, 0) * 60;
  v_reg := CASE WHEN blat IS NOT NULL AND v_lat IS NOT NULL THEN (vw_rep_m(v_lat, v_lng, blat, blng) / 1000.0) * v_fac / nullif(v_vel, 0) * 60 END;
  v_rest := vw_rep_hm(vw_cfg('rep_jornada_fin'), 1080) - (extract(hour FROM v_ahora) * 60 + extract(minute FROM v_ahora))::int;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('pendientes', v_pend, 'n', v_k, 'est_completar_min', round(v_comp), 'est_regreso_min', round(v_reg), 'jornada_restante_min', v_rest,
    'lat', lp_lat, 'lng', lp_lng, 'dispositivo', v_dev);
END $fn$;

-- ---------- jornada del día de cada camioneta: cuándo salió, cuándo regresó y km (para el tablero) ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_jornada_act(p_fecha DATE) RETURNS INT LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
DECLARE n INT := 0; blat DOUBLE PRECISION := nullif(vw_cfg('gps_base_lat'), '')::float8; blng DOUBLE PRECISION := nullif(vw_cfg('gps_base_lng'), '')::float8;
  d0 TIMESTAMPTZ := p_fecha::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'; d1 TIMESTAMPTZ := (p_fecha + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City';
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO vw_rep_jornada (fecha, device_id, chofer, salio, regreso, km)
  SELECT p_fecha, z.device_id, vw_rep_chofer_de(p_fecha, z.device_id), z.salio,
         CASE WHEN z.salio IS NOT NULL AND z.ult_fuera IS NOT NULL THEN z.regreso END, z.km
    FROM (SELECT u.device_id,
                 min(p.fix) FILTER (WHERE p.vel >= 5) AS salio,
                 max(p.fix) FILTER (WHERE blat IS NOT NULL AND vw_rep_m(blat, blng, p.lat, p.lng) > 300) AS ult_fuera,
                 min(p.fix) FILTER (WHERE blat IS NOT NULL AND vw_rep_m(blat, blng, p.lat, p.lng) <= 300
                                      AND p.fix > coalesce((SELECT max(p2.fix) FROM vw_gps_pos p2 WHERE p2.device_id = u.device_id AND p2.fix >= d0 AND p2.fix < d1 AND blat IS NOT NULL AND vw_rep_m(blat, blng, p2.lat, p2.lng) > 300), d0)) AS regreso,
                 round(max(p.km_total) FILTER (WHERE p.km_total > 0) - min(p.km_total) FILTER (WHERE p.km_total > 0), 1) AS km
            FROM vw_gps_unidades u JOIN vw_gps_pos p ON p.device_id = u.device_id AND p.fix >= d0 AND p.fix < d1
           WHERE u.activo GROUP BY u.device_id) z
  ON CONFLICT (fecha, device_id) DO UPDATE SET chofer = EXCLUDED.chofer, salio = EXCLUDED.salio, regreso = EXCLUDED.regreso, km = EXCLUDED.km, actualizado = now();
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN n;
END $fn$;

-- ---------- Fase 4 · cada 2 minutos: detecta visitas, revisa reglas y devuelve los avisos de Telegram ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_tick() RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE hoy DATE := vw_rep_hoy(); v_ahora TIMESTAMP := now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'; v_hh INT := (extract(hour FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') * 60 + extract(minute FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'))::int;
  l TEXT[] := '{}'; out JSONB := '[]'::jsonb; rec RECORD; v_id BIGINT; v_esp NUMERIC := vw_rep_num('rep_espera_min', 10); v_pl NUMERIC := vw_rep_num('rep_parada_larga_min', 20);
  v_fin INT := vw_rep_hm(vw_cfg('rep_jornada_fin'), 1080); v_ini INT := 420; v_rep INT := vw_rep_hm(vw_cfg('rep_reporte_hora'), 1140); blat DOUBLE PRECISION := nullif(vw_cfg('gps_base_lat'), '')::float8; blng DOUBLE PRECISION := nullif(vw_cfg('gps_base_lng'), '')::float8;
  v_ventana BOOLEAN; v_r JSONB; v_txt TEXT; d0 TIMESTAMPTZ := hoy::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'; d1 TIMESTAMPTZ := (hoy + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'; v_n INT; v_t TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(770707) THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb; END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.rutas_confirmadas') IS NULL OR to_regclass('public.entregas_evidencia') IS NULL THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb; END IF;
  PERFORM vw_rep_detectar(hoy);
  BEGIN PERFORM vw_alertas_stock_calc(); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
  PERFORM vw_rep_jornada_act(hoy);
  IF random() < 0.02 THEN DELETE FROM vw_rep_avisos WHERE creado < now() - interval '60 days'; END IF;
  v_ventana := coalesce(vw_cfg('rep_alertas'), 'si') <> 'no' AND v_hh BETWEEN v_ini AND 1290;

  IF v_ventana THEN
    -- a) lleva mucho tiempo en un domicilio sin registrar nada
    FOR rec IN SELECT v.id, v.device_id, v.chofer, v.cliente, v.folio, v.perm_min FROM vw_rep_visitas v JOIN vw_rep_estados(hoy) e ON e.v_id = v.id AND e.estado = 'en_sitio'
                WHERE v.fecha = hoy AND v.en_sitio AND NOT v.avisado_espera AND v.perm_min >= v_esp LOOP
      UPDATE vw_rep_visitas SET avisado_espera = true WHERE id = rec.id;
      PERFORM vw_rep_incid_crear(hoy, 'espera_larga', rec.folio, rec.cliente, rec.chofer, rec.device_id, 'gps', 'Lleva ' || round(rec.perm_min) || ' min en el domicilio sin registrar la entrega', jsonb_build_object('min', rec.perm_min), NULL, 'esp:' || rec.id);
      l := l || ('⏱️ <b>' || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || '</b> lleva ' || round(rec.perm_min) || ' min en ' || vw_rep_h(rec.cliente) || ' (' || vw_rep_h(rec.folio) || ') sin registrar. Oficina: ¿se espera, se reprograma o sigue la ruta?');
    END LOOP;
    -- b) estuvo, se fue y no registró: posible entrega, pendiente de confirmación
    FOR rec IN SELECT v.id, v.device_id, v.chofer, v.cliente, v.folio, v.perm_min FROM vw_rep_visitas v JOIN vw_rep_estados(hoy) e ON e.v_id = v.id AND e.estado = 'posible'
                WHERE v.fecha = hoy AND NOT v.en_sitio AND NOT v.avisado_sin_reg AND v.salida < now() - interval '10 minutes' LOOP
      UPDATE vw_rep_visitas SET avisado_sin_reg = true WHERE id = rec.id;
      PERFORM vw_rep_incid_crear(hoy, 'sin_registro', rec.folio, rec.cliente, rec.chofer, rec.device_id, 'gps', 'POSIBLE ENTREGA REALIZADA — PENDIENTE DE CONFIRMACIÓN. Estuvo ' || round(rec.perm_min) || ' min y siguió sin registrar.', jsonb_build_object('min', rec.perm_min), NULL, 'sr:' || rec.id);
      l := l || ('📍 <b>POSIBLE ENTREGA REALIZADA — PENDIENTE DE CONFIRMACIÓN</b>' || chr(10) || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || ' estuvo ' || round(rec.perm_min) || ' min en ' || vw_rep_h(rec.cliente) || ' (' || vw_rep_h(rec.folio) || ') y siguió sin registrar. Valídala en Reparto.');
    END LOOP;
    -- c) parada larga fuera de la ruta
    FOR rec IN SELECT u.device_id, vw_rep_chofer_de(hoy, u.device_id) AS chofer, lp.lat, lp.lng, lp.fix, lp.vel,
                      (SELECT max(p.fix) FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = u.device_id AND p.vel >= 5 AND p.fix >= d0 AND p.fix < d1) AS ult_mov
                 FROM vw_gps_unidades u JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = u.device_id ORDER BY p.fix DESC LIMIT 1) lp ON true
                WHERE u.activo AND lp.fix >= d0 AND lp.vel < 5 LOOP
      CONTINUE WHEN rec.ult_mov IS NULL OR rec.ult_mov < now() - interval '3 hours';
      v_n := floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - rec.ult_mov) / 60);
      CONTINUE WHEN v_n < v_pl OR v_hh < 480 OR v_hh > v_fin;
      CONTINUE WHEN vw_rep_en_casa(rec.device_id, hoy, rec.lat, rec.lng);  -- V8.11: en la tienda o donde se guarda la camioneta
      CONTINUE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_rep_visitas v WHERE v.fecha = hoy AND v.device_id = rec.device_id AND v.en_sitio);
      CONTINUE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_rep_estados(hoy) e WHERE e.device_id = rec.device_id AND e.estado IN ('pendiente', 'en_sitio') AND e.coord IS NOT NULL
                              AND vw_rep_m((e.coord ->> 'lat')::float8, (e.coord ->> 'lng')::float8, rec.lat, rec.lng) <= CASE WHEN coalesce(e.coord ->> 'nivel', 'exacta') IN ('colonia', 'cp') THEN 1300 ELSE 150 END);
      v_id := vw_rep_incid_crear(hoy, 'parada_larga', NULL, NULL, rec.chofer, rec.device_id, 'gps', 'Parada de ' || v_n || ' min fuera de la ruta y de la bodega', jsonb_build_object('min', v_n, 'desde', rec.ult_mov),
                                 NULL, 'pl:' || hoy || ':' || rec.device_id || ':' || to_char(rec.ult_mov AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24MI'), rec.lat, rec.lng);
      IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        l := l || ('🛑 <b>' || vw_rep_h(coalesce(rec.chofer, 'Camioneta ' || rec.device_id)) || '</b> lleva ' || v_n || ' min parado fuera de la ruta. Revisar (no es una conclusión).');
      ELSE
        UPDATE vw_rep_incid SET datos = jsonb_build_object('min', v_n, 'desde', rec.ult_mov), detalle = 'Parada de ' || v_n || ' min fuera de la ruta y de la bodega'
         WHERE clave = 'pl:' || hoy || ':' || rec.device_id || ':' || to_char(rec.ult_mov AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24MI') AND estado = 'abierta';
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
    -- d) la ruta va a quedar fuera de la jornada
    FOR rec IN SELECT e.chofer, max(e.device_id) AS device_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('pendiente', 'en_sitio')) AS pend FROM vw_rep_estados(hoy) e GROUP BY e.chofer HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('pendiente', 'en_sitio')) > 0 LOOP
      CONTINUE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_rep_jornada j WHERE j.fecha = hoy AND j.device_id = rec.device_id AND j.salio IS NOT NULL AND j.regreso IS NULL);
      v_r := vw_rep_resto(hoy, rec.chofer);
      CONTINUE WHEN (v_r ->> 'est_completar_min')::int + coalesce((v_r ->> 'est_regreso_min')::int, 0) <= (v_r ->> 'jornada_restante_min')::int;
      CONTINUE WHEN (v_r ->> 'jornada_restante_min')::int < -180;
      IF vw_rep_aviso_nuevo('atr:' || hoy || ':' || rec.device_id || ':' || (v_hh / 60)) THEN
        l := l || ('⏰ <b>ALERTA: RUTA ' || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || '</b>' || chr(10) || 'Son las ' || to_char(v_ahora, 'HH24:MI') || '. Quedan ' || rec.pend || ' entrega(s). Tiempo estimado restante: ' ||
                   ((v_r ->> 'est_completar_min')::int + coalesce((v_r ->> 'est_regreso_min')::int, 0)) / 60 || ' h ' || ((v_r ->> 'est_completar_min')::int + coalesce((v_r ->> 'est_regreso_min')::int, 0)) % 60 || ' min; disponible en la jornada: ' ||
                   greatest((v_r ->> 'jornada_restante_min')::int, 0) / 60 || ' h ' || greatest((v_r ->> 'jornada_restante_min')::int, 0) % 60 || ' min.' || chr(10) || 'Acción sugerida: contactar a clientes, evaluar prioridades y reorganizar las entregas.');
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
    -- e) regresó a la bodega con pedidos sin estado
    FOR rec IN SELECT j.device_id, j.chofer, (SELECT count(*) FROM vw_rep_estados(hoy) e WHERE e.device_id = j.device_id AND e.estado = 'pendiente') AS pend FROM vw_rep_jornada j WHERE j.fecha = hoy AND j.regreso IS NOT NULL LOOP
      CONTINUE WHEN rec.pend = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_rep_cierre c WHERE c.fecha = hoy AND c.device_id = rec.device_id AND c.estado = 'autorizado');
      v_id := vw_rep_incid_crear(hoy, 'regreso_anticipado', NULL, NULL, rec.chofer, rec.device_id, 'gps', 'Regresó a la bodega con ' || rec.pend || ' pedido(s) sin estado', jsonb_build_object('pendientes', rec.pend), NULL, 'ra:' || hoy || ':' || rec.device_id);
      IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN l := l || ('↩️ <b>' || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || '</b> regresó a la bodega con ' || rec.pend || ' pedido(s) sin estado definido. Revisar y decidir.'); END IF;
    END LOOP;
    -- f) lo que marcó el chofer no coincide con el GPS (para revisar, no para acusar)
    FOR rec IN SELECT e.chofer, e.device_id, e.folio, e.cliente, e.llave, round(vw_rep_m(e.ev_lat, e.ev_lng, (e.coord ->> 'lat')::float8, (e.coord ->> 'lng')::float8)) AS dm FROM vw_rep_estados(hoy) e
                WHERE e.ev_tipo = 'entregado' AND e.ev_lat IS NOT NULL AND e.coord IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(e.coord ->> 'nivel', 'exacta') NOT IN ('colonia', 'cp')
                  AND vw_rep_m(e.ev_lat, e.ev_lng, (e.coord ->> 'lat')::float8, (e.coord ->> 'lng')::float8) > 500 LOOP
      v_id := vw_rep_incid_crear(hoy, 'ubicacion_no_coincide', rec.folio, rec.cliente, rec.chofer, rec.device_id, 'gps', 'Marcó ENTREGADO a ' || rec.dm || ' m del domicilio', jsonb_build_object('metros', rec.dm), NULL, 'ub:' || hoy || ':' || rec.llave);
      IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN l := l || ('⚠️ <b>' || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || '</b> marcó ENTREGADO ' || vw_rep_h(rec.folio) || ' a ' || rec.dm || ' m del domicilio. Revisar.'); END IF;
    END LOOP;
    FOR rec IN SELECT e.chofer, e.device_id, e.folio, e.cliente, e.llave FROM vw_rep_estados(hoy) e
                WHERE e.ev_tipo = 'entregado' AND e.v_id IS NULL AND e.ev_hora < now() - interval '15 minutes' AND e.coord IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(e.coord ->> 'nivel', 'exacta') NOT IN ('colonia', 'cp')
                  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = e.device_id AND p.fix >= d0 AND p.fix < d1) >= 20
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_rep_incid i WHERE i.fecha = hoy AND i.llave = e.llave AND i.tipo = 'ubicacion_no_coincide') LOOP
      v_id := vw_rep_incid_crear(hoy, 'entregado_sin_visita', rec.folio, rec.cliente, rec.chofer, rec.device_id, 'gps', 'Lo marcó ENTREGADO y el GPS no registra la visita al domicilio', NULL, NULL, 'sv:' || hoy || ':' || rec.llave);
      IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN l := l || ('⚠️ ' || vw_rep_h(rec.folio) || ' (' || vw_rep_h(rec.cliente) || ') está ENTREGADO pero el GPS de ' || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || ' no registra la visita. Revisar.'); END IF;
    END LOOP;
    -- g) lo que reportó el chofer desde su pantalla y las peticiones de cierre de ruta
    FOR rec IN SELECT i.id, i.tipo, i.chofer, i.cliente, i.folio, i.detalle FROM vw_rep_incid i WHERE i.fecha >= hoy - 1 AND i.origen = 'chofer' AND NOT i.avisado ORDER BY i.id LOOP
      UPDATE vw_rep_incid SET avisado = true WHERE id = rec.id;
      l := l || (CASE rec.tipo WHEN 'no_contesta' THEN '📞 <b>CLIENTE NO CONTESTA</b>' || chr(10) || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || ' está con ' || vw_rep_h(rec.cliente) || ' (' || vw_rep_h(rec.folio) || '). Oficina: intenta localizarlo; espera sugerida ' || round(v_esp) || ' min y luego decides si se espera, se reprograma o sigue la ruta.'
                      WHEN 'cliente_cancelo' THEN '🚫 <b>CLIENTE CANCELÓ</b>' || chr(10) || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || ': ' || vw_rep_h(rec.cliente) || ' (' || vw_rep_h(rec.folio) || ').'
                      ELSE '🛠️ <b>PROBLEMA REPORTADO</b>' || chr(10) || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || ': ' || vw_rep_h(rec.detalle) || coalesce(' · ' || vw_rep_h(rec.cliente), '') END);
    END LOOP;
    FOR rec IN SELECT c.* FROM vw_rep_cierre c WHERE c.fecha >= hoy - 1 AND NOT c.avisado ORDER BY c.id LOOP
      UPDATE vw_rep_cierre SET avisado = true WHERE id = rec.id;
      l := l || ('↩️ <b>CIERRE DE RUTA SOLICITADO</b>' || chr(10) || vw_rep_h(rec.chofer) || ' quiere regresar a la bodega. Motivo: ' || vw_rep_h(rec.motivo) || coalesce(' · ' || vw_rep_h(rec.detalle), '') || chr(10) ||
                 'Pendientes: ' || jsonb_array_length(coalesce(rec.pendientes, '[]'::jsonb)) || ' · completarlos: ~' || coalesce(rec.est_completar_min::text, '?') || ' min · regreso a bodega: ~' || coalesce(rec.est_regreso_min::text, '?') || ' min · jornada restante: ' || coalesce(rec.jornada_restante_min::text, '?') || ' min. Autoriza, reorganiza o reasigna en Reparto.');
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  -- h) en la mañana: qué pedidos de hoy no están confirmados por el cliente (solo si el bot ya manda confirmaciones)
  IF v_hh >= 450 AND v_hh < 720 AND coalesce(vw_cfg('rep_alertas'), 'si') <> 'no' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_rep_confirm WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 days') AND vw_rep_aviso_nuevo('am:' || hoy) THEN
    SELECT string_agg('• ' || vw_rep_h(coalesce(e.cliente, e.folio)) || ' (' || vw_rep_h(e.folio) || ') · ' ||
             CASE WHEN e.confirma IS NULL THEN 'sin respuesta' WHEN e.confirma = 'confirmado' AND e.confirma_ts < (hoy - vw_rep_num('rep_confirm_viejo_dias', 2)::int)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City' THEN 'confirmación antigua'
                  WHEN e.confirma = 'reprogramar' THEN 'pidió reprogramar' ELSE e.confirma END, chr(10) ORDER BY e.chofer, e.n), count(*)
      INTO v_t, v_n FROM vw_rep_estados(hoy) e
     WHERE e.estado = 'pendiente' AND (e.confirma IS NULL OR e.confirma IN ('sin_respuesta', 'reprogramar', 'cancelado') OR (e.confirma = 'confirmado' AND e.confirma_ts < (hoy - vw_rep_num('rep_confirm_viejo_dias', 2)::int)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'));
    IF v_n > 0 THEN l := l || ('☀️ <b>Pedidos de hoy que conviene confirmar antes de cargar</b> (' || v_n || '):' || chr(10) || left(v_t, 1800) || chr(10) || 'No se cancelan solos: decide si conviene cargarlos, llamar o dejarlos para después.'); END IF;
  END IF;

  -- i) al cierre del día: ningún pedido se queda sin estado; reporte diario
  IF v_hh >= v_rep AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_rep_paradas(hoy)) AND vw_rep_aviso_nuevo('rep:' || hoy) THEN
    FOR rec IN SELECT e.chofer, e.device_id, e.folio, e.cliente, e.llave, e.estado FROM vw_rep_estados(hoy) e WHERE e.estado IN ('pendiente', 'en_sitio', 'posible') LOOP
      PERFORM vw_rep_incid_crear(hoy, 'sin_estado', rec.folio, rec.cliente, rec.chofer, rec.device_id, 'sistema', 'Cerró el día sin un estado definido (' || rec.estado || '). Oficina debe resolverlo.', NULL, NULL, 'se:' || hoy || ':' || rec.llave);
    END LOOP;
    out := out || vw_rep_msg(vw_rep_reporte(hoy));
  END IF;

  IF coalesce(array_length(l, 1), 0) > 0 THEN out := out || vw_rep_msg('🚚 <b>Reparto</b>' || chr(10) || chr(10) || array_to_string(l, chr(10) || chr(10))); END IF;
  RETURN out;
END $fn$;

-- ---------- Fase 5 · reporte diario ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_reporte(p_fecha DATE) RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE rec RECORD; v_t TEXT; v_dias TEXT[] := ARRAY['dom', 'lun', 'mar', 'mié', 'jue', 'vie', 'sáb']; v_pun NUMERIC := vw_rep_num('rep_puntual_min', 30); v_op TEXT[] := '{}'; v_n INT; v_m NUMERIC; v_pend INT := 0; v_x TEXT;
BEGIN
  v_t := '📋 <b>REPORTE DIARIO DE REPARTO</b> · ' || v_dias[extract(dow FROM p_fecha)::int + 1] || ' ' || to_char(p_fecha, 'DD/MM');
  FOR rec IN SELECT e.chofer, count(*) AS prog, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'entregado') AS ent,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado') AND coalesce(e.ev_motivo, '') ~* 'contest|ausente|no_estaba') AS aus,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado') AND coalesce(e.ev_motivo, '') ~* 'cancel') AS canc,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado') AND coalesce(e.causa, 'sin_justificar') = 'sin_justificar') AS sinj,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado')) AS fall,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('pendiente', 'en_sitio', 'posible')) AS pend,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'entregado' AND e.ev_tipo = 'entregado' AND e.ev_foto AND e.ev_lat IS NOT NULL) AS regok,
                    (SELECT count(*) FROM vw_rep_incid i WHERE i.fecha = p_fecha AND i.estado = 'abierta' AND vw_rep_mismo(i.chofer, e.chofer)) AS inc
               FROM vw_rep_estados(p_fecha) e GROUP BY e.chofer ORDER BY e.chofer LOOP
    v_t := v_t || chr(10) || chr(10) || '<b>' || vw_rep_h(initcap(rec.chofer)) || '</b>' || chr(10) ||
           '- Programadas: ' || rec.prog || chr(10) || '- Entregadas: ' || rec.ent || chr(10) ||
           CASE WHEN rec.aus > 0 THEN '- Cliente ausente / no contestó: ' || rec.aus || chr(10) ELSE '' END ||
           CASE WHEN rec.canc > 0 THEN '- Cliente canceló: ' || rec.canc || chr(10) ELSE '' END ||
           CASE WHEN rec.sinj > 0 THEN '- Sin justificación: ' || rec.sinj || chr(10) ELSE '' END ||
           CASE WHEN rec.pend > 0 THEN '- Sin estado definido: ' || rec.pend || chr(10) ELSE '' END ||
           '- Cumplimiento bruto: ' || round(100.0 * rec.ent / nullif(rec.prog, 0)) || '%' || chr(10) ||
           '- Registros completos: ' || rec.regok || ' de ' || rec.ent || chr(10) ||
           '- Incidencias pendientes de revisar: ' || rec.inc;
    v_pend := v_pend + rec.pend;
  END LOOP;
  IF v_t NOT LIKE '%Programadas%' THEN RETURN v_t || chr(10) || chr(10) || 'No hubo ruta confirmada para este día.'; END IF;
  -- resumen ejecutivo
  SELECT count(*), max(a.atraso) INTO v_n, v_m FROM (SELECT (extract(hour FROM e.v_llegada AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') * 60 + extract(minute FROM e.v_llegada AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')) - vw_rep_hm(e.hora_plan, NULL) AS atraso
                                                       FROM vw_rep_estados(p_fecha) e WHERE e.v_llegada IS NOT NULL AND vw_rep_hm(e.hora_plan, NULL) IS NOT NULL) a WHERE a.atraso > v_pun;
  IF v_n > 0 THEN v_op := v_op || ('Llegadas con más de ' || round(v_pun) || ' min de retraso contra el plan: ' || v_n || ' (la peor, +' || round(v_m) || ' min). Revisar los tiempos de traslado de esas zonas.'); END IF;
  SELECT count(*), string_agg(vw_rep_h(coalesce(e.cliente, e.folio)) || ' ' || round(e.v_perm) || ' min', ', ' ORDER BY e.v_perm DESC) INTO v_n, v_x FROM vw_rep_estados(p_fecha) e WHERE e.v_perm > 25;
  IF v_n > 0 THEN v_op := v_op || ('Estancias de más de 25 min en un domicilio: ' || v_n || ' (' || left(v_x, 200) || ').'); END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM vw_rep_estados(p_fecha) e WHERE e.estado = 'entregado' AND e.ev_tipo = 'entregado' AND NOT coalesce(e.ev_foto, false);
  IF v_n > 0 THEN v_op := v_op || (v_n || ' entrega(s) marcadas sin foto de evidencia.'); END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(sum((i.datos ->> 'min')::numeric), 0), count(*) INTO v_m, v_n FROM vw_rep_incid i WHERE i.fecha = p_fecha AND i.tipo = 'parada_larga';
  IF v_n > 0 THEN v_op := v_op || ('Paradas largas fuera de ruta: ' || v_n || ' (' || round(v_m) || ' min en total).'); END IF;
  IF v_pend > 0 THEN v_op := v_op || (v_pend || ' pedido(s) siguen sin estado definido: oficina debe validarlos hoy (Reparto → Hoy).'); END IF;
  IF coalesce(array_length(v_op, 1), 0) = 0 THEN v_op := v_op || 'Sin hallazgos importantes en el día.'::text; END IF;
  RETURN v_t || chr(10) || chr(10) || '<b>Resumen ejecutivo</b>' || chr(10) || '• ' || array_to_string(v_op, chr(10) || '• ');
END $fn$;

-- ---------- Fase 5 · indicadores por chofer ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_kpi(p_desde DATE, p_hasta DATE) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE v_d DATE := p_desde; v_h DATE := least(p_hasta, p_desde + 61); v_pun NUMERIC := vw_rep_num('rep_puntual_min', 30); gas JSONB; res JSONB;
BEGIN
  gas := coalesce(vw_gps_costos(v_d, v_h) -> 'retiros', '[]'::jsonb);
  WITH d AS (SELECT g::date AS f FROM generate_series(v_d, v_h, interval '1 day') g),
  e0 AS (SELECT d.f, x.* FROM d CROSS JOIN LATERAL vw_rep_estados(d.f) x),
  e AS (SELECT e0.*, lag(e0.v_salida) OVER (PARTITION BY e0.f, e0.chofer ORDER BY e0.v_llegada) AS salida_ant,
               CASE WHEN vw_rep_hm(e0.hora_plan, NULL) IS NOT NULL AND e0.v_llegada IS NOT NULL
                    THEN (extract(hour FROM e0.v_llegada AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') * 60 + extract(minute FROM e0.v_llegada AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')) - vw_rep_hm(e0.hora_plan, NULL) END AS atraso
          FROM e0),
  ch AS (SELECT e.chofer, count(*) AS prog, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'entregado') AS comp,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado')) AS fall,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado') AND e.causa = 'cliente') AS f_cliente,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado') AND e.causa = 'planeacion') AS f_planeacion,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado') AND e.causa = 'operacion') AS f_operacion,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado') AND coalesce(e.causa, 'sin_justificar') = 'sin_justificar') AS f_sin,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado') AND e.excluye) AS excl,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('pendiente', 'en_sitio', 'posible')) AS pend,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'entregado' AND e.ev_tipo = 'entregado' AND e.ev_foto AND e.ev_lat IS NOT NULL) AS regok,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.atraso IS NOT NULL) AS punt_n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.atraso IS NOT NULL AND abs(e.atraso) <= v_pun) AS punt_ok,
                round(avg(e.v_perm), 1) AS t_entrega,
                round(avg(extract(epoch FROM e.v_llegada - e.salida_ant) / 60) FILTER (WHERE e.salida_ant IS NOT NULL AND e.v_llegada > e.salida_ant AND e.v_llegada - e.salida_ant < interval '3 hours'), 1) AS traslado
           FROM e GROUP BY e.chofer),
  fin AS (SELECT ch.*,
                (SELECT jsonb_build_object('km', round(sum(j.km), 1), 'dias', count(*),
                    'salida', round(avg(extract(hour FROM j.salio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') * 60 + extract(minute FROM j.salio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'))),
                    'regreso', round(avg(extract(hour FROM j.regreso AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') * 60 + extract(minute FROM j.regreso AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City'))))
                   FROM vw_rep_jornada j WHERE j.fecha BETWEEN v_d AND v_h AND vw_rep_mismo(j.chofer, ch.chofer)) AS jr,
                (SELECT coalesce(sum((i.datos ->> 'min')::numeric), 0) FROM vw_rep_incid i WHERE i.tipo = 'parada_larga' AND i.fecha BETWEEN v_d AND v_h AND vw_rep_mismo(i.chofer, ch.chofer)) AS detenido,
                (SELECT count(*) FROM vw_rep_incid i WHERE i.estado = 'abierta' AND i.fecha BETWEEN v_d AND v_h AND vw_rep_mismo(i.chofer, ch.chofer)) AS inc_ab,
                (SELECT coalesce(sum((g ->> 'imp')::numeric), 0) FROM jsonb_array_elements(gas) g WHERE vw_rep_mismo(g ->> 'quien', ch.chofer)) AS gasolina
           FROM ch)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('desde', v_d, 'hasta', v_h,
    'por_chofer', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('chofer', f.chofer, 'prog', f.prog, 'comp', f.comp, 'fall', f.fall, 'f_cliente', f.f_cliente, 'f_planeacion', f.f_planeacion, 'f_operacion', f.f_operacion,
        'f_sin', f.f_sin, 'excl', f.excl, 'pend', f.pend, 'bruto', round(100.0 * f.comp / nullif(f.prog, 0), 1), 'ajustado', round(100.0 * f.comp / nullif(f.prog - f.excl, 0), 1),
        'regok', f.regok, 'registro_pct', round(100.0 * f.regok / nullif(f.comp, 0), 1), 'puntual_pct', round(100.0 * f.punt_ok / nullif(f.punt_n, 0), 1), 'punt_n', f.punt_n,
        't_entrega', f.t_entrega, 'traslado', f.traslado, 'km', f.jr ->> 'km', 'dias', f.jr ->> 'dias', 'salida_min', f.jr ->> 'salida', 'regreso_min', f.jr ->> 'regreso', 'detenido_min', f.detenido, 'inc_ab', f.inc_ab,
        'gasolina', f.gasolina, 'costo_km', round(f.gasolina / nullif((f.jr ->> 'km')::numeric, 0), 2), 'costo_entrega', round(f.gasolina / nullif(f.comp, 0), 2),
        'costo_fallidas', round(f.gasolina / nullif(f.prog, 0) * f.fall, 2)) ORDER BY f.chofer) FROM fin f), '[]'::jsonb),
    'por_dia', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('fecha', q.f, 'chofer', q.chofer, 'prog', q.prog, 'comp', q.comp, 'fall', q.fall, 'pend', q.pend) ORDER BY q.f, q.chofer)
                           FROM (SELECT e.f, e.chofer, count(*) AS prog, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'entregado') AS comp, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado')) AS fall,
                                        count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('pendiente', 'en_sitio', 'posible')) AS pend FROM e GROUP BY e.f, e.chofer) q), '[]'::jsonb),
    'gasolina_sin_chofer', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(g) FROM jsonb_array_elements(gas) g WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ch WHERE vw_rep_mismo(g ->> 'quien', ch.chofer))), '[]'::jsonb))
  INTO res;
  RETURN res;
END $fn$;

-- ---------- pantalla de oficina: el día completo ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vw_rep_panel(p_fecha DATE) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $fn$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE hoy DATE := vw_rep_hoy(); v_ch JSONB; v_inc JSONB; v_ci JSONB; v_un JSONB; v_cf JSONB; v_viejo TIMESTAMPTZ := (p_fecha - vw_rep_num('rep_confirm_viejo_dias', 2)::int)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City';
BEGIN
  WITH es AS (SELECT * FROM vw_rep_estados(p_fecha)),
  dv AS (SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM es WHERE device_id IS NOT NULL),
  gp AS (SELECT dv.device_id, jsonb_build_object('lat', lp.lat, 'lng', lp.lng, 'vel', lp.vel, 'min', floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - lp.fix) / 60),
            'salio', to_char(j.salio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI'), 'regreso', to_char(j.regreso AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI'), 'km', j.km,
            'nombre', (SELECT coalesce(nullif(u.alias, ''), u.nombre) FROM vw_gps_unidades u WHERE u.device_id = dv.device_id)) AS g
           FROM dv LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.lat, p.lng, p.vel, p.fix FROM vw_gps_pos p WHERE p.device_id = dv.device_id ORDER BY p.fix DESC LIMIT 1) lp ON true
                   LEFT JOIN vw_rep_jornada j ON j.fecha = p_fecha AND j.device_id = dv.device_id),
  ch AS (SELECT e.chofer, max(e.device_id) AS device_id, count(*) AS prog, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'entregado') AS ent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado IN ('no_entregado', 'reprogramado')) AS no,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'pendiente') AS pend, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'posible') AS posible, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.estado = 'en_sitio') AS en_sitio,
                jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('n', e.n, 'folio', e.folio, 'cliente', e.cliente, 'zona', e.zona, 'hora', e.hora_plan, 'piezas', e.piezas, 'estado', e.estado,
                   'confirma', CASE WHEN e.confirma IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.confirma = 'confirmado' AND e.confirma_ts < v_viejo THEN 'antigua' ELSE e.confirma END,
                   'tipo_ev', e.ev_tipo, 'motivo', e.ev_motivo, 'nota', e.ev_nota, 'ev_hora', to_char(e.ev_hora AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI'), 'foto', coalesce(e.ev_foto, false), 'ev_ubic', e.ev_lat IS NOT NULL,
                   'llego', to_char(e.ev_llego AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI'), 'res', e.res,
                   'v_id', e.v_id, 'v_ll', to_char(e.v_llegada AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI'), 'v_sa', to_char(e.v_salida AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI'), 'v_perm', e.v_perm, 'v_val', e.v_validacion,
                   'causa', e.causa, 'excluye', e.excluye, 'nivel', coalesce(e.coord ->> 'nivel', CASE WHEN e.coord IS NULL THEN 'sin' END), 'lat', e.coord -> 'lat', 'lng', e.coord -> 'lng') ORDER BY e.n) AS paradas
           FROM es e GROUP BY e.chofer)
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('chofer', ch.chofer, 'device_id', ch.device_id, 'gps', gp.g, 'resumen', jsonb_build_object('prog', ch.prog, 'ent', ch.ent, 'no', ch.no, 'pend', ch.pend, 'posible', ch.posible, 'en_sitio', ch.en_sitio), 'paradas', ch.paradas) ORDER BY ch.chofer), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_ch FROM ch LEFT JOIN gp ON gp.device_id = ch.device_id;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'fecha', i.fecha, 'tipo', i.tipo, 'folio', i.folio, 'cliente', i.cliente, 'chofer', i.chofer, 'detalle', i.detalle, 'causa', i.causa, 'responsable', i.responsable,
           'excluye', i.excluye, 'estado', i.estado, 'explica_chofer', i.explica_chofer, 'explicacion', i.explicacion, 'hora', to_char(i.creado AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI'), 'origen', i.origen,
           'lat', i.lat, 'lng', i.lng) ORDER BY (i.estado = 'abierta') DESC, i.id DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_inc FROM (SELECT * FROM vw_rep_incid WHERE fecha = p_fecha OR (estado = 'abierta' AND fecha >= hoy - 14) ORDER BY (estado = 'abierta') DESC, id DESC LIMIT 120) i;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'fecha', c.fecha, 'chofer', c.chofer, 'motivo', c.motivo, 'detalle', c.detalle, 'pendientes', c.pendientes, 'est_completar_min', c.est_completar_min, 'est_regreso_min', c.est_regreso_min,
           'jornada_restante_min', c.jornada_restante_min, 'estado', c.estado, 'nota', c.nota, 'hora', to_char(c.creado AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI')) ORDER BY c.id DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_ci FROM vw_rep_cierre c WHERE c.fecha = p_fecha OR (c.estado = 'solicitado' AND c.fecha >= hoy - 3);
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('device_id', u.device_id, 'nombre', coalesce(nullif(u.alias, ''), u.nombre), 'chofer_base', u.chofer, 'chofer_dia', vw_rep_chofer_de(p_fecha, u.device_id)) ORDER BY u.device_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_un FROM vw_gps_unidades u WHERE u.activo;
