      FROM v, hoy WHERE origen = 'PV' AND upper(tipo) = 'V' AND NOT cancelado AND fecha = hoy.d GROUP BY base, trim(almacen)) x),
  'pv_caja', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.t DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT v.base, coalesce(cj.datos->>'NOMBRE', 'Caja ' || v.caja_id::text, trim(v.almacen)) AS caja, count(*) AS n, sum(v.total) AS t
      FROM v JOIN hoy ON v.fecha = hoy.d
      LEFT JOIN ms_raw cj ON cj.base = v.base AND cj.tabla = 'CAJAS' AND cj.pk = v.caja_id::text
      WHERE v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'V' AND NOT v.cancelado GROUP BY 1, 2) x),
  'mov', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT upper(p.tipo) AS tdoc,
             coalesce(fc.datos->>'NOMBRE', 'Forma ' || (c.datos->>'FORMA_COBRO_ID')) AS forma,
             coalesce(fc.datos->>'NOMBRE', '') ~* 'efectivo' AS efectivo,
             coalesce(fc.datos->>'NOMBRE', '') ~* '^\s*cr[eé]dito' AS credito,
             count(DISTINCT p.docto_id) AS n,
             sum(CASE WHEN upper(coalesce(c.datos->>'TIPO', 'C')) = 'A' THEN -(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.datos->'IMPORTE') = 'number' THEN (c.datos->>'IMPORTE')::numeric ELSE 0 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.datos->'IMPORTE') = 'number' THEN (c.datos->>'IMPORTE')::numeric ELSE 0 END) END) AS t
      FROM ms_raw c
      JOIN v p ON p.base = c.base AND p.origen = 'PV' AND p.docto_id::text = c.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID'
      JOIN hoy ON p.fecha = hoy.d
      LEFT JOIN ms_raw fc ON fc.base = c.base AND fc.tabla = 'FORMAS_COBRO' AND fc.pk = c.datos->>'FORMA_COBRO_ID'
      WHERE c.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS' AND NOT p.cancelado
      GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) x),
  'creditos', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.t DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT p.folio, p.cliente, left(p.hora, 5) AS hora, sum((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.datos->'IMPORTE') = 'number' THEN (c.datos->>'IMPORTE')::numeric ELSE 0 END)) AS t
      FROM ms_raw c
      JOIN v p ON p.base = c.base AND p.origen = 'PV' AND p.docto_id::text = c.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID'
      JOIN hoy ON p.fecha = hoy.d
      JOIN ms_raw fc ON fc.base = c.base AND fc.tabla = 'FORMAS_COBRO' AND fc.pk = c.datos->>'FORMA_COBRO_ID'
      WHERE c.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS' AND upper(p.tipo) = 'V' AND NOT p.cancelado
        AND fc.datos->>'NOMBRE' ~* '^\s*cr[eé]dito' AND upper(coalesce(c.datos->>'TIPO', 'C')) <> 'A'
      GROUP BY p.folio, p.cliente, p.hora) x),
  'movs_lista', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.tdoc, x.hora), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT upper(p.tipo) AS tdoc, p.folio, left(p.hora, 5) AS hora, p.cliente,
             coalesce(nullif(trim(p.descripcion), ''), (
               SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT trim(e.value), ' · ')
               FROM ms_raw rf
               LEFT JOIN ms_raw c2 ON c2.base = rf.base AND c2.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS' AND c2.pk = rf.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_COBRO_ID'
               CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(rf.datos) e
               WHERE rf.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS_REFER' AND rf.base = p.base
                 AND coalesce(c2.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID', rf.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID') = p.docto_id::text
                 AND e.key !~ '(_ID|FECHA|HORA|USUARIO)' AND length(trim(e.value)) > 1
                 AND trim(e.value) !~ '^[0-9.:T -]+$' AND lower(trim(e.value)) NOT IN ('true', 'false')), '') AS descripcion,
             coalesce((SELECT sum((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.datos->'IMPORTE') = 'number' THEN (c.datos->>'IMPORTE')::numeric ELSE 0 END)) FROM ms_raw c WHERE c.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS' AND c.base = p.base
                        AND c.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID' = p.docto_id::text AND upper(coalesce(c.datos->>'TIPO', 'C')) <> 'A'), abs(p.total)) AS t
      FROM v p JOIN hoy ON p.fecha = hoy.d
      WHERE p.origen = 'PV' AND upper(p.tipo) IN ('R', 'I', 'D', 'P') AND NOT p.cancelado) x),
  'fondos', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT coalesce(cj.datos->>'NOMBRE', 'Caja ' || (m.datos->>'CAJA_ID')) AS caja, m.datos->>'TIPO_MOVTO' AS tipo_movto,
             left(m.datos->>'HORA', 5) AS hora,
             sum((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.datos->'IMPORTE') = 'number' THEN (f.datos->>'IMPORTE')::numeric ELSE 0 END)) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(fc.datos->>'NOMBRE', '') ~* 'efectivo') AS efectivo,
             sum((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.datos->'IMPORTE') = 'number' THEN (f.datos->>'IMPORTE')::numeric ELSE 0 END)) AS total, count(f.pk) AS renglones
      FROM ms_raw m JOIN hoy ON m.fecha = hoy.d
      LEFT JOIN ms_raw f ON f.base = m.base AND f.tabla = 'MOVTOS_CAJAS_FONDO' AND f.datos->>'MOVTO_CAJA_ID' = m.pk
      LEFT JOIN ms_raw fc ON fc.base = f.base AND fc.tabla = 'FORMAS_COBRO' AND fc.pk = f.datos->>'FORMA_COBRO_ID'
      LEFT JOIN ms_raw cj ON cj.base = m.base AND cj.tabla = 'CAJAS' AND cj.pk = m.datos->>'CAJA_ID'
      WHERE m.tabla = 'MOVTOS_CAJAS' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, m.pk) x),
  'cortes', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT coalesce(cj.datos->>'NOMBRE', 'Caja ' || (m.datos->>'CAJA_ID')) AS caja,
             min(left(m.datos->>'HORA', 5)) FILTER (WHERE m.datos->>'TIPO_MOVTO' = 'A') AS apertura,
             max(left(m.datos->>'HORA', 5)) FILTER (WHERE m.datos->>'TIPO_MOVTO' = 'C') AS cierre
      FROM ms_raw m JOIN hoy ON m.fecha = hoy.d
      LEFT JOIN ms_raw cj ON cj.base = m.base AND cj.tabla = 'CAJAS' AND cj.pk = m.datos->>'CAJA_ID'
      WHERE m.tabla = 'MOVTOS_CAJAS' GROUP BY 1) x),
  'pedidos', (SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 't', coalesce(sum(total), 0),
        'pend', count(*) FILTER (WHERE estatus = 'P'), 'surt', count(*) FILTER (WHERE estatus = 'S'),
        'lista', coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('folio', folio, 'cliente', cliente, 'total', total, 'estatus', estatus) ORDER BY total DESC), '[]'::json))
      FROM v, hoy WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'P' AND NOT cancelado AND fecha = hoy.d AND total <= {{ Number($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.monto_maximo) || 500000 }}),
  'remisiones', (SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 't', coalesce(sum(total), 0),
        'lista', coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('folio', folio, 'cliente', cliente, 'total', total, 'almacen', trim(almacen), 'hora', left(hora, 5), 'base', base) ORDER BY hora), '[]'::json))
      FROM v, hoy WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'R' AND NOT cancelado AND fecha = hoy.d AND total <= {{ Number($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.monto_maximo) || 500000 }}),
  'facturas', (SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 't', coalesce(sum(total), 0))
      FROM v, hoy WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'F' AND NOT cancelado AND fecha = hoy.d AND total <= {{ Number($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.monto_maximo) || 500000 }}),
  'rem_pend', (SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 't', coalesce(sum(total), 0), 'dias', coalesce(max(hoy.d - fecha), 0))
      FROM v, hoy WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'R' AND estatus = 'P' AND total <= {{ Number($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.monto_maximo) || 500000 }}),
  'ped_pend', (SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 't', coalesce(sum(total), 0), 'dias', coalesce(max(hoy.d - fecha), 0))
      FROM v, hoy WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'P' AND estatus = 'P' AND total <= {{ Number($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.monto_maximo) || 500000 }}),
  'revisar', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.total DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT tipo, folio, cliente, total, to_char(fecha, 'DD/MM') AS fecha_doc FROM v, hoy
      WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo IN ('P', 'R', 'F') AND NOT cancelado AND total > {{ Number($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.monto_maximo) || 500000 }}
        AND (fecha = hoy.d OR estatus = 'P')) x),
  'cancelados', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.tipo, x.total DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT tipo, folio, cliente, total, to_char(fecha, 'DD/MM') AS fecha_doc, usuario, usuario_cancelacion, descripcion, base
      FROM v, hoy WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo IN ('P', 'R') AND cancelado
        AND COALESCE(fecha_cancelacion::date, fecha) = hoy.d) x),
  'inventario', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.valor DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT base, trim(almacen) AS almacen, sum(valor) AS valor, count(*) FILTER (WHERE existencia > 0) AS articulos
      FROM ms_existencias WHERE NOT {{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.ocultar_existencia_negativa === true ? 'true' : 'false' }} OR existencia > 0 GROUP BY base, trim(almacen) HAVING abs(sum(coalesce(valor, 0))) >= 1) x),
  'ultima_copia', (SELECT to_char(max(actualizado) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') FROM ms_existencias),
  'minutos_desde_copia', (SELECT round(extract(epoch FROM now() - max(actualizado)) / 60) FROM ms_existencias)
) AS r;

WITH ms_ventas_v AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas_v WHERE NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}', '') IS NULL OR base = '{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}'),
ms_ventas_det AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas_det WHERE NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}', '') IS NULL OR base = '{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}'),
ms_existencias AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_existencias WHERE NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}', '') IS NULL OR base = '{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}'),
ms_articulos AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_articulos WHERE NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}', '') IS NULL OR base = '{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}'),
ms_raw AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_raw WHERE NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}', '') IS NULL OR base = '{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.base }}'),
cfg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.fecha || '' }}', '')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date) AS d,
         {{ Number($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.monto_maximo) || 500000 }}::numeric AS maxm, {{ Number($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.dias_habiles_semana) || 6 }}::int AS dsem),
vt0 AS (   -- venta real: tickets de punto de venta + remisiones (salidas), sin cancelados ni montos anómalos
  SELECT v.base, v.origen, v.docto_id, v.fecha, v.cliente,
         CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS sg,
         CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -abs(v.total) ELSE v.total END AS total
  FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
  WHERE NOT v.cancelado AND abs(v.total) <= cfg.maxm AND v.fecha >= cfg.d - 70
    AND ((v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) IN ('V', 'D')) OR (v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo = 'F' AND (NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.almacenes_facturas || '' }}', '') IS NULL OR upper(trim(coalesce(v.almacen,''))) IN (SELECT upper(trim(x)) FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.almacenes_facturas || '' }}', ',')) x))))),
vt AS (SELECT * FROM vt0),
dia AS (SELECT fecha, sum(total) AS venta FROM vt GROUP BY fecha),
costo AS (  -- costo por artículo: 1) el que pusiste en Telegram, 2) último costo de compra, 3) costo promedio de Microsip
  SELECT a.base, a.articulo_id,
         coalesce(m.costo,
                  CASE WHEN a.costo_ultimo > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND a.costo_ultimo > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN a.costo_ultimo END,
                  CASE WHEN c0.cu0 > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND c0.cu0 > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN c0.cu0 END) AS cu,
         CASE WHEN m.costo IS NOT NULL THEN 'manual'
              WHEN a.costo_ultimo > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND a.costo_ultimo > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN 'ultima compra'
              WHEN c0.cu0 > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND c0.cu0 > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN 'promedio' END AS fuente
  FROM ms_articulos a
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT base, articulo_id, sum(valor) / NULLIF(sum(existencia), 0) AS cu0 FROM ms_existencias
             WHERE existencia > 0 AND valor > 0 GROUP BY base, articulo_id) c0 ON c0.base = a.base AND c0.articulo_id = a.articulo_id
  LEFT JOIN ms_costos_manual m ON m.base = a.base AND m.articulo_id = a.articulo_id),
lin AS (  -- renglones con costo promedio actual (utilidad estimada)
  SELECT vt.fecha, vt.sg * abs(d.importe) AS importe,
         CASE WHEN c.cu IS NOT NULL AND abs(d.unidades) * c.cu <= 2 * abs(d.importe) THEN vt.sg * abs(d.unidades) * c.cu END AS costo,
         (c.cu IS NOT NULL AND abs(d.unidades) * c.cu <= 2 * abs(d.importe)) AS con_costo
  FROM vt JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id
  LEFT JOIN costo c ON c.base = d.base AND c.articulo_id = d.articulo_id),
util AS (SELECT fecha, sum(importe) AS venta_siva, sum(importe) FILTER (WHERE con_costo) AS venta_con_costo,
                sum(costo) AS costo FROM lin GROUP BY fecha),
mes AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', d)::date AS ini, (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS fin FROM cfg),
hab AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE g::date <= cfg.d) AS transcurridos, count(*) AS totales
        FROM mes, cfg, generate_series(mes.ini, mes.fin, interval '1 day') g WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) <= cfg.dsem),
cmx AS (
  SELECT sum(c) FILTER (WHERE o = 'PV' AND t = 'V') AS cv, sum(c) FILTER (WHERE o = 'PV' AND t = 'D') AS cd, sum(c) FILTER (WHERE o = 'VE' AND t = 'F') AS cf, sum(c) FILTER (WHERE o = 'VE' AND t = 'R') AS cr, count(*) > 0 AS hay
  FROM (SELECT r.datos ->> 'ORIGEN' AS o, upper(r.datos ->> 'TIPO') AS t, (r.datos ->> 'COSTO')::numeric AS c FROM ms_raw r, mes WHERE r.tabla = 'COSTO_VENDIDO_TIPO' AND r.datos ->> 'MES' = to_char(mes.ini, 'YYYY-MM')) z),
rv AS (  -- venta de remisiones del mes y venta de facturas ligadas a remisiones (su costo está en las remisiones)
  SELECT sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE upper(v.tipo) = 'R') AS vr,
         sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE upper(v.tipo) = 'F' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_raw l WHERE l.base = v.base AND l.tabla = 'VE_FACT_LIGADA' AND l.pk = v.docto_id::text)) AS vfl
  FROM ms_ventas_v v JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = v.base AND d.origen = v.origen AND d.docto_id = v.docto_id, mes
  WHERE v.origen = 'VE' AND upper(v.tipo) IN ('R', 'F') AND NOT v.cancelado AND v.fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND mes.fin),
cadj AS (  -- costo estilo Microsip: mostrador + devoluciones + facturas directas + costo (a la tasa de las remisiones) de lo facturado desde remisiones
  SELECT cmx.hay, coalesce(cmx.cv, 0) + coalesce(cmx.cd, 0) + coalesce(cmx.cf, 0)
         + CASE WHEN coalesce(rv.vr, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(cmx.cr, 0) / rv.vr * coalesce(rv.vfl, 0) ELSE 0 END AS costo FROM cmx, rv),
pend AS (
  SELECT v.tipo, cfg.d - v.fecha AS dias, v.total, v.folio, v.cliente FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
  WHERE v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo IN ('P', 'R') AND v.estatus = 'P' AND v.total <= cfg.maxm)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'hoy', (SELECT coalesce(venta, 0) FROM dia, cfg WHERE fecha = cfg.d),
  'ayer', (SELECT json_build_object('fecha', to_char(fecha, 'DD/MM'), 'venta', venta) FROM dia, cfg
           WHERE fecha < cfg.d AND venta > 0 ORDER BY fecha DESC LIMIT 1),
  'sem_pasada', (SELECT coalesce(venta, 0) FROM dia, cfg WHERE fecha = cfg.d - 7),
  'prom30', (SELECT avg(venta) FROM dia, cfg WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.d - 30 AND cfg.d - 1 AND venta > 0),
  'dias_hist', (SELECT count(*) FROM dia, cfg WHERE fecha < cfg.d AND venta > 0),
  'util_hoy', (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM util u, cfg WHERE u.fecha = cfg.d),
  'mes', (SELECT json_build_object(
            'nombre', to_char(cfg.d, 'TMMonth'),
            'venta', (SELECT coalesce(sum(venta), 0) FROM dia, mes WHERE fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d),
            'venta_siva', (SELECT sum(venta_siva) FROM util, mes WHERE fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d),
            'venta_con_costo', CASE WHEN (SELECT hay FROM cadj) THEN (SELECT sum(venta_siva) FROM util, mes WHERE fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d) ELSE (SELECT sum(venta_con_costo) FROM util, mes WHERE fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d) END,
            'costo', CASE WHEN (SELECT hay FROM cadj) THEN (SELECT costo FROM cadj) ELSE (SELECT sum(costo) FROM util, mes WHERE fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d) END,
            'cobranza', (SELECT coalesce(sum(abs(total)), 0) FROM ms_ventas_v v, mes WHERE v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'P'
                           AND NOT v.cancelado AND v.fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d),
            'gastos_caja', (SELECT coalesce(sum(abs(total)), 0) FROM ms_ventas_v v, mes WHERE v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'R'
                           AND NOT v.cancelado AND v.fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d),
            'credito_otorgado', (SELECT coalesce(sum(t), 0) FROM (
                SELECT (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.datos->'IMPORTE') = 'number' THEN (c.datos->>'IMPORTE')::numeric ELSE 0 END) AS t
                FROM ms_raw c JOIN ms_ventas_v p ON p.base = c.base AND p.origen = 'PV' AND p.docto_id::text = c.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID'
                JOIN ms_raw fc ON fc.base = c.base AND fc.tabla = 'FORMAS_COBRO' AND fc.pk = c.datos->>'FORMA_COBRO_ID'
                WHERE c.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS' AND upper(p.tipo) = 'V' AND NOT p.cancelado AND p.fecha BETWEEN (SELECT ini FROM mes) AND cfg.d
                  AND fc.datos->>'NOMBRE' ~* '^\s*cr[eé]dito' AND upper(coalesce(c.datos->>'TIPO', 'C')) <> 'A') z),
            'primer_dato', (SELECT to_char(min(fecha), 'DD/MM') FROM dia, mes WHERE fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d),
            'hab_transcurridos', (SELECT transcurridos FROM hab), 'hab_totales', (SELECT totales FROM hab),
            'semanas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(s ORDER BY s.ini), '[]'::json) FROM (
                SELECT to_char(greatest(date_trunc('week', fecha)::date, mes.ini), 'DD/MM') AS ini,
                       min(greatest(date_trunc('week', fecha)::date, mes.ini)) AS ord, sum(venta) AS venta
                FROM dia, mes WHERE fecha BETWEEN mes.ini AND cfg.d GROUP BY 1) s)
          ) FROM cfg),
  'pend', (SELECT json_build_object(
      'ped', (SELECT json_build_object('b0', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias <= 2), 'b1', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias BETWEEN 3 AND 5),
                'b2', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias BETWEEN 6 AND 10), 'b3', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias BETWEEN 11 AND 30),
                'hist', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias > 30), 't_hist', coalesce(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE dias > 30), 0),
                't_activo', coalesce(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE dias <= 30), 0)) FROM pend WHERE tipo = 'P'),
      'rem', (SELECT json_build_object('b0', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias <= 2), 'b1', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias BETWEEN 3 AND 5),
                'b2', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias BETWEEN 6 AND 10), 'b3', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias BETWEEN 11 AND 30),
                'hist', count(*) FILTER (WHERE dias > 30)) FROM pend WHERE tipo = 'R'),
      'ped_atorado', (SELECT json_build_object('folio', folio, 'cliente', cliente, 'dias', dias, 'total', total) FROM pend
                      WHERE tipo = 'P' AND dias BETWEEN 6 AND 30 ORDER BY dias DESC, total DESC LIMIT 1),
      'rem_atorada', (SELECT json_build_object('folio', folio, 'cliente', cliente, 'dias', dias, 'total', total) FROM pend
                      WHERE tipo = 'R' AND dias BETWEEN 3 AND 30 ORDER BY dias DESC LIMIT 1))),
  'clientes', (SELECT json_build_object(
      'mes', count(DISTINCT lower(trim(vt.cliente))) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d),
      'mes_ant', count(DISTINCT lower(trim(vt.cliente))) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date
                                                                AND (cfg.d - interval '1 month')::date))
      FROM vt, cfg WHERE coalesce(trim(vt.cliente), '') <> '' AND vt.cliente !~* '(p[uú]blico|mostrador|general)'),
  'lineas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.dif), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT coalesce(nullif(a.linea, ''), 'Sin línea') AS linea,
             coalesce(sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d), 0) AS actual,
             coalesce(sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date
                                                AND (cfg.d - interval '1 month')::date), 0) AS anterior,
             coalesce(sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d), 0)
           - coalesce(sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date
                                                AND (cfg.d - interval '1 month')::date), 0) AS dif
      FROM vt JOIN cfg ON true
      JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id
      LEFT JOIN ms_articulos a ON a.base = d.base AND a.articulo_id = d.articulo_id
      GROUP BY 1 HAVING coalesce(sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date
                                                AND (cfg.d - interval '1 month')::date), 0) > 0
      ORDER BY dif LIMIT 3) x),
  'hist_mes_ant', (SELECT (SELECT min(fecha) FROM dia) <= (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date + 2 FROM cfg),
  'meta', (SELECT json_build_object('mensual', meta_mensual, 'semanal', meta_semanal) FROM ms_metas, cfg WHERE mes = to_char(cfg.d, 'YYYY-MM')),
  'semana', (SELECT json_build_object('ini', to_char(date_trunc('week', cfg.d), 'DD/MM'), 'venta', coalesce(sum(venta), 0),
             'hab_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(date_trunc('week', cfg.d), date_trunc('week', cfg.d) + interval '6 day', interval '1 day') g WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) <= cfg.dsem))
             FROM cfg LEFT JOIN dia ON dia.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('week', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d GROUP BY cfg.d, cfg.dsem),
  'lineas_hoy', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.hoy DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT coalesce(nullif(a.linea, ''), 'Sin línea') AS linea,
             sum(vt.sg * abs(d.importe)) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha = cfg.d) AS hoy,
             sum(vt.sg * abs(d.importe)) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d) AS mes,
             sum(vt.sg * abs(d.importe)) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha BETWEEN (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date
                                                  AND (cfg.d - interval '1 month')::date) AS mes_ant
      FROM vt JOIN cfg ON vt.fecha >= (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date
      JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id
      LEFT JOIN ms_articulos a ON a.base = d.base AND a.articulo_id = d.articulo_id
      GROUP BY 1 HAVING coalesce(sum(vt.sg * abs(d.importe)) FILTER (WHERE vt.fecha = cfg.d), 0) > 0) x),
  'lineas_total_mes', (SELECT sum(vt.sg * abs(d.importe)) FROM vt JOIN cfg ON vt.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d
      JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id),
  'validacion', (SELECT json_build_object(
      'pv_y_rem', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT a.folio AS ticket, b.folio AS remision, a.cliente, a.total FROM ms_ventas_v a, ms_ventas_v b, cfg
          WHERE a.fecha = cfg.d AND b.fecha = cfg.d AND a.origen = 'PV' AND upper(a.tipo) = 'V' AND NOT a.cancelado
            AND b.origen = 'VE' AND b.tipo = 'R' AND NOT b.cancelado AND abs(a.total - b.total) <= 1
            AND lower(trim(a.cliente)) = lower(trim(b.cliente)) AND a.cliente !~* '(p[uú]blico|mostrador|general)' LIMIT 5) x),
      'rem_dobles', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT min(folio) AS f1, max(folio) AS f2, cliente, total FROM ms_ventas_v, cfg
          WHERE fecha = cfg.d AND origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'R' AND NOT cancelado
          GROUP BY lower(trim(cliente)), cliente, total HAVING count(*) > 1 LIMIT 5) x),
      'pv_dobles', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT a.folio AS f1, b.folio AS f2, a.cliente, a.total FROM ms_ventas_v a JOIN ms_ventas_v b
            ON a.base = b.base AND a.origen = 'PV' AND b.origen = 'PV' AND a.docto_id < b.docto_id AND a.fecha = b.fecha
           AND upper(a.tipo) = 'V' AND upper(b.tipo) = 'V' AND NOT a.cancelado AND NOT b.cancelado AND a.total = b.total
           AND lower(trim(a.cliente)) = lower(trim(b.cliente)) AND a.cliente !~* '(p[uú]blico|mostrador|general)'
           AND a.hora ~ '^\d' AND b.hora ~ '^\d' AND abs(extract(epoch FROM b.hora::time - a.hora::time)) <= 600
          JOIN cfg ON a.fecha = cfg.d LIMIT 5) x),
      'fac_directas', (SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 't', coalesce(sum(f.total), 0)) FROM ms_ventas_v f, cfg
          WHERE f.fecha = cfg.d AND f.origen = 'VE' AND f.tipo = 'F' AND NOT f.cancelado AND f.total <= cfg.maxm
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_ventas_v r WHERE r.base = f.base AND r.origen = 'VE' AND r.tipo = 'R' AND NOT r.cancelado
                              AND lower(trim(r.cliente)) = lower(trim(f.cliente)) AND r.fecha BETWEEN f.fecha - 45 AND f.fecha)
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_ventas_v t WHERE t.base = f.base AND t.origen = 'PV' AND upper(t.tipo) = 'V' AND NOT t.cancelado
                              AND lower(trim(t.cliente)) = lower(trim(f.cliente)) AND t.fecha BETWEEN f.fecha - 45 AND f.fecha)))),
  'inv', (SELECT json_build_object(
      'valor', (SELECT coalesce(sum(valor), 0) FROM ms_existencias WHERE NOT {{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.ocultar_existencia_negativa === true ? 'true' : 'false' }} OR existencia > 0),
      'negativos', CASE WHEN {{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.ocultar_existencia_negativa === true ? 'true' : 'false' }} THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM ms_existencias WHERE existencia < 0) END,
      'costo_30d', (SELECT sum(costo) FROM util, cfg WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.d - 30 AND cfg.d - 1),
      'dias_venta_30d', (SELECT count(*) FROM util, cfg WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.d - 30 AND cfg.d - 1 AND venta_siva > 0)))
) AS k;

WITH ms_ventas_v AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas_v WHERE NULLIF($11::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $11::text),
ms_ventas_det AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas_det WHERE NULLIF($11::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $11::text),
ms_clientes AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_clientes WHERE NULLIF($11::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $11::text),
ms_articulos AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_articulos WHERE NULLIF($11::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $11::text),
cfg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF($10, '')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date) AS d,
         (date_trunc('month', COALESCE(NULLIF($10, '')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date)) - make_interval(months => greatest($1::int, 3) - 1))::date AS ini,
         $2::numeric AS meta, $3::text AS patron, $4::numeric AS kg_def, $5::numeric AS maxm, ($6::text = 'true') AS mortero_en_meta,
         $7::int AS dias_hab, $8::text AS reventa, $9::numeric AS pedido_grande),
art AS (
  SELECT a.base, a.articulo_id, a.clave, a.nombre,
         CASE WHEN a.nombre ~* 'mortero' THEN 'Mortero' WHEN a.nombre ~* 'blanco' THEN 'Cemento blanco' ELSE 'Cemento gris' END AS tipo,
         CASE WHEN a.nombre ~* '[0-9] *(kg|kilo)' THEN substring(a.nombre FROM '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?) *[Kk]')::numeric
              WHEN a.nombre ~* '(tonelada|granel| ton)' THEN 1000 ELSE (SELECT kg_def FROM cfg) END AS kg
  FROM ms_articulos a, cfg
  WHERE (coalesce(a.nombre, '') || ' ' || coalesce(a.linea, '') || ' ' || coalesce(a.grupo, '')) ~* cfg.patron),
costo AS (
  SELECT a.base, a.articulo_id,
         coalesce(m.costo, CASE WHEN a.costo_ultimo > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND a.costo_ultimo > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN a.costo_ultimo END) AS cu
  FROM ms_articulos a LEFT JOIN ms_costos_manual m ON m.base = a.base AND m.articulo_id = a.articulo_id),
vt AS (
  SELECT v.base, v.origen, v.docto_id, v.fecha, v.cliente, v.cliente_id, CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS sg
  FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
  WHERE NOT v.cancelado AND abs(v.total) <= cfg.maxm AND v.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.d
    AND ((v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) IN ('V', 'D')) OR (v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo = 'F' AND (NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.almacenes_facturas || '' }}', '') IS NULL OR upper(trim(coalesce(v.almacen,''))) IN (SELECT upper(trim(x)) FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.almacenes_facturas || '' }}', ',')) x))))),
lin0 AS (
  SELECT vt.base, vt.origen, vt.docto_id, vt.fecha, date_trunc('month', vt.fecha)::date AS mes,
         CASE WHEN coalesce(vt.cliente, '') ~* 'publico|público|mostrador|general|contado|varios' OR vt.cliente_id IS NULL
              THEN '(público general)' ELSE vt.cliente END AS cliente, vt.cliente_id, coalesce(k.tipo_cliente, '') AS tipo_cliente,
         art.articulo_id, art.clave, art.nombre, art.tipo, art.kg,
         vt.sg * abs(d.unidades) AS unidades, vt.sg * abs(d.unidades) * art.kg / 1000.0 AS ton, vt.sg * abs(d.importe) AS venta,
         CASE WHEN c.cu > 0 THEN vt.sg * abs(d.unidades) * c.cu END AS costo
  FROM vt JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id
  JOIN art ON art.base = d.base AND art.articulo_id = d.articulo_id
  LEFT JOIN costo c ON c.base = d.base AND c.articulo_id = d.articulo_id
  LEFT JOIN ms_clientes k ON k.base = vt.base AND k.cliente_id = vt.cliente_id),
lm AS (
  SELECT l.*, (l.tipo <> 'Mortero' OR cfg.mortero_en_meta) AS en_meta,
         CASE WHEN l.cliente <> '(público general)' AND cfg.reventa <> '' AND l.tipo_cliente ~* cfg.reventa THEN 'Reventa' ELSE 'Público' END AS segmento,
         CASE WHEN l.kg < 40 THEN 'Chico (≤25 kg)' ELSE 'Grande (50 kg o más)' END AS presentacion
  FROM lin0 l, cfg),
doc AS (SELECT base, origen, docto_id, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) AS ton FROM lm GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
mes AS (
  SELECT m.mes, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) AS ton_meta, sum(ton) AS ton_total,
         sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Público') AS ton_publico, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Reventa') AS ton_reventa,
         sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND kg < 40) AS ton_chico, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND kg >= 40) AS ton_grande,
         sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Mortero') AS ton_mortero, sum(unidades) AS unidades, sum(venta) AS venta,
         sum(venta) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) / NULLIF(sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta), 0) AS precio_ton,
         sum(venta) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Público') / NULLIF(sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Público'), 0) AS precio_ton_publico,
         sum(venta) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Reventa') / NULLIF(sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Reventa'), 0) AS precio_ton_reventa,
         sum(venta) FILTER (WHERE costo IS NOT NULL) AS venta_con_costo, sum(costo) AS costo,
         count(DISTINCT m.cliente_id) FILTER (WHERE m.segmento = 'Reventa') AS clientes_reventa,
         count(DISTINCT m.cliente_id) FILTER (WHERE m.cliente <> '(público general)') AS clientes,
         count(DISTINCT m.docto_id) AS tickets, count(DISTINCT m.fecha) AS dias,
         (SELECT sum(x.ton) FROM doc x WHERE x.ton >= (SELECT pedido_grande FROM cfg)
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lm y WHERE y.base = x.base AND y.origen = x.origen AND y.docto_id = x.docto_id AND y.mes = m.mes)) AS ton_pedidos_grandes
  FROM lm m GROUP BY m.mes),
mes2 AS (
  SELECT m.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(m.mes, (m.mes + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date, interval '1 day') g, cfg
               WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) <= cfg.dias_hab AND g::date <= cfg.d) AS dias_hab,
         (SELECT sum(t) FROM (SELECT sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) AS t FROM lm WHERE lm.mes = m.mes AND cliente <> '(público general)'
                               GROUP BY cliente ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3) z) / NULLIF(m.ton_meta, 0) AS top3
  FROM mes m),
rol AS (
  SELECT mes, avg(ton_meta) OVER (ORDER BY mes ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prom3,
         count(*) OVER (ORDER BY mes ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM mes, cfg WHERE mes < date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date),
ref AS (SELECT (mes - interval '2 months')::date AS ini, mes AS fin, prom3 FROM rol WHERE n = 3 ORDER BY prom3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1),
ult AS (SELECT (date_trunc('month', d) - interval '3 months')::date AS ini, (date_trunc('month', d) - interval '1 month')::date AS fin FROM cfg),
compras AS (   -- días distintos de compra por cliente (para calcular cada cuánto compra)
  SELECT cliente, cliente_id, fecha, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) AS ton FROM lm WHERE cliente <> '(público general)' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
frec AS (
  SELECT cliente, count(*) AS compras, (max(fecha) - min(fecha))::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) - 1, 0) AS cada_dias
  FROM compras GROUP BY cliente),
cli AS (
  SELECT l.cliente, max(l.cliente_id) AS cliente_id, max(l.segmento) AS segmento, max(l.tipo_cliente) AS tipo_cliente,
         sum(l.ton) FILTER (WHERE l.en_meta AND l.mes BETWEEN (SELECT ini FROM ref) AND (SELECT fin FROM ref)) / 3.0 AS ton_mes_ref,
         sum(l.ton) FILTER (WHERE l.en_meta AND l.mes BETWEEN (SELECT ini FROM ult) AND (SELECT fin FROM ult)) / 3.0 AS ton_mes_ult3,
         sum(l.ton) FILTER (WHERE l.en_meta AND l.mes = date_trunc('month', (SELECT d FROM cfg))::date) AS ton_mes_actual,
         sum(l.ton) FILTER (WHERE l.en_meta) AS ton_periodo, max(l.fecha) AS ultima,
         sum(l.venta) FILTER (WHERE l.en_meta) / NULLIF(sum(l.ton) FILTER (WHERE l.en_meta), 0) AS precio_ton
  FROM lm l GROUP BY l.cliente),
cli2 AS (
  SELECT c.*, f.compras, round(f.cada_dias, 1) AS cada_dias, (SELECT d FROM cfg) - c.ultima AS dias_sin_comprar, k.telefono1,
         coalesce(c.ton_mes_ult3, 0) - coalesce(c.ton_mes_ref, 0) AS cambio,
         (c.cliente <> '(público general)' AND f.compras >= 3 AND f.cada_dias > 0 AND ((SELECT d FROM cfg) - c.ultima) > f.cada_dias * 1.5
            AND ((SELECT d FROM cfg) - c.ultima) <= 120) AS le_toca,
         CASE WHEN c.cliente = '(público general)' THEN 'mostrador'
              WHEN coalesce(c.ton_mes_ref, 0) >= 1 AND coalesce(c.ton_mes_ult3, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(c.ton_mes_actual, 0) = 0 THEN 'perdido'
              WHEN coalesce(c.ton_mes_ref, 0) >= 1 AND coalesce(c.ton_mes_ult3, 0) < c.ton_mes_ref * 0.6 THEN 'bajó mucho'
              WHEN coalesce(c.ton_mes_ref, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(c.ton_mes_ult3, 0) > 0 THEN 'nuevo'
              WHEN coalesce(c.ton_mes_ult3, 0) > coalesce(c.ton_mes_ref, 0) * 1.1 THEN 'creció'
              ELSE 'estable' END AS estado
  FROM cli c LEFT JOIN frec f ON f.cliente = c.cliente
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT telefono1 FROM ms_clientes k WHERE k.cliente_id = c.cliente_id ORDER BY (k.telefono1 <> '') DESC LIMIT 1) k ON true)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'hoy', (SELECT d FROM cfg), 'ini', (SELECT ini FROM cfg), 'meta', (SELECT meta FROM cfg), 'mortero_en_meta', (SELECT mortero_en_meta FROM cfg),
  'primer_dato', (SELECT min(fecha) FROM lm),
  'dias_hab_mes', (SELECT count(*) FROM cfg, generate_series(date_trunc('month', cfg.d), date_trunc('month', cfg.d) + interval '1 month - 1 day', interval '1 day') g
                   WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) <= cfg.dias_hab),
  'dias_hab_transc', (SELECT count(*) FROM cfg, generate_series(date_trunc('month', cfg.d), cfg.d, interval '1 day') g WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) <= cfg.dias_hab),
  'ref', (SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM ref r), 'ult', (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM ult u),
  'articulos_sin_kg', (SELECT count(*) FROM art WHERE nombre !~* '[0-9] *(kg|kilo)' AND nombre !~* '(tonelada|granel| ton)'),
  'con_tipo_reventa', (SELECT count(DISTINCT cliente_id) FROM lm WHERE segmento = 'Reventa'),
  'meses', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(m ORDER BY m.mes), '[]'::json) FROM mes2 m),
  'dias', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.fecha), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT fecha, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) AS ton, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Público') AS publico,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Reventa') AS reventa, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND kg < 40) AS chico,
             sum(unidades) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND kg >= 40) AS bultos50, sum(unidades) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND kg < 40) AS bultos25,
             count(DISTINCT docto_id) AS tickets
      FROM lm, cfg WHERE fecha > cfg.d - 70 GROUP BY fecha) x),
  'semanas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.semana), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT date_trunc('week', fecha)::date AS semana, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) AS ton,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Público') AS publico, sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Reventa') AS reventa,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND kg < 40) AS chico, count(DISTINCT fecha) AS dias
      FROM lm, cfg WHERE fecha > cfg.d - 7 * 30 GROUP BY 1) x),
  'dias_semana', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.n), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT extract(isodow FROM fecha)::int AS n, (ARRAY['Lunes','Martes','Miércoles','Jueves','Viernes','Sábado','Domingo'])[extract(isodow FROM fecha)::int] AS dia,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT fecha), 0) AS ton_por_dia,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Público') / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT fecha), 0) AS publico_por_dia,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Reventa') / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT fecha), 0) AS reventa_por_dia, count(DISTINCT fecha) AS dias
      FROM lm, cfg WHERE fecha > cfg.d - 182 GROUP BY 1) x),
  'quincenas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.orden), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT CASE WHEN extract(day FROM fecha) <= 5 THEN 1 WHEN extract(day FROM fecha) <= 12 THEN 2 WHEN extract(day FROM fecha) <= 17 THEN 3
                  WHEN extract(day FROM fecha) <= 25 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS orden,
             CASE WHEN extract(day FROM fecha) <= 5 THEN 'Días 1 a 5 (inicio de mes)' WHEN extract(day FROM fecha) <= 12 THEN 'Días 6 a 12'
                  WHEN extract(day FROM fecha) <= 17 THEN 'Días 13 a 17 (quincena)' WHEN extract(day FROM fecha) <= 25 THEN 'Días 18 a 25'
                  ELSE 'Días 26 a 31 (fin de mes)' END AS tramo,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT fecha), 0) AS ton_por_dia,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Público') / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT fecha), 0) AS publico_por_dia,
             sum(ton) FILTER (WHERE en_meta AND segmento = 'Reventa') / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT fecha), 0) AS reventa_por_dia, count(DISTINCT fecha) AS dias
      FROM lm GROUP BY 1, 2) x),
  'productos', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.ton DESC NULLS LAST), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT l.clave, l.nombre, l.tipo, max(l.kg) AS kg, sum(l.unidades) AS unidades, sum(l.ton) AS ton, sum(l.venta) AS venta,
             sum(l.venta) / NULLIF(sum(l.unidades), 0) AS precio_unidad, sum(l.venta) / NULLIF(sum(l.ton), 0) AS precio_ton,
             sum(l.costo) / NULLIF(sum(l.unidades) FILTER (WHERE l.costo IS NOT NULL), 0) AS costo_unidad,
             (sum(l.venta) FILTER (WHERE l.costo IS NOT NULL) - sum(l.costo)) / NULLIF(sum(l.venta) FILTER (WHERE l.costo IS NOT NULL), 0) AS margen,
             sum(l.ton) FILTER (WHERE l.segmento = 'Público') / NULLIF(sum(l.ton), 0) AS pct_publico,
             sum(l.ton) FILTER (WHERE l.mes BETWEEN (SELECT ini FROM ult) AND (SELECT fin FROM ult)) / 3.0 AS ton_mes_ult3
      FROM lm l GROUP BY l.clave, l.nombre, l.tipo) x),
  'clientes', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.cambio, x.ton_periodo DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM cli2 WHERE coalesce(ton_periodo, 0) > 0.05) x)
) AS r;

const p = $('Panel · Leer comando').first().json;
const SQL = {
  ultima: "WITH ahora AS (SELECT now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City' AS t),
u AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.base, v.caja_id) v.base, v.caja_id, v.docto_id, v.folio, to_char(v.fecha, 'DD/MM') AS fecha, v.fecha AS f,
         left(v.hora, 5) AS hora, v.total, trim(v.almacen) AS almacen,
         coalesce(cj.datos->>'NOMBRE', 'Caja ' || v.caja_id::text, trim(v.almacen)) AS caja, ce.datos->>'NOMBRE' AS cajero,
         v.fecha + CASE WHEN v.hora ~ '^[0-9]' THEN v.hora::time ELSE time '00:00' END AS ts
  FROM ms_ventas_v v
  LEFT JOIN ms_raw cj ON cj.base = v.base AND cj.tabla = 'CAJAS' AND cj.pk = v.caja_id::text
  LEFT JOIN ms_raw ce ON ce.base = v.base AND ce.tabla = 'CAJEROS' AND ce.pk = v.cajero_id::text
  WHERE v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'V' AND NOT v.cancelado AND coalesce(v.total, 0) <> 0 AND v.fecha >= current_date - 7
  ORDER BY v.base, v.caja_id, v.fecha DESC, v.hora DESC, v.docto_id DESC)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'filas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.ts DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT u.*, round(extract(epoch FROM (SELECT t FROM ahora) - u.ts) / 60) AS minutos,
            u.f = (SELECT t::date FROM ahora) AS es_hoy,
            (SELECT string_agg(rtrim(rtrim(d.unidades::text, '0'), '.') || ' ' || d.articulo, ', ')
               FROM ms_ventas_det d WHERE d.base = u.base AND d.origen = 'PV' AND d.docto_id = u.docto_id) AS articulos
     FROM u WHERE $1 = '' OR u.caja ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR u.almacen ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%') x),
  'copia', (SELECT to_char(max(actualizado) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI') FROM ms_ventas WHERE origen = 'PV')
) AS r;",
  hoy: "WITH hoy AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS d),

  'pv_t', (SELECT coalesce(sum(total), 0) FROM v WHERE origen = 'PV' AND upper(tipo) = 'V'),
  'ped_n', (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'P'),

  'rem_t', (SELECT coalesce(sum(total), 0) FROM v WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'R' AND total <= 500000),
  'fac_n', (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'F'),
  'fac_t', (SELECT coalesce(sum(total), 0) FROM v WHERE origen = 'VE' AND tipo = 'F' AND total <= 500000),
  'cxc_n', (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE origen = 'PV' AND upper(tipo) = 'P'),

  cajas: "SELECT json_build_object('tablas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.tabla), '[]'::json) FROM (

  corte: "WITH hoy AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS d),
mc AS (SELECT m.* FROM ms_raw m, hoy WHERE m.tabla = 'MOVTOS_CAJAS' AND m.fecha = hoy.d),
pv AS (SELECT v.* FROM ms_ventas v, hoy WHERE v.origen = 'PV' AND v.fecha = hoy.d),
cob AS (SELECT c.*, upper(p.tipo) AS tipo_doc FROM ms_raw c JOIN pv p ON p.base = c.base AND p.docto_id::text = c.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID'

  meta: "WITH cfg AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS d, 6 AS dsem, 500000::numeric AS maxm),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO ms_metas (mes, meta_mensual, meta_semanal, por, actualizado)
  SELECT to_char(cfg.d, 'YYYY-MM'), nullif(split_part($1, '|', 1), '')::numeric, nullif(split_part($1, '|', 2), '')::numeric,
         split_part($1, '|', 3), now()
  FROM cfg WHERE split_part($1, '|', 4) = 'set'
  ON CONFLICT (mes) DO UPDATE SET meta_mensual = coalesce(EXCLUDED.meta_mensual, ms_metas.meta_mensual),
     meta_semanal = coalesce(EXCLUDED.meta_semanal, ms_metas.meta_semanal), por = EXCLUDED.por, actualizado = now()
  RETURNING meta_mensual, meta_semanal),
met AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT meta_mensual FROM up), (SELECT meta_mensual FROM ms_metas, cfg WHERE mes = to_char(cfg.d, 'YYYY-MM'))) AS mm,
               coalesce((SELECT meta_semanal FROM up), (SELECT meta_semanal FROM ms_metas, cfg WHERE mes = to_char(cfg.d, 'YYYY-MM'))) AS ms),
vt0 AS (SELECT v.base, v.origen, v.docto_id, v.fecha, CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS sg,
              CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -abs(v.total) ELSE v.total END AS total FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
       WHERE NOT v.cancelado AND abs(v.total) <= cfg.maxm AND v.fecha >= (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date
         AND ((v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) IN ('V', 'D')) OR (v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo = 'F' AND (NULLIF($3::text, '') IS NULL OR upper(trim(coalesce(v.almacen,''))) IN (SELECT upper(trim(x)) FROM unnest(string_to_array($3::text, ',')) x))))),
vt AS (SELECT vt0.* FROM vt0, cfg WHERE vt0.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d),
hab AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE g::date <= cfg.d) AS trans, count(*) AS tot,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE g::date > cfg.d) AS rest
        FROM cfg, generate_series(date_trunc('month', cfg.d), date_trunc('month', cfg.d) + interval '1 month - 1 day', interval '1 day') g
        WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) <= cfg.dsem),
habsem AS (SELECT count(*) AS tot FROM cfg, generate_series(date_trunc('week', cfg.d), date_trunc('week', cfg.d) + interval '6 day', interval '1 day') g
           WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) <= cfg.dsem)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'guardado', (SELECT count(*) > 0 FROM up),
  'mes_nombre', (SELECT extract(month FROM d)::int FROM cfg),
  'fecha', (SELECT to_char(d, 'DD/MM') FROM cfg),
  'copia', (SELECT to_char(max(actualizado) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH24:MI') FROM ms_ventas WHERE origen = 'PV'),
  'meta_mes', (SELECT mm FROM met), 'meta_sem', (SELECT ms FROM met),
  'venta_mes', (SELECT coalesce(sum(total), 0) FROM vt),
  'venta_hoy', (SELECT coalesce(sum(total), 0) FROM vt, cfg WHERE fecha = cfg.d),
  'venta_sem', (SELECT coalesce(sum(total), 0) FROM vt, cfg WHERE fecha >= date_trunc('week', cfg.d)::date),
  'ini_sem', (SELECT to_char(greatest(date_trunc('week', d), date_trunc('month', d)), 'DD/MM') FROM cfg),
  'hab_trans', (SELECT trans FROM hab), 'hab_tot', (SELECT tot FROM hab), 'hab_rest', (SELECT rest FROM hab),
  'hab_sem', (SELECT tot FROM habsem),
  'lineas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.t DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT coalesce(nullif(a.linea, ''), 'Sin línea') AS linea,
             sum(vt0.sg * abs(d.importe)) FILTER (WHERE vt0.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d) AS t,
             sum(vt0.sg * abs(d.importe)) FILTER (WHERE vt0.fecha BETWEEN (date_trunc('month', cfg.d) - interval '1 month')::date
                                                  AND (cfg.d - interval '1 month')::date) AS ant
      FROM vt0 JOIN cfg ON true JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt0.base AND d.origen = vt0.origen AND d.docto_id = vt0.docto_id
      LEFT JOIN ms_articulos a ON a.base = d.base AND a.articulo_id = d.articulo_id
      GROUP BY 1 HAVING coalesce(sum(vt0.sg * abs(d.importe)) FILTER (WHERE vt0.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d), 0) > 0
      ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) x),
  'lineas_total', (SELECT sum(vt.sg * abs(d.importe)) FROM vt JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id),
  'hist_mes_ant', (SELECT min(fecha) <= (date_trunc('month', (SELECT d FROM cfg)) - interval '1 month')::date + 2 FROM vt0),
  'q', $1::text) AS r;
",

  margen: "WITH cfg AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS d),
vt AS (SELECT v.base, v.origen, v.docto_id FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
       WHERE NOT v.cancelado AND v.total <= 500000 AND v.fecha BETWEEN date_trunc('month', cfg.d)::date AND cfg.d
         AND ((v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'V') OR (v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo = 'F' AND (NULLIF($3::text, '') IS NULL OR upper(trim(coalesce(v.almacen,''))) IN (SELECT upper(trim(x)) FROM unnest(string_to_array($3::text, ',')) x))))),
costo AS (  -- costo por artículo: 1) el que pusiste en Telegram, 2) último costo de compra, 3) costo promedio de Microsip
  SELECT a.base, a.articulo_id,
         coalesce(m.costo,
                  CASE WHEN a.costo_ultimo > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND a.costo_ultimo > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN a.costo_ultimo END,
                  CASE WHEN c0.cu0 > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND c0.cu0 > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN c0.cu0 END) AS cu,
         CASE WHEN m.costo IS NOT NULL THEN 'manual'
              WHEN a.costo_ultimo > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND a.costo_ultimo > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN 'ultima compra'
              WHEN c0.cu0 > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND c0.cu0 > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN 'promedio' END AS fuente
  FROM ms_articulos a
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT base, articulo_id, sum(valor) / NULLIF(sum(existencia), 0) AS cu0 FROM ms_existencias
             WHERE existencia > 0 AND valor > 0 GROUP BY base, articulo_id) c0 ON c0.base = a.base AND c0.articulo_id = a.articulo_id
  LEFT JOIN ms_costos_manual m ON m.base = a.base AND m.articulo_id = a.articulo_id),
art AS (SELECT d.base, d.articulo_id, max(d.articulo) AS articulo, sum(abs(d.unidades)) AS u, sum(abs(d.importe)) AS venta
        FROM vt JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT json_build_object('filas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.venta DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
  SELECT art.articulo, a.clave, art.u, art.venta, round(art.venta / NULLIF(art.u, 0), 2) AS precio_prom, round(c.cu, 2) AS costo_prom, c.fuente,
         a.precio_lista, CASE WHEN c.cu IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE round((1 - c.cu * art.u / NULLIF(art.venta, 0)) * 100, 1) END AS margen
  FROM art LEFT JOIN costo c ON c.base = art.base AND c.articulo_id = art.articulo_id
  LEFT JOIN ms_articulos a ON a.base = art.base AND a.articulo_id = art.articulo_id
  ORDER BY art.venta DESC LIMIT 15) x), 'q', $1::text) AS r;
",
  costo: "WITH q AS (SELECT trim(split_part($1, '|', 1)) AS t, nullif(split_part($1, '|', 2), '')::numeric AS c, split_part($1, '|', 3) AS por),
toks AS (SELECT tk FROM q, unnest(string_to_array(lower(q.t), ' ')) tk WHERE tk <> ''),
cand AS (SELECT a.base, a.articulo_id, a.clave, a.nombre, a.precio_lista, a.costo_ultimo FROM ms_articulos a, q
         WHERE lower(trim(a.clave)) = lower(q.t)
            OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM toks WHERE translate(lower(a.nombre), 'áéíóú', 'aeiou') NOT LIKE '%' || translate(toks.tk, 'áéíóú', 'aeiou') || '%')),
exacta AS (SELECT c.* FROM cand c, q WHERE lower(trim(c.clave)) = lower(q.t)),
pick AS (SELECT * FROM exacta UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cand WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exacta) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM cand) = 1),
up AS (INSERT INTO ms_costos_manual (base, articulo_id, costo, por)
       SELECT p.base, p.articulo_id, q.c, q.por FROM pick p, q WHERE q.c IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pick) = 1
       ON CONFLICT (base, articulo_id) DO UPDATE SET costo = EXCLUDED.costo, por = EXCLUDED.por, actualizado = now()
       RETURNING articulo_id)
SELECT json_build_object('guardado', (SELECT count(*) FROM up) > 0, 'costo', (SELECT c FROM q),
  'pick', (SELECT row_to_json(p) FROM pick p LIMIT 1), 'n', (SELECT count(*) FROM cand),
  'cand', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT clave, nombre FROM cand ORDER BY nombre LIMIT 10) x), 'q', $1::text) AS r;
",
  cobros: "WITH cfg AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS d),
docs AS (SELECT v.* FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg WHERE v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'P' AND NOT v.cancelado AND v.fecha = cfg.d)
SELECT json_build_object('filas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.hora), '[]'::json) FROM (
  SELECT p.folio, left(p.hora, 5) AS hora, p.cliente, abs(p.total) AS total, p.usuario,
    (SELECT string_agg(coalesce(fc.datos->>'NOMBRE', '?'), ' + ') FROM ms_raw c
       LEFT JOIN ms_raw fc ON fc.base = c.base AND fc.tabla = 'FORMAS_COBRO' AND fc.pk = c.datos->>'FORMA_COBRO_ID'
       WHERE c.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS' AND c.base = p.base AND c.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID' = p.docto_id::text
         AND upper(coalesce(c.datos->>'TIPO', 'C')) = 'C') AS formas,
    (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT trim(e.value), ' · ') FROM ms_raw rf
       LEFT JOIN ms_raw c2 ON c2.base = rf.base AND c2.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS' AND c2.pk = rf.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_COBRO_ID'
       CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(rf.datos) e
       WHERE rf.tabla = 'DOCTOS_PV_COBROS_REFER' AND rf.base = p.base
         AND coalesce(c2.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID', rf.datos->>'DOCTO_PV_ID') = p.docto_id::text
         AND e.key !~ '(_ID|FECHA|HORA|USUARIO)' AND length(trim(e.value)) > 1
         AND trim(e.value) ~ '[^0-9.:T -]' AND lower(trim(e.value)) NOT IN ('true', 'false')) AS referencia
  FROM docs p) x), 'q', $1::text) AS r;
",
  pendientes: "WITH cfg AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS d, coalesce(nullif($1, '')::int, -1) AS desde),
pend AS (SELECT v.folio, v.cliente, v.total, v.fecha, cfg.d - v.fecha AS dias FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
         WHERE v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo = 'P' AND v.estatus = 'P' AND v.total <= 500000)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'b0', (SELECT count(*) FROM pend WHERE dias <= 2), 'b1', (SELECT count(*) FROM pend WHERE dias BETWEEN 3 AND 5),
  'b2', (SELECT count(*) FROM pend WHERE dias BETWEEN 6 AND 10), 'b3', (SELECT count(*) FROM pend WHERE dias BETWEEN 11 AND 30),
  'hist', (SELECT count(*) FROM pend WHERE dias > 30), 'total', (SELECT coalesce(sum(total), 0) FROM pend),
  'desde', (SELECT desde FROM cfg),
  'lista', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.dias DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT folio, cliente, total, dias, to_char(fecha, 'DD/MM/YY') AS fecha FROM pend, cfg
      WHERE cfg.desde >= 0 AND dias >= cfg.desde ORDER BY dias DESC LIMIT 40) x)) AS r;
",
  det: "SELECT (SELECT r FROM (
WITH hoy AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('', '')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date) AS d),
v AS (SELECT v.* FROM ms_ventas_v v),
nb AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT base) AS n FROM ms_ventas)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'fecha', (SELECT to_char(d, 'DD/MM/YYYY') FROM hoy),
  'varias_bases', (SELECT n > 1 FROM nb),
  'pv', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.t DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT base, trim(almacen) AS almacen, count(*) AS n, sum(total) AS t
      FROM v, hoy WHERE origen = 'PV' AND upper(tipo) = 'V' AND NOT cancelado AND fecha = hoy.d GROUP BY base, trim(almacen)) x),
  'pv_caja', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.t DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT v.base, coalesce(cj.datos->>'NOMBRE', 'Caja ' || v.caja_id::text, trim(v.almacen)) AS caja, count(*) AS n, sum(v.total) AS t
      FROM v JOIN hoy ON v.fecha = hoy.d
      LEFT JOIN ms_raw cj ON cj.base = v.base AND cj.tabla = 'CAJAS' AND cj.pk = v.caja_id::text
      WHERE v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'V' AND NOT v.cancelado GROUP BY 1, 2) x),
  'mov', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT upper(p.tipo) AS tdoc,
             coalesce(fc.datos->>'NOMBRE', 'Forma ' || (c.datos->>'FORMA_COBRO_ID')) AS forma,
             coalesce(fc.datos->>'NOMBRE', '') ~* 'efectivo' AS efectivo,
             coalesce(fc.datos->>'NOMBRE', '') ~* '^[[:space:]]*cr[eé]dito' AS credito,
             count(DISTINCT p.docto_id) AS n,

  'creditos', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.t DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (

(SELECT k FROM (
WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('', '')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date) AS d,
         500000::numeric AS maxm, 6::int AS dsem),
vt0 AS (   -- venta real: tickets de punto de venta + remisiones (salidas), sin cancelados ni montos anómalos
  SELECT v.base, v.origen, v.docto_id, v.fecha, v.cliente,
         CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS sg,
         CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -abs(v.total) ELSE v.total END AS total
  FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
  WHERE NOT v.cancelado AND abs(v.total) <= cfg.maxm AND v.fecha >= cfg.d - 70
    AND ((v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) IN ('V', 'D')) OR (v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo = 'F' AND (NULLIF($3::text, '') IS NULL OR upper(trim(coalesce(v.almacen,''))) IN (SELECT upper(trim(x)) FROM unnest(string_to_array($3::text, ',')) x))))),
vt AS (SELECT * FROM vt0),
dia AS (SELECT fecha, sum(total) AS venta FROM vt GROUP BY fecha),
costo AS (  -- costo por artículo: 1) el que pusiste en Telegram, 2) último costo de compra, 3) costo promedio de Microsip
  SELECT a.base, a.articulo_id,
         coalesce(m.costo,
                  CASE WHEN a.costo_ultimo > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND a.costo_ultimo > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN a.costo_ultimo END,
                  CASE WHEN c0.cu0 > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND c0.cu0 > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN c0.cu0 END) AS cu,
         CASE WHEN m.costo IS NOT NULL THEN 'manual'
              WHEN a.costo_ultimo > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND a.costo_ultimo > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN 'ultima compra'
              WHEN c0.cu0 > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND c0.cu0 > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN 'promedio' END AS fuente
  FROM ms_articulos a
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT base, articulo_id, sum(valor) / NULLIF(sum(existencia), 0) AS cu0 FROM ms_existencias
             WHERE existencia > 0 AND valor > 0 GROUP BY base, articulo_id) c0 ON c0.base = a.base AND c0.articulo_id = a.articulo_id
  LEFT JOIN ms_costos_manual m ON m.base = a.base AND m.articulo_id = a.articulo_id),
lin AS (  -- renglones con costo promedio actual (utilidad estimada)
  SELECT vt.fecha, vt.sg * abs(d.importe) AS importe,
         CASE WHEN c.cu IS NOT NULL AND abs(d.unidades) * c.cu <= 2 * abs(d.importe) THEN vt.sg * abs(d.unidades) * c.cu END AS costo,
         (c.cu IS NOT NULL AND abs(d.unidades) * c.cu <= 2 * abs(d.importe)) AS con_costo
  FROM vt JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id
  LEFT JOIN costo c ON c.base = d.base AND c.articulo_id = d.articulo_id),
util AS (SELECT fecha, sum(importe) AS venta_siva, sum(importe) FILTER (WHERE con_costo) AS venta_con_costo,

mes AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', d)::date AS ini, (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS fin FROM cfg),
hab AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE g::date <= cfg.d) AS transcurridos, count(*) AS totales
        FROM mes, cfg, generate_series(mes.ini, mes.fin, interval '1 day') g WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) <= cfg.dsem),
pend AS (
  SELECT v.tipo, cfg.d - v.fecha AS dias, v.total, v.folio, v.cliente FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
  WHERE v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo IN ('P', 'R') AND v.estatus = 'P' AND v.total <= cfg.maxm)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'hoy', (SELECT coalesce(venta, 0) FROM dia, cfg WHERE fecha = cfg.d),

(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.existencia), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT articulo, trim(almacen) AS almacen, existencia FROM ms_existencias WHERE existencia < 0 ORDER BY existencia LIMIT 20) x) AS neg,
$1::text AS q;",

SQL.seguimiento = "WITH RECURSIVE q AS (

ligas AS (

baja (base, docto_id, nivel) AS (

sube (base, docto_id, nivel) AS (
  SELECT base, docto_id, 0 FROM doc

  SELECT l.base, l.fte, s.nivel - 1 FROM sube s JOIN ligas l ON l.base = s.base AND l.dst = s.docto_id WHERE s.nivel > -4),
cadena AS (SELECT base, docto_id, min(nivel) AS nivel FROM (SELECT * FROM baja UNION SELECT * FROM sube) z GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT json_build_object(

  'hay_ligas', (SELECT count(*) > 0 FROM ligas),
  'cadena', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('nivel', c.nivel, 'tipo', v.tipo, 'folio', v.folio, 'estatus', v.estatus,
              'cancelado', v.cancelado, 'fecha', to_char(v.fecha, 'DD/MM'), 'hora', left(v.hora, 5), 'total', v.total, 'usuario', v.usuario,

             FROM cadena c JOIN ms_ventas_v v ON v.base = c.base AND v.origen = 'VE' AND v.docto_id = c.docto_id WHERE c.nivel <> 0),
  'posibles', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('tipo', v.tipo, 'folio', v.folio, 'fecha', to_char(v.fecha, 'DD/MM'),
               'hora', left(v.hora, 5), 'total', v.total, 'estatus', v.estatus,
               'articulos', (SELECT string_agg((x.unidades)::float8::text || ' ' || x.articulo, ', ')
                               FROM ms_ventas_det x WHERE x.base = v.base AND x.origen = 'VE' AND x.docto_id = v.docto_id)) ORDER BY v.fecha), '[]'::json)
               FROM doc d JOIN ms_ventas_v v ON v.base = d.base AND v.origen = 'VE' AND NOT v.cancelado
                AND d.tipo = 'P' AND v.tipo IN ('R', 'F') AND lower(trim(v.cliente)) = lower(trim(d.cliente))
                AND v.fecha BETWEEN d.fecha AND d.fecha + 15 AND abs(v.total - d.total) <= greatest(1, d.total * 0.02)),
  'surtido', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('articulo', z.articulo, 'pedido', z.pedido, 'remisionado', z.remisionado) ORDER BY z.articulo), '[]'::json)
      FROM (SELECT coalesce(pd.articulo, rd.articulo) AS articulo, coalesce(pd.u, 0) AS pedido, coalesce(rd.u, 0) AS remisionado
            FROM (SELECT x.articulo_id, max(x.articulo) AS articulo, sum(x.unidades) AS u

            FULL JOIN (SELECT x.articulo_id, max(x.articulo) AS articulo, sum(x.unidades) AS u

                   AND v.tipo = 'R' AND NOT v.cancelado AND c.nivel > 0

              ON rd.articulo_id = pd.articulo_id) z

SQL.existencia = "WITH q AS (SELECT array_remove(string_to_array(translate(lower(trim($1)), 'áéíóúü', 'aeiouu'), ' '), '') AS toks, upper(trim($1)) AS raw),

e AS (SELECT e.base, e.articulo_id, sum(e.existencia) AS total,

function splitStmts(s){const out=[];let cur='',q=false,i=0;while(i<s.length){const c=s[i];if(!q&&s.startsWith('--',i)){let j=s.indexOf('
',i);if(j<0)j=s.length;cur+=s.slice(i,j);i=j;continue}
if(!q&&s.startsWith('$$',i)){const j=s.indexOf('$$',i+2);cur+=s.slice(i,j+2);i=j+2;continue}
if(c==="'"){if(q&&s[i+1]==="'"){cur+="''";i+=2;continue}q=!q}
if(!q&&c===';'){out.push(cur+';');cur='';i++;continue}cur+=c;i++}
if(cur.trim())out.push(cur);return out}
function shadowSql(sql,B){const TABS=['ms_ventas_v','ms_ventas_det','ms_ventas','ms_existencias','ms_clientes','ms_articulos','ms_raw'];
return splitStmts(sql).map(st=>{let t=st;for(;;){t=t.replace(/^\s+/,'');if(t.startsWith('--')){const j=t.indexOf('
');t=j<0?'':t.slice(j+1)}else break}
const used=TABS.filter(x=>new RegExp('\b'+x+'\b').test(st));if(!used.length)return st;const u=t.toUpperCase();
if(u.startsWith('WITH RECURSIVE')||/^(SET|CREATE|ALTER|DROP) /.test(u))return st;
const sh=used.map(x=>x+" AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM "+x+" WHERE NULLIF("+B+", '') IS NULL OR base = "+B+")").join(',
');
const idx=st.indexOf(t);return u.startsWith('WITH')?st.slice(0,idx)+'WITH '+sh+',
'+t.slice(4).replace(/^\s+/,''):st.slice(0,idx)+'WITH '+sh+'
'+t})
.join('')}

-- Pedidos con tinacos (o cisternas, tambos…) pendientes de surtir con más días de los permitidos
WITH ms_ventas_v AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas_v WHERE NULLIF($5::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $5::text),
ms_ventas_det AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas_det WHERE NULLIF($5::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $5::text),
cfg AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF($1, '')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date) AS d,
                    greatest($2::int, 1) AS lim, $3::text AS pat, $4::numeric AS maxm)
SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 't', coalesce(sum(x.total), 0), 'lim', (SELECT lim FROM cfg),
       'lista', coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.dias DESC, x.total DESC), '[]'::json)) AS r
FROM (
  SELECT v.folio, v.cliente, round(v.total) AS total, to_char(v.fecha, 'DD/MM') AS fecha, (cfg.d - v.fecha) AS dias,
         (SELECT string_agg(rtrim(rtrim(d.unidades::text, '0'), '.') || ' ' || d.articulo, ', ')
            FROM ms_ventas_det d WHERE d.base = v.base AND d.origen = v.origen AND d.docto_id = v.docto_id AND d.articulo ~* cfg.pat) AS tinacos
  FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
  WHERE v.origen = 'VE' AND v.tipo = 'P' AND v.estatus = 'P' AND NOT v.cancelado AND v.total <= cfg.maxm
    AND v.fecha <= cfg.d AND cfg.d - v.fecha > cfg.lim
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_ventas_det d WHERE d.base = v.base AND d.origen = v.origen AND d.docto_id = v.docto_id AND d.articulo ~* cfg.pat)
) x;
