SET LOCAL jit = off;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '40s';
WITH cfg AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT nullif(valor, '') FROM pp_config WHERE clave = 'base'), 'LOMAS AJUSCO') AS base,
                    (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS hoy,
                    coalesce((SELECT nullif(valor, '')::date FROM pp_config WHERE clave = 'desde'), date '2026-05-01') AS desde,
                    coalesce((SELECT nullif(valor, '')::numeric FROM pp_config WHERE clave = 'abono_semanal'), 8000) AS abono,
                    $1::jsonb AS p, $2::text AS por),
prov AS (SELECT p.proveedor_id, p.dias, p.rebate, p.pagado_hasta, coalesce(nullif(pr.datos->>'NOMBRE', ''), p.nombre, p.proveedor_id) AS nombre
         FROM pp_proveedor p CROSS JOIN cfg LEFT JOIN ms_raw pr ON pr.base = cfg.base AND pr.tabla = 'PROVEEDORES' AND pr.pk = p.proveedor_id
         WHERE p.base = cfg.base AND p.seguir),
-- si Microsip trae dos documentos con el mismo folio (se borró y se volvió a capturar), solo cuenta el más nuevo
cm0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'TIPO_DOCTO', '')), coalesce(r.datos->>'FOLIO', ''), r.datos->>'PROVEEDOR_ID') r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID' AS id, upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'TIPO_DOCTO', '')) AS tipo, coalesce(r.datos->>'FOLIO', '') AS folio,
               coalesce(r.fecha, left(r.datos->>'FECHA', 10)::date) AS fecha, r.datos->>'PROVEEDOR_ID' AS prov,
               CASE WHEN (r.datos->>'IMPORTE_NETO') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\Z' THEN (r.datos->>'IMPORTE_NETO')::numeric ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (r.datos->>'TOTAL_IMPUESTOS') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\Z' THEN (r.datos->>'TOTAL_IMPUESTOS')::numeric ELSE 0 END AS total, r.datos
        FROM ms_raw r, cfg
        WHERE r.base = cfg.base AND r.tabla = 'DOCTOS_CM' AND upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'TIPO_DOCTO', '')) IN ('R', 'C')
          AND upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'ESTATUS', '')) <> 'C' AND upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'CANCELADO', 'N')) NOT IN ('S', 'SI', 'Y', 'T', '1', 'TRUE')
          AND r.datos->>'PROVEEDOR_ID' IN (SELECT proveedor_id FROM prov)
          AND coalesce(r.fecha, left(r.datos->>'FECHA', 10)::date) >= cfg.desde - 60
        ORDER BY upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'TIPO_DOCTO', '')), coalesce(r.datos->>'FOLIO', ''), r.datos->>'PROVEEDOR_ID', CASE WHEN (r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}\Z' THEN (r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID')::bigint END DESC NULLS LAST),
cml AS (SELECT DISTINCT z.fte, z.dest FROM (SELECT coalesce(r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_FTE_ID', r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID_FTE', r.datos->>'DOCTO_FTE_ID') AS fte,
                 coalesce(r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_DEST_ID', r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID_DEST', r.datos->>'DOCTO_DEST_ID') AS dest
               FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.base = cfg.base AND r.tabla = 'DOCTOS_CM_LIGAS') z WHERE z.dest IN (SELECT id FROM cm0 WHERE tipo = 'C')),
md AS (SELECT c.* FROM cm0 c WHERE NOT (c.tipo = 'R' AND c.id IN (SELECT fte FROM cml WHERE fte IS NOT NULL))),
-- desde cuándo corre el crédito: la fecha de la remisión del proveedor (si ya se subió) o el día que se recibió (no el día que se pasó a compra)
fb0 AS (SELECT m.id, least(m.fecha, (SELECT min(c.fecha) FROM cml l JOIN cm0 c ON c.id = l.fte WHERE l.dest = m.id)) AS frec,
               (SELECT string_agg(c.folio, ', ' ORDER BY c.folio) FROM cml l JOIN cm0 c ON c.id = l.fte WHERE l.dest = m.id) AS rfolio
        FROM md m),
-- la fecha de la remisión solo cuenta si tiene sentido (hasta 45 días antes de recibir); si la IA leyó mal el año, se usa el día que se recibió
fb AS (SELECT f.*, (SELECT min(x.fecha_remision) FROM pp_remision x CROSS JOIN cfg WHERE x.base = cfg.base AND NOT x.borrado AND x.fecha_remision IS NOT NULL
                       AND x.fecha_remision BETWEEN f.frec - 45 AND f.frec + 3
                       AND (x.docto_id = f.id OR x.docto_id IN (SELECT l.fte FROM cml l WHERE l.dest = f.id))) AS frem
       FROM fb0 f),
ed AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.proveedor_id, d.folio_n) d.* FROM pp_estado_doc d JOIN pp_estado e ON e.id = d.estado_id CROSS JOIN cfg
       WHERE e.base = cfg.base AND NOT e.borrado AND d.proveedor_id IN (SELECT proveedor_id FROM prov) AND coalesce(d.folio_n, '') <> ''
       ORDER BY d.proveedor_id, d.folio_n, d.estado_id DESC),
mnum AS (SELECT m.id, array_agg(DISTINCT ltrim(t.tok[1], '0')) AS nums
         FROM md m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(m.datos) v CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_matches(v.value, '([0-9]{3,20})', 'g') AS t(tok)
         WHERE m.prov IN (SELECT proveedor_id FROM ed)
           AND v.key !~* '(FECHA|HORA|IMPORTE|TOTAL|PRECIO|DSCTO|DESCUENTO|IMPUESTO|CAMBIO|PESO|CARGO|_ID\Z|^ID\Z)'
         GROUP BY 1),
-- números de cada nota del estado que pueden venir en Microsip: folio, remisión y pedido (el pedido solo si no se repite en otra nota)
enum AS (SELECT e.id, array_remove(ARRAY[e.folio_n, nullif(e.remision, ''), CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.proveedor_id, e.pedido) = 1 THEN nullif(e.pedido, '') END], NULL) AS nums FROM ed e),
-- kilos de material de cada nota (CEMEX factura en toneladas y Microsip recibe bultos: se comparan kilos)
ekg0 AS (SELECT d.id, CASE WHEN upper(l->>'descripcion') ~ 'MORTERO' THEN 'mortero' WHEN upper(l->>'descripcion') ~ '(CEMENTO|GRIS|CPC)' THEN 'cemento' ELSE 'otro' END AS cat,
                CASE WHEN (l->>'unidades') ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\Z' AND upper(l->>'descripcion') ~ '[0-9]\s*KG' AND upper(l->>'descripcion') !~ '(CARGO|MANIOBRA|FLETE|LOGIST)'
                     THEN (l->>'unidades')::numeric * CASE WHEN (l->>'precio') ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\Z' AND (l->>'precio')::numeric >= 1500 THEN 1000
                                                           ELSE substring(upper(l->>'descripcion') from '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*KG')::numeric END END AS kg
         FROM ed d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.detalle) = 'array' THEN d.detalle ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) l),
ekg AS (SELECT id, sum(kg) AS kg, coalesce(sum(kg) FILTER (WHERE cat = 'cemento'), 0) AS kc, coalesce(sum(kg) FILTER (WHERE cat = 'mortero'), 0) AS km FROM ekg0 GROUP BY 1),
mkg0 AS (SELECT d.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID' AS id, CASE WHEN upper(a.nombre) ~ 'MORTERO' THEN 'mortero' WHEN upper(a.nombre) ~ '(CEMENTO|GRIS|CPC)' THEN 'cemento' ELSE 'otro' END AS cat,
                CASE WHEN (d.datos->>'UNIDADES') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\Z' THEN (d.datos->>'UNIDADES')::numeric ELSE 0 END * substring(upper(a.nombre) from '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*KG')::numeric AS kg
         FROM ms_raw d CROSS JOIN cfg CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.nombre FROM ms_articulos x WHERE (d.datos->>'ARTICULO_ID') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}\Z' AND x.articulo_id = (d.datos->>'ARTICULO_ID')::bigint
                                                          ORDER BY (x.base = cfg.base) DESC LIMIT 1) a
         WHERE d.base = cfg.base AND d.tabla = 'DOCTOS_CM_DET' AND d.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID' IN (SELECT id FROM md) AND upper(a.nombre) ~ '[0-9]\s*KG'),
mkg AS (SELECT id, sum(kg) AS kg, coalesce(sum(kg) FILTER (WHERE cat = 'cemento'), 0) AS kc, coalesce(sum(kg) FILTER (WHERE cat = 'mortero'), 0) AS km FROM mkg0 GROUP BY 1),
-- si en Microsip la descripción dice a quién se entregó (ej. "SE LE ENTREGO ACUEDUCTO"), esa recepción es de ese frente
mfr AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.id) m.id, f.frente, f.nombre FROM md m CROSS JOIN cfg JOIN pp_frente f ON f.base = cfg.base AND length(coalesce(f.nombre, '')) >= 4
          AND upper(coalesce(m.datos->>'DESCRIPCION', '')) LIKE '%' || upper(f.nombre) || '%'
        ORDER BY m.id, length(f.nombre) DESC),
am AS (SELECT a.* FROM pp_amarre a, cfg WHERE a.base = cfg.base AND NOT a.borrado AND a.proveedor_id IN (SELECT proveedor_id FROM prov)),
par AS (SELECT e.id AS eid, a.docto_id AS mid, -1 AS forma, 0::numeric AS dt, 0 AS df
        FROM am a JOIN ed e ON e.proveedor_id = a.proveedor_id AND e.folio_n = a.folio_n WHERE a.tipo = 'amarre' AND a.docto_id IN (SELECT id FROM md)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT e.id AS eid, m.id AS mid,
               -- primero lo que coincide en kilos de cada material; un importe parecido con otro material va al final
               CASE WHEN en.nums && coalesce(n.nums, '{}'::text[]) THEN 0
                    WHEN ek.kg > 0 AND mk.kg > 0 THEN CASE WHEN abs(ek.kg - mk.kg) <= greatest(60, 0.03 * ek.kg) AND abs(ek.kc - mk.kc) <= greatest(60, 0.03 * ek.kg)
                                                            AND abs(ek.km - mk.km) <= greatest(60, 0.03 * ek.kg) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                    WHEN abs(e.total - m.total) <= greatest(1, 0.005 * abs(e.total)) AND abs(coalesce(e.fecha, m.fecha) - m.fecha) <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS forma,
               CASE WHEN ek.kg > 0 AND mk.kg > 0 THEN (abs(ek.kc - mk.kc) + abs(ek.km - mk.km) + abs(ek.kg - mk.kg)) / ek.kg ELSE abs(e.total - m.total) / greatest(abs(e.total), 1) END
                 - CASE WHEN mfr.frente IS NOT NULL AND mfr.frente = e.frente THEN 0.01 ELSE 0 END AS dt,
               abs(coalesce(e.fecha, m.fecha) - m.fecha) AS df
        FROM ed e JOIN md m ON m.prov = e.proveedor_id LEFT JOIN mnum n ON n.id = m.id LEFT JOIN ekg ek ON ek.id = e.id LEFT JOIN mkg mk ON mk.id = m.id LEFT JOIN mfr ON mfr.id = m.id JOIN enum en ON en.id = e.id
        WHERE e.cargo AND abs(coalesce(e.fecha, m.fecha) - m.fecha) <= 60
          AND NOT (mfr.frente IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(e.frente, '') <> '' AND mfr.frente <> e.frente)

          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pp_frente f, cfg WHERE f.base = cfg.base AND f.frente = e.frente AND NOT f.propio)
          AND (en.nums && coalesce(n.nums, '{}'::text[])
               OR (abs(e.total - m.total) <= greatest(1, 0.005 * abs(e.total)) AND abs(coalesce(e.fecha, m.fecha) - m.fecha) <= 7)
               -- mismos kilos (±3 %) y fechas cercanas: así se amarra CEMEX aunque el folio y el precio no coincidan
               -- (cemento con cemento y mortero con mortero: 5 t de mortero + 5 t de cemento no es lo mismo que 10 t de cemento)
               OR (ek.kg > 0 AND mk.kg > 0 AND abs(ek.kg - mk.kg) <= greatest(60, 0.03 * ek.kg)
                   AND abs(ek.kc - mk.kc) <= greatest(60, 0.03 * ek.kg) AND abs(ek.km - mk.km) <= greatest(60, 0.03 * ek.kg)
                   AND abs(coalesce(e.fecha, m.fecha) - m.fecha) <= 5))),
-- se amarra de uno en uno, siempre el par más parecido que quede libre
mt0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (eid) eid, mid, forma FROM par WHERE forma <= 0 ORDER BY eid, forma, dt, df, mid),
mt AS (WITH RECURSIVE a(n, eid, mid, forma, ue, um) AS (
         SELECT 0, NULL::bigint, NULL::text, NULL::int, coalesce((SELECT array_agg(eid) FROM mt0), ARRAY[]::bigint[]), coalesce((SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT mid) FROM mt0), ARRAY[]::text[])
         UNION ALL
         SELECT a.n + 1, b.eid, b.mid, b.forma, a.ue || b.eid, a.um || b.mid FROM a CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
           SELECT p.eid, p.mid, p.forma FROM par p WHERE NOT (p.eid = ANY (a.ue)) AND NOT (p.mid = ANY (a.um)) ORDER BY p.forma, p.dt, p.df, p.eid, p.mid LIMIT 1) b
         WHERE a.n < 3000)
       SELECT eid, mid, forma FROM mt0 UNION ALL SELECT eid, mid, forma FROM a WHERE n > 0),
-- cuando una recepción lleva varias notas: sus totales juntos
mta AS (SELECT t.mid, count(*) AS n, sum(e.total) AS total, string_agg(e.folio, ', ' ORDER BY e.folio) AS folios,
               array_agg('E:' || e.proveedor_id || ':' || e.folio_n) AS docs FROM mt t JOIN ed e ON e.id = t.eid GROUP BY 1),
apl AS (SELECT a.doc, sum(a.monto) AS m FROM pp_aplicacion a JOIN pp_pago g ON g.id = a.pago_id CROSS JOIN cfg WHERE g.base = cfg.base AND NOT g.borrado GROUP BY 1),
it AS (
  SELECT 'M:' || m.id AS id, m.prov, p.nombre, m.tipo, m.folio, g.folios AS folio_prov, m.fecha, m.total AS ms_total, g.total AS prov_total,
         coalesce(g.total, m.total) AS monto, coalesce(fb.frem, fb.frec, m.fecha) + p.dias AS vence, false AS sin_ms,
         coalesce(a1.m, 0) + coalesce((SELECT sum(a2.m) FROM apl a2 WHERE a2.doc = ANY (g.docs)), 0) AS pagado,
         coalesce(fb.frem, fb.frec, m.fecha) AS fbase, fb.frem IS NOT NULL AS por_remision, fb.rfolio, fb.frec
  FROM md m JOIN prov p ON p.proveedor_id = m.prov CROSS JOIN cfg LEFT JOIN fb ON fb.id = m.id LEFT JOIN mta g ON g.mid = m.id
  LEFT JOIN apl a1 ON a1.doc = 'M:' || m.id
  WHERE m.fecha >= cfg.desde AND (p.pagado_hasta IS NULL OR m.fecha > p.pagado_hasta)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'E:' || e.proveedor_id || ':' || e.folio_n, e.proveedor_id, p.nombre, 'EDO', e.folio, e.folio, e.fecha, NULL, e.total, e.total,
         coalesce(e.fecha, cfg.hoy) + p.dias, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pp_frente f WHERE f.base = cfg.base AND f.frente = e.frente AND NOT f.propio), coalesce(a.m, 0), coalesce(e.fecha, cfg.hoy), false, NULL, NULL
  FROM ed e JOIN prov p ON p.proveedor_id = e.proveedor_id CROSS JOIN cfg LEFT JOIN apl a ON a.doc = 'E:' || e.proveedor_id || ':' || e.folio_n
  WHERE e.cargo AND e.id NOT IN (SELECT eid FROM mt) AND coalesce(e.fecha, cfg.hoy) >= cfg.desde
    AND (p.pagado_hasta IS NULL OR coalesce(e.fecha, cfg.hoy) > p.pagado_hasta)),
cma AS (SELECT r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID' AS id, upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'TIPO_DOCTO', '')) AS tipo, coalesce(r.fecha, left(r.datos->>'FECHA', 10)::date) AS fecha,
               r.datos->>'PROVEEDOR_ID' AS prov, CASE WHEN (r.datos->>'IMPORTE_NETO') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\Z' THEN (r.datos->>'IMPORTE_NETO')::numeric ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (r.datos->>'TOTAL_IMPUESTOS') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\Z' THEN (r.datos->>'TOTAL_IMPUESTOS')::numeric ELSE 0 END AS total
        FROM ms_raw r, cfg
        WHERE r.base = cfg.base AND r.tabla = 'DOCTOS_CM' AND upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'TIPO_DOCTO', '')) IN ('R', 'C')
          AND upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'ESTATUS', '')) <> 'C' AND upper(coalesce(r.datos->>'CANCELADO', 'N')) NOT IN ('S', 'SI', 'Y', 'T', '1', 'TRUE')
          AND coalesce(r.fecha, left(r.datos->>'FECHA', 10)::date) >= cfg.hoy - 180),
cmal AS (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_FTE_ID', r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID_FTE', r.datos->>'DOCTO_FTE_ID') AS fte
         FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.base = cfg.base AND r.tabla = 'DOCTOS_CM_LIGAS'
           AND coalesce(r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_DEST_ID', r.datos->>'DOCTO_CM_ID_DEST', r.datos->>'DOCTO_DEST_ID') IN (SELECT id FROM cma WHERE tipo = 'C')),
cmd AS (SELECT c.* FROM cma c WHERE NOT (c.tipo = 'R' AND c.id IN (SELECT fte FROM cmal WHERE fte IS NOT NULL))),
sem AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('week', cfg.hoy)::date - 49, date_trunc('week', cfg.hoy)::date, interval '7 day')::date AS ini FROM cfg),
ven AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', v.fecha)::date AS ini, sum(coalesce(v.total, 0)) AS t FROM ms_ventas_v v, cfg
        WHERE v.base = cfg.base AND v.fecha >= cfg.hoy - 63 AND NOT coalesce(v.cancelado, false)
          AND ((v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'V') OR (v.origen = 'VE' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'R')) GROUP BY 1),
reb AS (SELECT i.prov, to_char(i.fecha, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, sum(i.prov_total - i.ms_total) AS esperado
        FROM it i JOIN pp_proveedor p ON p.proveedor_id = i.prov AND p.rebate CROSS JOIN cfg
        WHERE p.base = cfg.base AND i.prov_total IS NOT NULL AND i.ms_total IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT json_build_object('ok', true, 'hoy', cfg.hoy, 'desde', cfg.desde, 'abono', cfg.abono,
  'abonado_semana', (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(a.monto), 0), 2) FROM pp_aplicacion a JOIN pp_pago g ON g.id = a.pago_id JOIN it ON it.id = a.doc
                     WHERE g.base = cfg.base AND NOT g.borrado AND g.fecha >= date_trunc('week', cfg.hoy)::date AND it.vence < g.fecha
                       AND coalesce(g.referencia, '') <> 'Ya estaba pagada'),
  'proveedores', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('proveedor_id', p.proveedor_id, 'nombre', coalesce(nullif(pr.datos->>'NOMBRE', ''), p.nombre), 'dias', p.dias,
                    'rebate', p.rebate, 'pagado_hasta', p.pagado_hasta, 'seguir', p.seguir) ORDER BY p.seguir DESC, p.nombre), '[]')
                  FROM pp_proveedor p LEFT JOIN ms_raw pr ON pr.base = cfg.base AND pr.tabla = 'PROVEEDORES' AND pr.pk = p.proveedor_id WHERE p.base = cfg.base),
  'items', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', i.id, 'prov', i.prov, 'nombre', i.nombre, 'tipo', i.tipo, 'folio', i.folio, 'folio_prov', i.folio_prov,
               'fecha', i.fecha, 'ms_total', round(i.ms_total, 2), 'prov_total', round(i.prov_total, 2), 'monto', round(i.monto, 2), 'pagado', round(i.pagado, 2),
               'vence', i.vence, 'sin_ms', i.sin_ms, 'fbase', i.fbase, 'por_remision', i.por_remision, 'rfolio', i.rfolio, 'frec', i.frec) ORDER BY i.vence, i.fecha), '[]') FROM it i WHERE i.monto - i.pagado > 0.5),
  'pagos', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', g.id, 'prov', g.proveedor_id, 'nombre', coalesce(nullif(pr.datos->>'NOMBRE', ''), pp.nombre, g.proveedor_id),
               'fecha', g.fecha, 'monto', g.monto, 'referencia', g.referencia, 'por', g.por, 'notas', (SELECT count(*) FROM pp_aplicacion a WHERE a.pago_id = g.id))
               ORDER BY g.fecha DESC, g.id DESC), '[]')
            FROM pp_pago g LEFT JOIN pp_proveedor pp ON pp.base = g.base AND pp.proveedor_id = g.proveedor_id
            LEFT JOIN ms_raw pr ON pr.base = cfg.base AND pr.tabla = 'PROVEEDORES' AND pr.pk = g.proveedor_id
            WHERE g.base = cfg.base AND NOT g.borrado AND g.fecha >= cfg.hoy - 120),
  'estados', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', e.id, 'prov', e.proveedor_id, 'archivo', e.archivo, 'fecha_corte', e.fecha_corte, 'total', e.total,
                'docs', e.docs, 'creado', to_char(e.creado AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')) ORDER BY e.id DESC), '[]')
              FROM (SELECT * FROM pp_estado WHERE base = cfg.base AND NOT borrado ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30) e),
  'rebate', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('prov', reb.prov, 'mes', reb.mes, 'esperado', round(reb.esperado, 2)) ORDER BY reb.mes DESC), '[]') FROM reb),
  'catalogo', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('proveedor_id', z.prov, 'nombre', coalesce(nullif(pr.datos->>'NOMBRE', ''), z.prov), 'compras_90', round(z.t, 2),
                  'ultima', z.ult) ORDER BY z.t DESC), '[]')
               FROM (SELECT prov, sum(total) FILTER (WHERE fecha >= (SELECT hoy FROM cfg) - 90) AS t, max(fecha) AS ult FROM cmd WHERE prov IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) z
               LEFT JOIN ms_raw pr ON pr.base = cfg.base AND pr.tabla = 'PROVEEDORES' AND pr.pk = z.prov),
  'flujo', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('ini', s.ini, 'ventas', round(coalesce(v.t, 0), 2),
                 'compras', round(coalesce((SELECT sum(total) FROM cmd WHERE date_trunc('week', cmd.fecha)::date = s.ini), 0), 2),
                 'credito', round(coalesce((SELECT sum(total) FROM cmd WHERE date_trunc('week', cmd.fecha)::date = s.ini AND cmd.prov IN (SELECT proveedor_id FROM prov)), 0), 2),
                 'pagado', round(coalesce((SELECT sum(monto) FROM pp_pago g WHERE g.base = cfg.base AND NOT g.borrado AND date_trunc('week', g.fecha)::date = s.ini), 0), 2)) ORDER BY s.ini), '[]')
            FROM sem s LEFT JOIN ven v ON v.ini = s.ini)) AS r
FROM cfg;

WITH h AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS hoy),
nom AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', fecha)::date AS sem,
         sum(importe) FILTER (WHERE lower(translate(coalesce(subcategoria, ''), 'óÓ', 'oO')) = 'nomina') AS nomina,
         sum(importe) FILTER (WHERE lower(translate(coalesce(subcategoria, ''), 'óÓ', 'oO')) <> 'nomina') AS otros
  FROM gastos.movimientos, h
  WHERE categoria = 'Gasto Operativo' AND fecha >= date_trunc('week', h.hoy)::date - 28 AND fecha < date_trunc('week', h.hoy)::date
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT json_build_object('nomina_sem', coalesce((SELECT sum(nomina) / 4 FROM nom), 0), 'otros_sem', coalesce((SELECT sum(otros) / 4 FROM nom), 0),
                         'semanas_con_datos', (SELECT count(*) FROM nom)) AS g;

SET LOCAL jit = off;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '90s';
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inv_cierres (dia DATE PRIMARY KEY, valor NUMERIC, articulos INT, actualizado TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now());
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ms_metas (mes TEXT PRIMARY KEY, meta_mensual NUMERIC, meta_semanal NUMERIC, por TEXT, actualizado TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now());
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ms_metas_vendedor (mes TEXT NOT NULL, vendedor TEXT NOT NULL, meta NUMERIC, por TEXT, actualizado TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (mes, vendedor));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ms_costos_manual (base TEXT, articulo_id BIGINT, costo NUMERIC, por TEXT, actualizado TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (base, articulo_id));
ALTER TABLE ms_articulos ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS costo_ultimo NUMERIC;

  alta TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), alta_por TEXT, activo BOOLEAN DEFAULT true, notas TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS monedero_movs (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, fecha TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), telefono TEXT NOT NULL, tipo TEXT NOT NULL,
  puntos NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, monto_compra NUMERIC(12,2), base TEXT, origen TEXT, docto_id BIGINT, folio TEXT, ref TEXT UNIQUE, usuario TEXT, notas TEXT);
-- foto diaria del valor del inventario (para inventario promedio y al cierre de cada mes)
WITH ms_existencias AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_existencias WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text)
INSERT INTO inv_cierres (dia, valor, articulos)
SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date, coalesce(sum(valor), 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE existencia > 0) FROM ms_existencias WHERE NOT {{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.ocultar_existencia_negativa === true ? 'true' : 'false' }} OR existencia > 0
ON CONFLICT (dia) DO UPDATE SET valor = EXCLUDED.valor, articulos = EXCLUDED.articulos, actualizado = now();
-- inventario al cierre de cada mes: se fija la primera vez que se calcula (ya no cambia con el costo de hoy)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS panel_cierres_mes (mes TEXT PRIMARY KEY, inventario NUMERIC, fuente TEXT, fijado TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now());
INSERT INTO panel_cierres_mes (mes, inventario, fuente) VALUES ('2026-07', 718701, 'Excel 4.1.1.2'), ('2026-08', 688672, 'Excel 4.1.1.2'), ('2026-09', 415004, 'Excel 4.1.1.2')
ON CONFLICT (mes) DO NOTHING;
WITH ms_existencias AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_existencias WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text),
ms_raw AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_raw WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text),
ih AS (SELECT r.datos ->> 'MES' AS mes, max(r.datos ->> 'CORTE') AS corte, sum((r.datos ->> 'VALOR')::numeric) AS v FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'INV_CIERRE_MES' GROUP BY 1),
ihr AS (SELECT * FROM ih ORDER BY mes DESC LIMIT 1), inv_hoy AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(valor), 0) AS v FROM ms_existencias)
INSERT INTO panel_cierres_mes (mes, inventario, fuente)
SELECT ih.mes, round(inv_hoy.v - (ihr.v - ih.v), 2), 'microsip' FROM ih, ihr, inv_hoy
WHERE ih.mes < to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'YYYY-MM') AND ih.mes ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$'
  AND left(ih.corte, 10)::date >= ((ih.mes || '-01')::date + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date
ON CONFLICT (mes) DO NOTHING;
-- si vienen objetivos desde el panel, se guardan
INSERT INTO ms_metas_vendedor (mes, vendedor, meta, por)
SELECT $1::jsonb ->> 'mes', left(x.key, 60), nullif(regexp_replace(x.value, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 'panel'
FROM jsonb_each_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof($1::jsonb -> 'metas_vendedor') = 'object' THEN $1::jsonb -> 'metas_vendedor' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) x
WHERE coalesce($1::jsonb ->> 'mes', '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$'
ON CONFLICT (mes, vendedor) DO UPDATE SET meta = EXCLUDED.meta, actualizado = now();
INSERT INTO ms_metas (mes, meta_mensual, por)
SELECT $1::jsonb ->> 'mes', ($1::jsonb ->> 'meta_mes')::numeric, 'panel'
WHERE coalesce($1::jsonb ->> 'mes', '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' AND coalesce($1::jsonb ->> 'meta_mes', '') ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
ON CONFLICT (mes) DO UPDATE SET meta_mensual = EXCLUDED.meta_mensual, actualizado = now();
WITH ms_ventas_v AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas_v WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text),
ms_ventas_det AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas_det WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text),
ms_ventas AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_ventas WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text),
ms_existencias AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_existencias WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text),
ms_articulos AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_articulos WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text),
ms_raw AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ms_raw WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NULL OR base = $2::text),
p0 AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS hoy),
cfg AS (
  SELECT m.ini, least(m.fin_mes, p0.hoy) AS fin, m.fin_mes, p0.hoy, greatest(least(m.fin_mes, p0.hoy) - m.ini + 1, 1) AS dias,
         (m.ini - interval '1 year')::date AS ly_ini, (least(m.fin_mes, p0.hoy) - interval '1 year')::date AS ly_fin, (m.fin_mes - interval '1 year')::date AS ly_fin_mes,
         500000::numeric AS maxm,
         coalesce((SELECT valor FROM panel_config WHERE clave = 'bono_grupos'), '') AS bgr,
         coalesce((SELECT nullif(valor, '')::numeric FROM panel_config WHERE clave = 'bono_pct'), 5) AS bpct,
         coalesce((SELECT nullif(valor, '')::int FROM panel_config WHERE clave = 'cxc_dias_credito'), 15) AS dcred,
         m.fin_mes < p0.hoy AS pasado,
         (SELECT (k.datos ->> 'DESDE')::date FROM ms_raw k WHERE k.tabla = 'VE_FACT_LIGADA' AND k.pk = '_corte' ORDER BY k.actualizado DESC LIMIT 1) AS lig_desde,
         translate(upper(trim('{{ String($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.almacenes_venta ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}')), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') AS alm,
         '{{ String($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.alias_vendedores ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS alias,
         translate(upper(trim('{{ String($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.patron_sobre_pedido ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}')), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') AS psp,
         translate(upper(trim('{{ String($('Panel · Configuración').first().json.patron_tinacos ?? 'tinaco').replace(/'/g, "''") }}')), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') AS ptin
  FROM p0, LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(p0.p ->> 'mes', '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ((p0.p ->> 'mes') || '-01')::date ELSE date_trunc('month', p0.hoy)::date END AS ini) i,
       LATERAL (SELECT i.ini, (i.ini + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS fin_mes) m),
alms AS (SELECT trim(x) AS a FROM cfg, regexp_split_to_table(cfg.alm, '[|,]') x WHERE trim(x) <> ''),
almon AS (SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_ventas v WHERE translate(upper(trim(coalesce(v.almacen, ''))), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') IN (SELECT a FROM alms)) AS on_),
lcov AS MATERIALIZED (   -- meses en que ya se revisaron las facturas ligadas a remisiones: ahí se cuentan las facturas directas
  SELECT r.base, r.pk AS mes FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'VE_LIGAS_MES'
  UNION SELECT r.base, to_char(r.fecha, 'YYYY-MM') FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla IN ('VE_FACT_LIGADA', 'VE_LIGA') AND r.pk <> '_corte' AND r.fecha IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT r.base, r.datos ->> 'MES' FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'COSTO_VENDIDO_TIPO' AND r.datos ->> 'ORIGEN' = 'VE'
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_raw k WHERE k.base = r.base AND k.tabla = 'VE_FACT_LIGADA' AND k.pk <> '_corte')),
al AS (SELECT upper(trim(split_part(x, '=', 1))) AS usr, trim(split_part(x, '=', 2)) AS nom
       FROM cfg, regexp_split_to_table(cfg.alias, ',') x WHERE position('=' in x) > 0 AND trim(split_part(x, '=', 2)) <> ''),
vt0 AS (   -- venta real: tickets y devoluciones de punto de venta + remisiones + facturas directas; de una factura que salió de remisiones solo cuenta lo que no venía en ellas
  SELECT x.base, x.origen, x.docto_id, x.fecha, x.tipo, x.cliente, x.vendedor, x.usr_ms, x.importe * x.fx AS importe, x.sg, x.total * x.fx AS total, x.fx, x.almacen
  FROM (SELECT v.base, v.origen, v.docto_id, v.fecha, v.tipo, v.cliente, coalesce(nullif(trim(v.almacen), ''), '(sin almacén)') AS almacen,
               coalesce((SELECT al.nom FROM al WHERE al.usr = upper(trim(v.usuario)) LIMIT 1), nullif(trim(v.usuario), ''), '(sin usuario)') AS vendedor,
               coalesce(nullif(trim(v.usuario), ''), '(sin usuario)') AS usr_ms, CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -abs(v.importe) ELSE v.importe END AS importe,
               CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS sg, CASE WHEN upper(v.tipo) = 'D' THEN -abs(v.total) ELSE v.total END AS total,
               1 AS fx
        FROM ms_ventas_v v CROSS JOIN cfg
        LEFT JOIN ms_raw lg ON v.origen = 'VE' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'F' AND lg.base = v.base AND lg.tabla = 'VE_FACT_LIGADA' AND lg.pk = v.docto_id::text
        WHERE NOT v.cancelado AND abs(v.total) <= cfg.maxm
          AND (v.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin OR v.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ly_ini AND cfg.ly_fin_mes OR v.fecha BETWEEN cfg.fin - 89 AND cfg.fin)
          AND ((v.origen = 'PV' AND upper(v.tipo) IN ('V', 'D')) OR (v.origen = 'VE' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'F' AND (NULLIF('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.almacenes_facturas || '' }}', '') IS NULL OR upper(trim(coalesce(v.almacen,''))) IN (SELECT upper(trim(x)) FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.almacenes_facturas || '' }}', ',')) x))))) x
  WHERE x.fx > 0 AND (x.fx = 1 OR x.importe * x.fx > 1)),
vt AS (SELECT vt0.* FROM vt0, almon WHERE NOT almon.on_ OR translate(upper(trim(vt0.almacen)), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') IN (SELECT a FROM alms)),
costo AS (
  SELECT a.base, a.articulo_id, a.grupo, a.linea, a.nombre, a.clave, a.unidad,
         coalesce(m.costo,
                  CASE WHEN a.costo_ultimo > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND a.costo_ultimo > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN a.costo_ultimo END,
                  CASE WHEN c0.cu0 > 0 AND NOT (a.precio_lista > 0 AND c0.cu0 > a.precio_lista * 1.1) THEN c0.cu0 END) AS cu
  FROM ms_articulos a
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT base, articulo_id, sum(valor) / NULLIF(sum(existencia), 0) AS cu0 FROM ms_existencias WHERE existencia > 0 AND valor > 0 GROUP BY base, articulo_id) c0
         ON c0.base = a.base AND c0.articulo_id = a.articulo_id
  LEFT JOIN ms_costos_manual m ON m.base = a.base AND m.articulo_id = a.articulo_id),
lin AS (
  SELECT vt.fecha, vt.vendedor, d.base, d.articulo_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(c.grupo), ''), nullif(trim(c.linea), ''), 'Sin grupo') AS grupo,
         vt.sg * vt.fx * abs(d.importe) AS importe, vt.sg * vt.fx * abs(d.unidades) AS unidades,
         CASE WHEN c.cu IS NOT NULL AND abs(d.unidades) * c.cu <= 2 * abs(d.importe) THEN vt.sg * vt.fx * abs(d.unidades) * c.cu END AS costo
  FROM vt JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = vt.base AND d.origen = vt.origen AND d.docto_id = vt.docto_id
  LEFT JOIN costo c ON c.base = d.base AND c.articulo_id = d.articulo_id),
lm AS (SELECT lin.* FROM lin, cfg WHERE lin.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin),
abc0 AS (SELECT l.base, l.articulo_id, sum(l.importe) AS imp, sum(l.unidades) AS uni FROM lin l, cfg WHERE l.fecha BETWEEN cfg.fin - 89 AND cfg.fin GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING sum(l.importe) > 0),
abc1 AS (SELECT a.*, sum(a.imp) OVER (ORDER BY a.imp DESC, a.articulo_id) / NULLIF(sum(a.imp) OVER (), 0) AS acum FROM abc0 a),
abc AS (SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN a.acum - a.imp / NULLIF((SELECT sum(imp) FROM abc0), 0) < 0.80 THEN 'A' WHEN a.acum - a.imp / NULLIF((SELECT sum(imp) FROM abc0), 0) < 0.95 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS clase,
               (SELECT CASE WHEN {{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.ocultar_existencia_negativa === true ? 'true' : 'false' }} THEN greatest(sum(e.existencia), 0) ELSE sum(e.existencia) END FROM ms_existencias e WHERE e.base = a.base AND e.articulo_id = a.articulo_id) AS exis
        FROM abc1 a),
cmx AS (
  SELECT sum(c) FILTER (WHERE o = 'PV' AND t = 'V') AS cv, sum(c) FILTER (WHERE o = 'PV' AND t = 'D') AS cd, sum(c) FILTER (WHERE o = 'VE' AND t = 'F') AS cf, sum(c) FILTER (WHERE o = 'VE' AND t = 'R') AS cr, count(*) > 0 AS hay
  FROM (SELECT r.datos ->> 'ORIGEN' AS o, upper(r.datos ->> 'TIPO') AS t, (r.datos ->> 'COSTO')::numeric AS c FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.tabla = 'COSTO_VENDIDO_TIPO' AND r.datos ->> 'MES' = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')) z),
rv AS (  -- venta de remisiones del mes y venta de facturas ligadas a remisiones (su costo está en las remisiones)
  SELECT sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE upper(v.tipo) = 'R') AS vr,
         sum(d.importe) FILTER (WHERE upper(v.tipo) = 'F' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_raw l WHERE l.base = v.base AND l.tabla = 'VE_FACT_LIGADA' AND l.pk = v.docto_id::text)) AS vfl
  FROM ms_ventas_v v JOIN ms_ventas_det d ON d.base = v.base AND d.origen = v.origen AND d.docto_id = v.docto_id, cfg
  WHERE v.origen = 'VE' AND upper(v.tipo) IN ('R', 'F') AND NOT v.cancelado AND v.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin_mes),
cadj AS (  -- costo estilo Microsip: mostrador + devoluciones + facturas directas + costo (a la tasa de las remisiones) de lo facturado desde remisiones
  SELECT cmx.hay, coalesce(cmx.cv, 0) + coalesce(cmx.cd, 0) + coalesce(cmx.cf, 0)
         + CASE WHEN coalesce(rv.vr, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(cmx.cr, 0) / rv.vr * coalesce(rv.vfl, 0) ELSE 0 END AS costo FROM cmx, rv),
kf AS (SELECT CASE WHEN cadj.hay AND tot.t > 0 THEN cadj.costo / tot.t ELSE 1 END AS k
  FROM cadj, (SELECT sum((r.datos ->> 'COSTO')::numeric) AS t FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.tabla = 'COSTO_VENDIDO_MES' AND r.datos ->> 'MES' = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')) tot),
cvm AS (SELECT r.base, (r.datos ->> 'ARTICULO_ID')::bigint AS articulo_id, (r.datos ->> 'COSTO')::numeric * (SELECT k FROM kf) AS costo
        FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.tabla = 'COSTO_VENDIDO_MES' AND r.datos ->> 'MES' = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')),
cvg AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(trim(c.grupo), ''), nullif(trim(c.linea), ''), 'Sin grupo') AS grupo, sum(m.costo) AS costo_ms
        FROM cvm m LEFT JOIN costo c ON c.base = m.base AND c.articulo_id = m.articulo_id GROUP BY 1),
ih AS (SELECT r.datos ->> 'MES' AS mes, max(r.datos ->> 'CORTE') AS corte, sum((r.datos ->> 'VALOR')::numeric) AS v FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'INV_CIERRE_MES' GROUP BY 1),
ihr AS (SELECT * FROM ih ORDER BY mes DESC LIMIT 1),
inv_hoy AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(valor), 0) AS v FROM ms_existencias),
hcc AS (SELECT sum((r.datos ->> 'SALDO')::numeric) AS saldo, sum((r.datos ->> 'B0')::numeric) AS b0, sum((r.datos ->> 'B1')::numeric) AS b1, sum((r.datos ->> 'B2')::numeric) AS b2,
               sum((r.datos ->> 'B3')::numeric) AS b3, sum((r.datos ->> 'N')::int) AS n, max(r.datos ->> 'CORTE') AS corte
        FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.tabla = 'SALDOS_CC_MES' AND r.pk = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM') HAVING count(*) > 0),
hcp AS (SELECT sum((r.datos ->> 'SALDO')::numeric) AS saldo, sum((r.datos ->> 'B0')::numeric) AS b0, sum((r.datos ->> 'B1')::numeric) AS b1, sum((r.datos ->> 'B2')::numeric) AS b2,
               sum((r.datos ->> 'B3')::numeric) AS b3, sum((r.datos ->> 'N')::int) AS n, max(r.datos ->> 'CORTE') AS corte
        FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.tabla = 'SALDOS_CP_MES' AND r.pk = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM') HAVING count(*) > 0),
cc AS (SELECT (r.datos ->> 'PENDIENTE')::numeric AS pend, cfg.hoy - left(r.datos ->> 'FECHA', 10)::date AS dias, (r.datos ->> 'CLIENTE_ID') AS cli
       FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.tabla = 'CARGOS_CC' AND r.pk <> '_corte'
        AND r.sync_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT k.sync_id FROM ms_raw k WHERE k.tabla = 'CARGOS_CC' AND k.pk = '_corte' ORDER BY k.actualizado DESC LIMIT 1)
        AND coalesce((r.datos ->> 'PENDIENTE')::numeric, 0) > 0.009),
sc AS (SELECT (r.datos ->> 'CLIENTE_ID') AS cli, (r.datos ->> 'CLIENTE') AS nombre, (r.datos ->> 'SALDO')::numeric AS saldo FROM ms_raw r
       WHERE r.tabla = 'SALDOS_CC' AND r.pk <> '_corte'
        AND r.sync_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT k.sync_id FROM ms_raw k WHERE k.tabla = 'SALDOS_CC' AND k.pk = '_corte' ORDER BY k.actualizado DESC LIMIT 1)
        AND coalesce((r.datos ->> 'SALDO')::numeric, 0) > 0.009)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'mes', to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM'), 'ini', cfg.ini, 'fin', cfg.fin, 'fin_mes', cfg.fin_mes, 'dias', cfg.dias, 'hoy', cfg.hoy,
  'generado', to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
  'resumen', (SELECT json_build_object(
      'venta_civa', (SELECT coalesce(sum(total), 0) FROM vt WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin),
      'venta_siva', coalesce(sum(importe), 0), 'venta_con_costo', coalesce(sum(importe) FILTER (WHERE costo IS NOT NULL), 0), 'costo', coalesce(sum(costo), 0),
      'venta_siva_enc', (SELECT coalesce(sum(importe), 0) FROM vt WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin),
      'costo_ms', (SELECT sum(costo) FROM cvm), 'costo_ms_hay', (SELECT count(*) > 0 FROM cvm))
    FROM lm),
  'ligas_desde', cfg.lig_desde,
  'ligas_mes', (cfg.ini >= cfg.lig_desde) IS TRUE OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lcov WHERE lcov.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')),
  'almacen_filtro', CASE WHEN (SELECT on_ FROM almon) THEN cfg.alm END,
  'almacen_filtro_sin_match', cfg.alm <> '' AND NOT (SELECT on_ FROM almon),
  'almacen_excluye', (SELECT on_ FROM almon) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vt0 WHERE vt0.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin
                       AND translate(upper(trim(vt0.almacen)), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') NOT IN (SELECT a FROM alms)),
  'ligas_diag', json_build_object(
      'facturas', (SELECT count(*) FROM ms_ventas_v v WHERE v.origen = 'VE' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'F' AND NOT v.cancelado AND v.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin),
      'ligadas', (SELECT count(*) FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'VE_FACT_LIGADA' AND r.pk <> '_corte' AND r.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin),
      'ligas', (SELECT count(*) FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'VE_LIGA' AND r.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin),
      'revisado', (SELECT max(r.datos ->> 'REVISADO') FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'VE_LIGAS_MES' AND r.pk = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')),
      'ultima_liga', (SELECT to_char(max(r.actualizado) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla IN ('VE_FACT_LIGADA', 'VE_LIGA', 'VE_LIGAS_MES'))),
  'por_almacen', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('almacen', z.almacen, 'venta', z.imp, 'docs', z.n, 'cuenta', z.cuenta) ORDER BY z.imp DESC), '[]'::json)
                  FROM (SELECT vt0.almacen, round(sum(vt0.importe), 2) AS imp, count(*) AS n,
                               NOT (SELECT on_ FROM almon) OR translate(upper(trim(vt0.almacen)), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') IN (SELECT a FROM alms) AS cuenta
                        FROM vt0 WHERE vt0.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin GROUP BY vt0.almacen) z),
  'cuadre', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('origen', z.origen, 'tipo', z.tipo, 'nombre', z.tn, 'cuenta', z.cuenta, 'n', z.n, 'importe', z.imp, 'total', z.tot,
                 'costo', CASE WHEN z.cuenta OR z.tipo = 'F' THEN (SELECT sum((r.datos ->> 'COSTO')::numeric) FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'COSTO_VENDIDO_TIPO' AND r.datos ->> 'MES' = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')
                                                        AND r.datos ->> 'ORIGEN' = z.origen AND upper(r.datos ->> 'TIPO') = z.tipo) END,
                 'canceladas_n', z.cn, 'canceladas_total', z.ct, 'canceladas_raras', z.cr, 'excluidas_n', z.xn, 'excluidas_total', z.xt, 'excedente', z.exc, 'excedente_n', z.excn) ORDER BY z.cuenta DESC, z.tot DESC NULLS LAST), '[]'::json)
             FROM (SELECT y.origen, y.tipo, max(y.tipo_nombre) AS tn, bool_or(y.cuenta) AS cuenta,
                          count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) <= cfg.maxm) AS n,
                          coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN y.tipo = 'D' THEN -abs(y.importe) ELSE y.importe END) FILTER (WHERE NOT y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) <= cfg.maxm), 0) AS imp,
                          coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN y.tipo = 'D' THEN -abs(y.total) ELSE y.total END) FILTER (WHERE NOT y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) <= cfg.maxm), 0) AS tot,
                          count(*) FILTER (WHERE y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) <= cfg.maxm) AS cn, coalesce(sum(y.total) FILTER (WHERE y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) <= cfg.maxm), 0) AS ct,
                          count(*) FILTER (WHERE y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) > cfg.maxm) AS cr,
                          coalesce(sum(y.exc) FILTER (WHERE NOT y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) <= cfg.maxm AND y.exc > 1), 0) AS exc,
                          count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) <= cfg.maxm AND y.exc > 1) AS excn,
                          count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) > cfg.maxm) AS xn, coalesce(sum(y.total) FILTER (WHERE NOT y.cancelado AND abs(y.total) > cfg.maxm), 0) AS xt
                   FROM (SELECT v.*, CASE WHEN lg.pk IS NOT NULL THEN 'FR' ELSE upper(v.tipo) END AS tipo2,
                                CASE WHEN lg.pk IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(v.importe - coalesce((lg.datos ->> 'IMPORTE_REM')::numeric, v.importe), 0) END AS exc
                         FROM ms_ventas_v v
                         LEFT JOIN ms_raw lg ON v.origen = 'VE' AND upper(v.tipo) = 'F' AND lg.base = v.base AND lg.tabla = 'VE_FACT_LIGADA' AND lg.pk = v.docto_id::text
                         CROSS JOIN almon
                         WHERE v.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin AND NOT (v.origen = 'VE' AND upper(v.tipo) IN ('C', 'P'))
                           AND (NOT almon.on_ OR translate(upper(trim(coalesce(nullif(trim(v.almacen), ''), '(sin almacén)'))), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') IN (SELECT a FROM alms))) y0
                   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (y0.fecha >= cfg.lig_desde OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lcov WHERE lcov.base = y0.base AND lcov.mes = to_char(y0.fecha, 'YYYY-MM'))) IS TRUE AS cov) cv
                   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT y0.origen, y0.tipo2 AS tipo, CASE WHEN y0.tipo2 = 'FR' THEN 'Factura de remisión' ELSE y0.tipo_nombre END AS tipo_nombre,
                                              y0.cancelado, y0.importe, y0.total, CASE WHEN cv.cov THEN y0.exc END AS exc,
                                              ((y0.origen = 'PV' AND y0.tipo2 IN ('V', 'D')) OR (y0.origen = 'VE' AND y0.tipo2 = 'R')
                                               OR (y0.origen = 'VE' AND y0.tipo2 = 'F' AND cv.cov)) IS TRUE AS cuenta) y
                   GROUP BY y.origen, y.tipo) z),
  've_otros', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('tipo', r.datos ->> 'TIPO', 'n', (r.datos ->> 'N')::int, 'importe', (r.datos ->> 'IMPORTE')::numeric, 'total', (r.datos ->> 'TOTAL')::numeric)), '[]'::json)
               FROM ms_raw r WHERE r.tabla = 'VENTAS_VE_OTROS' AND r.datos ->> 'MES' = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')),
  'tickets', (SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 'total', coalesce(sum(total), 0),
      'dias', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('fecha', z.fecha, 'n', z.n, 'total', z.t) ORDER BY z.fecha), '[]'::json) FROM (
                SELECT fecha, count(*) AS n, sum(total) AS t FROM vt WHERE origen = 'PV' AND upper(tipo) = 'V' AND fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin GROUP BY 1) z))
    FROM vt WHERE origen = 'PV' AND upper(tipo) = 'V' AND fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin),
  'devoluciones', (SELECT json_build_object('n', count(*), 'total', coalesce(sum(abs(total)), 0)) FROM vt WHERE upper(tipo) = 'D' AND fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin),
  'meta_mes', (SELECT meta_mensual FROM ms_metas WHERE mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')),
  'ly', (SELECT json_build_object('periodo', coalesce(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ly_ini AND cfg.ly_fin), 0), 'mes', coalesce(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ly_ini AND cfg.ly_fin_mes), 0),
              'hay', count(*) > 0) FROM vt WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ly_ini AND cfg.ly_fin_mes),
  'vendedores', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('vendedor', z.vendedor, 'usuarios', z.usrs, 'venta', z.venta, 'tickets', z.n, 'ly_periodo', z.lyp, 'ly_mes', z.lym,
                    'meta', (SELECT mv.meta FROM ms_metas_vendedor mv WHERE mv.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM') AND mv.vendedor = z.vendedor)) ORDER BY z.venta DESC), '[]'::json)
                 FROM (SELECT vendedor, string_agg(DISTINCT usr_ms, ', ') AS usrs, coalesce(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin), 0) AS venta, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin) AS n,
                              coalesce(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ly_ini AND cfg.ly_fin), 0) AS lyp, coalesce(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE fecha BETWEEN cfg.ly_ini AND cfg.ly_fin_mes), 0) AS lym
                       FROM vt GROUP BY vendedor) z WHERE z.venta <> 0 OR z.lym <> 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_metas_vendedor mv WHERE mv.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM') AND mv.vendedor = z.vendedor)),
  'grupos', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('grupo', z.grupo, 'venta', z.venta, 'venta_con_costo', z.vcc, 'costo', z.costo, 'costo_ms', (SELECT g.costo_ms FROM cvg g WHERE g.grupo = z.grupo),
                 'bono', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM regexp_split_to_table(cfg.bgr, '\|') x WHERE trim(x) <> '' AND translate(upper(coalesce(z.grupo, '')), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') LIKE '%' || translate(upper(coalesce(trim(x), '')), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') || '%')) ORDER BY z.venta DESC), '[]'::json)
             FROM (SELECT grupo, sum(importe) AS venta, sum(importe) FILTER (WHERE costo IS NOT NULL) AS vcc, sum(costo) AS costo FROM lm GROUP BY grupo) z),
  'bono_cfg', (SELECT json_object_agg(clave, valor) FROM panel_config WHERE clave LIKE 'bono%'),
  'inventario', json_build_object(
      'actual', (SELECT coalesce(sum(valor), 0) FROM ms_existencias WHERE NOT {{ $('Panel · Configuración').first().json.ocultar_existencia_negativa === true ? 'true' : 'false' }} OR existencia > 0),
      'cierre', CASE WHEN cfg.pasado AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM panel_cierres_mes f WHERE f.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM'))
                     THEN (SELECT f.inventario FROM panel_cierres_mes f WHERE f.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM'))
                     WHEN cfg.pasado AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ih WHERE ih.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM'))
                     THEN (SELECT inv_hoy.v - (ihr.v - ih.v) FROM ih, ihr, inv_hoy WHERE ih.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM'))
                     ELSE (SELECT valor FROM inv_cierres WHERE dia BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin_mes ORDER BY dia DESC LIMIT 1) END,
      'cierre_dia', CASE WHEN cfg.pasado AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM panel_cierres_mes f WHERE f.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')) THEN cfg.fin_mes
                     WHEN cfg.pasado AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ih WHERE ih.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')) THEN cfg.fin_mes
                     ELSE (SELECT dia FROM inv_cierres WHERE dia BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin_mes ORDER BY dia DESC LIMIT 1) END,
      'fijo', (SELECT json_build_object('fuente', f.fuente, 'fijado', to_char(f.fijado AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) FROM panel_cierres_mes f WHERE cfg.pasado AND f.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')),
      'fuente', CASE WHEN cfg.pasado AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM panel_cierres_mes f WHERE f.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')) THEN 'microsip' WHEN cfg.pasado AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ih WHERE ih.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')) THEN 'microsip' WHEN cfg.pasado THEN 'foto' ELSE 'hoy' END,
      'inicio', coalesce((SELECT f.inventario FROM panel_cierres_mes f WHERE f.mes = to_char(cfg.ini - 1, 'YYYY-MM')), (SELECT inv_hoy.v - (ihr.v - ih.v) FROM ih, ihr, inv_hoy WHERE ih.mes = to_char(cfg.ini - 1, 'YYYY-MM')),
                         (SELECT valor FROM inv_cierres WHERE dia < cfg.ini ORDER BY dia DESC LIMIT 1)),
      'promedio', (SELECT avg(valor) FROM inv_cierres WHERE dia BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin_mes HAVING count(*) >= 15),
      'calc_hoy', (SELECT v FROM ihr), 'calc_corte', (SELECT corte FROM ihr), 'real_hoy', (SELECT v FROM inv_hoy),
      'cierre_calc', (SELECT v FROM ih WHERE ih.mes = to_char(cfg.ini, 'YYYY-MM')), 'hist_meses', (SELECT count(*) FROM ih),
      'fotos', (SELECT count(*) FROM inv_cierres WHERE dia BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin_mes)),
  'cxc_hist', CASE WHEN cfg.pasado THEN (SELECT row_to_json(hcc) FROM hcc) END,
  'cxp_hist', CASE WHEN cfg.pasado THEN (SELECT row_to_json(hcp) FROM hcp) END,
  'cxc', json_build_object('dias_credito', cfg.dcred,
      'saldo', greatest((SELECT coalesce(sum(saldo), 0) FROM sc), (SELECT coalesce(sum(pend), 0) FROM cc)),
      'por_vencer', (SELECT coalesce(sum(pend), 0) FROM cc WHERE dias <= cfg.dcred),
      'v1_30', (SELECT coalesce(sum(pend), 0) FROM cc WHERE dias BETWEEN cfg.dcred + 1 AND cfg.dcred + 30),
      'v31_60', (SELECT coalesce(sum(pend), 0) FROM cc WHERE dias BETWEEN cfg.dcred + 31 AND cfg.dcred + 60),
      'v60', (SELECT coalesce(sum(pend), 0) FROM cc WHERE dias > cfg.dcred + 60) + greatest((SELECT coalesce(sum(saldo), 0) FROM sc) - (SELECT coalesce(sum(pend), 0) FROM cc), 0),
      'clientes', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('cliente', z.nombre, 'saldo', z.saldo,
                     'v60', z.v60 + greatest(z.saldo - z.sumc, 0), 'v31_60', z.v31, 'v1_30', z.v1, 'por_vencer', z.pv) ORDER BY z.saldo DESC), '[]'::json)
                   FROM (SELECT sc.nombre, sc.saldo, coalesce(sum(cc.pend), 0) AS sumc,
                                coalesce(sum(cc.pend) FILTER (WHERE cc.dias <= cfg.dcred), 0) AS pv, coalesce(sum(cc.pend) FILTER (WHERE cc.dias BETWEEN cfg.dcred + 1 AND cfg.dcred + 30), 0) AS v1,
                                coalesce(sum(cc.pend) FILTER (WHERE cc.dias BETWEEN cfg.dcred + 31 AND cfg.dcred + 60), 0) AS v31, coalesce(sum(cc.pend) FILTER (WHERE cc.dias > cfg.dcred + 60), 0) AS v60
                         FROM sc LEFT JOIN cc ON cc.cli = sc.cli GROUP BY sc.cli, sc.nombre, sc.saldo) z)),
  'abc', json_build_object(
      'resumen', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('clase', clase, 'articulos', n, 'venta', imp) ORDER BY clase), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT clase, count(*) AS n, sum(imp) AS imp FROM abc GROUP BY clase) z),
      'a', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('clave', c.clave, 'articulo', c.nombre, 'venta_90', round(a.imp, 2), 'unidades_90', round(a.uni, 2), 'existencia', round(coalesce(a.exis, 0), 2), 'unidad', c.unidad,
                 'sobre_pedido', (translate(upper(coalesce(c.nombre, '') || ' ' || coalesce(c.grupo, '') || ' ' || coalesce(c.linea, '')), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') !~ (CASE WHEN cfg.ptin = '' THEN '^$' ELSE cfg.ptin END)
                                  AND ((cfg.psp <> '' AND translate(upper(coalesce(c.nombre, '') || ' ' || coalesce(c.grupo, '') || ' ' || coalesce(c.linea, '')), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') ~ cfg.psp)
                                       OR upper(trim(coalesce(c.unidad, ''))) ~ '^(TON|TONS|TONELADAS?|M3|MTS3|VIAJES?)$')),
                 'cobertura', CASE WHEN a.uni > 0 THEN round(coalesce(a.exis, 0) / (a.uni / 90.0), 1) END) ORDER BY a.imp DESC), '[]'::json)
            FROM abc a LEFT JOIN costo c ON c.base = a.base AND c.articulo_id = a.articulo_id WHERE a.clase = 'A')),
  'mov_inv', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('concepto', z.concepto, 'tipo', z.tipo,
                 'categoria', CASE WHEN translate(upper(z.concepto), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') ~ '(FABRIC|PRODUC|ENSAMBL|TRANSFORM|MAQUIL)' THEN 'Producción'
                                   WHEN translate(upper(z.concepto), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') ~ '(MERMA|DANAD|DANO|CADUC|DESPERD|ROBO|EXTRAV|PERDID)' THEN 'Merma'
                                   WHEN translate(upper(z.concepto), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') ~ '(USO INTERNO|CONSUMO|INTERNO|MUESTRA|REGALO|OBSEQUIO)' THEN 'Uso interno'
                                   WHEN translate(upper(z.concepto), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') ~ '(TRASPASO|TRANSFER)' THEN 'Traspaso'
                                   WHEN translate(upper(z.concepto), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') ~ 'DEVOL' THEN 'Devolución'
                                   WHEN translate(upper(z.concepto), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') ~ '(AJUSTE|FISICO|CONTEO|INVENTARIO INICIAL)' THEN 'Ajuste'
                                   WHEN translate(upper(z.concepto), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ', 'AEIOUUN') ~ '(COMPRA|RECEPCION)' THEN 'Compras'
                                   ELSE 'Otro' END, 'docs', z.docs, 'unidades', z.u, 'valor', z.v) ORDER BY z.v DESC), '[]'::json)
              FROM (SELECT coalesce(nullif(r.datos ->> 'CONCEPTO', ''), 'Sin concepto') AS concepto, upper(coalesce(r.datos ->> 'TIPO_MOVTO', '')) AS tipo,
                           count(DISTINCT r.datos ->> 'DOCTO_IN_ID') AS docs, round(sum(coalesce((r.datos ->> 'UNIDADES')::numeric, 0)), 2) AS u, round(sum(coalesce((r.datos ->> 'COSTO_TOTAL')::numeric, 0)), 2) AS v
                    FROM ms_raw r, cfg WHERE r.tabla = 'MOVS_IN' AND r.fecha BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin GROUP BY 1, 2) z),
  'mov_inv_hay', (SELECT count(*) > 0 FROM ms_raw WHERE tabla = 'MOVS_IN'),
  'monedero', json_build_object(
      'altas', (SELECT coalesce(sum(z.n) FILTER (WHERE z.n <= 50), 0) FROM (SELECT (alta AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS dia, count(*) AS n FROM monedero_clientes
                 WHERE (alta AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin GROUP BY 1) z),
      'masivas', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('dia', z.dia, 'n', z.n) ORDER BY z.dia), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT (alta AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date AS dia, count(*) AS n FROM monedero_clientes
                 WHERE (alta AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 50) z),
      'socios', (SELECT count(*) FROM monedero_clientes WHERE coalesce(activo, true)),
      'movs', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('tipo', z.tipo, 'n', z.n, 'puntos', z.p, 'compras', z.c) ORDER BY z.tipo), '[]'::json)
               FROM (SELECT tipo, count(*) AS n, sum(puntos) AS p, sum(monto_compra) AS c FROM monedero_movs, cfg WHERE (fecha AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date BETWEEN cfg.ini AND cfg.fin GROUP BY tipo) z)),
  'diag_costo', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(z ORDER BY z.dif DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT coalesce(c.clave, '') AS clave, coalesce(c.nombre, 'Artículo ' || k.articulo_id) AS articulo,
             coalesce(nullif(trim(c.grupo), ''), nullif(trim(c.linea), ''), 'Sin grupo') AS grupo,
             round(coalesce(v.venta, 0), 2) AS venta, round(coalesce(v.uni, 0), 2) AS unidades, round(coalesce(m.costo, 0), 2) AS costo_ms,
             round(coalesce(m.costo, 0) - coalesce(v.venta, 0), 2) AS dif,
             CASE WHEN coalesce(v.uni, 0) > 0 THEN round(coalesce(v.venta, 0) / v.uni, 2) END AS precio_prom,
             CASE WHEN coalesce(v.uni, 0) > 0 THEN round(coalesce(m.costo, 0) / v.uni, 2) END AS costo_unit_aprox,
             c.cu AS costo_catalogo
      FROM (SELECT base, articulo_id FROM cvm UNION SELECT base, articulo_id FROM lm WHERE articulo_id IS NOT NULL) k
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT base, articulo_id, sum(importe) AS venta, sum(unidades) AS uni FROM lm GROUP BY 1, 2) v ON v.base = k.base AND v.articulo_id = k.articulo_id
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT base, articulo_id, sum(costo) AS costo FROM cvm GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.base = k.base AND m.articulo_id = k.articulo_id
      LEFT JOIN costo c ON c.base = k.base AND c.articulo_id = k.articulo_id
      WHERE coalesce(m.costo, 0) > coalesce(v.venta, 0) * 0.98
      ORDER BY coalesce(m.costo, 0) - coalesce(v.venta, 0) DESC LIMIT 60) z),
  'diag_costo_tot', (SELECT json_build_object(
      'costo_sin_venta', (SELECT coalesce(sum(m.costo), 0) FROM cvm m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lm WHERE lm.base = m.base AND lm.articulo_id = m.articulo_id)),
      'arts_sin_venta', (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.articulo_id) FROM cvm m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lm WHERE lm.base = m.base AND lm.articulo_id = m.articulo_id)),
      'bases_cvm', (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT base, ', ') FROM cvm), 'bases_venta', (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT base, ', ') FROM lm)))
) AS r
FROM cfg;

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Tablero del vendedor</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,400..900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#D9DCDE; --panel:#F3F4F5; --ink:#1A222C; --soft:#5A6470; --line:#C3C8CD;
  --blue:#0B4EA2; --yellow:#FFC20E; --wa:#159447; --red:#C7352A; --green:#1E8A4C; --grey:#9AA1A8;
  --empty:#C9CDD1;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:#1C2025; --panel:#262B31; --ink:#EEF0F2; --soft:#9AA3AD; --line:#3A4149;
  --blue:#5B9BEA; --empty:#363C43; --wa:#25B95C; --red:#EF6A5E; --green:#3CC37A; --grey:#6B737C;
}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#1C2025; --panel:#262B31; --ink:#EEF0F2; --soft:#9AA3AD; --line:#3A4149;
  --blue:#5B9BEA; --empty:#363C43; --wa:#25B95C; --red:#EF6A5E; --green:#3CC37A; --grey:#6B737C;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Archivo",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.45;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
main{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 14px 48px}
h2{font-size:1.45rem;font-weight:800;font-stretch:112%;margin:0 0 4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.12rem;font-weight:800;font-stretch:108%}
.sub{color:var(--soft);margin:0 0 14px;font-size:.95rem}
section{margin-top:34px}
button,input,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--yellow);outline-offset:2px}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
@media (min-width:900px){.grid2{grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr}}
.card{background:var(--panel);border-radius:16px;padding:16px}
.card > p{margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--soft);font-size:.92rem}

.top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.store{font-weight:800;font-stretch:90%;font-size:1rem}
.store small{display:block;font-weight:400;color:var(--soft);font-size:.85rem;font-stretch:100%}
.who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--soft)}
.who input{width:110px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel)}

/* Hero */
.hero{margin-top:18px}
.hero .kicker{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--soft);margin:0}
.big{font-weight:900;font-stretch:125%;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,10vw,4.2rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:6px 0 2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.of{margin:0;color:var(--soft)}
.track{height:18px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--empty);margin:14px 0 4px;overflow:hidden}
.fill{height:100%;width:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,var(--yellow) 0 12px,#1A222C 12px 24px);border-radius:9px;transition:width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.trackrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--soft)}
.pallet{margin-top:22px}
.pallet p{margin:2px 0 10px;color:var(--soft);font-size:.95rem}
.bags{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(17px,1fr));gap:4px}
.bag{aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:4px 4px 3px 3px;background:var(--empty);position:relative;transform:scale(.6);opacity:.4;transition:transform .25s ease,opacity .25s ease}
.bag::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:38%;height:18%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.bag.on{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}
.bag.done{background:var(--blue)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:10px;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--soft);flex-wrap:wrap}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:13px;border-radius:2px;vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:5px}

/* Comparison */
.cmp{display:grid;gap:18px}
.cmp h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1rem;font-weight:700}
.bar{margin-bottom:8px}
.bar .lab{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:3px}
.bar .lab b{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.bar .t{height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--empty);overflow:hidden}
.bar .f{height:100%;width:0;border-radius:6px;transition:width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.f.oct{background:var(--blue)} .f.sep{background:var(--grey)}
.verdict{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:.95rem}
.verdict b{color:var(--red)}
.note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--soft);margin:12px 0 0}

/* Calls */
.calls{display:grid;gap:12px}
@media (min-width:900px){.calls{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.call{background:var(--panel);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;border-left:6px solid var(--yellow)}
.call.wait{border-left-color:var(--green)}
.call.due{border-left-color:var(--red)}
.call .name{font-weight:800;font-size:1.1rem;font-stretch:95%;margin:0}
.tags{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-left:4px;vertical-align:2px}
.tag{font-size:.72rem;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--soft);font-weight:600}
.tag.due{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.why{margin:6px 0 10px;font-size:.98rem}
.lost{font-weight:800;color:var(--red)}
.meter{display:flex;gap:3px;margin:0 0 12px}
.meter span{flex:1;height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--empty)}
.meter span.hot{background:var(--red)} .meter span.ok{background:var(--yellow)}
.last{margin:0 0 12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);font-size:.9rem}
.last b{font-weight:700}
.last .hist{margin:6px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;color:var(--soft);font-size:.82rem}
.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:0;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;font-size:.98rem}
.btn-wa{background:var(--wa);color:#fff}
.btn-ask{background:var(--yellow);color:#1A222C}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-main{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
.panel{display:none;margin-top:12px;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg)}
.panel.open{display:block}
.panel p{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600}
.panel .row{display:flex;gap:8px}
.panel input,.panel textarea{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);font-size:1rem}
.panel textarea{min-height:60px;resize:vertical;margin-bottom:10px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
.chip{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:20px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);cursor:pointer;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--panel);border-color:var(--ink)}
.more{margin-top:12px}
.dropped{margin-top:12px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--soft)}
.sync{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--soft);margin:4px 0 12px}

/* Products */
.example{display:inline-block;background:var(--yellow);color:#1A222C;font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.list{display:grid;gap:8px}
.item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:var(--bg);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;border:2px solid transparent;text-align:left;width:100%}
button.item{cursor:pointer}
button.item[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--blue)}
.light{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.2rem}
.light.up{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--green) 22%,transparent)}
.light.flat{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--yellow) 30%,transparent)}
.light.down{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--red) 22%,transparent)}
.item .pn{font-weight:700;margin:0}
.item .tip{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--soft)}
.pct{font-weight:900;font-stretch:115%;font-size:1.15rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pct.up{color:var(--green)} .pct.down{color:var(--red)} .pct.flat{color:var(--soft)}

.dots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(20,1fr);gap:3px}
.dots span{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:var(--empty)}
.dots span.on{background:var(--blue)} .dots span.today{background:var(--yellow)}
.back ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.back li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.95rem}
.back li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.back .d{color:var(--soft)}

.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translate(-50%,140px);background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:12px 18px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:600;transition:transform .3s ease;z-index:10;max-width:90vw}
.toast.show{transform:translate(-50%,0)}
footer{margin-top:40px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--soft);max-width:70ch}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.fill,.bag,.toast,.bar .f{transition:none}}

/* Premio */

/* Pistas animadas */
.lane{position:relative;height:96px;margin:12px 34px 4px 30px}
.road{position:absolute;left:-30px;right:-34px;bottom:26px;height:20px;border-radius:10px;background:#4A525B;overflow:hidden}
.road::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:9px;height:2px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#FFC20E 0 14px,transparent 14px 28px);animation:dash 1s linear infinite}
.lane.idle .road::after{animation:none}
@keyframes dash{to{background-position:-28px 0}}
.road .done{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:0;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 70%,transparent);transition:width 1.8s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1)}
.goal.done .road .done{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--green) 75%,transparent)}
.runner .road{background:#B5523B}
.runner .road::after{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.7) 0 2px,transparent 2px 40px)}
.veh{position:absolute;bottom:34px;left:0;transform:translateX(-50%);transition:left 1.8s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1);z-index:2}
.veh svg{width:64px;height:auto;display:block}
.veh .wheel{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:spin .5s linear infinite}
.veh .drum{animation:drum 1.2s linear infinite}
.lane.idle .veh .wheel,.lane.idle .veh .drum{animation:none}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes drum{to{stroke-dashoffset:-24}}
.veh .emo{font-size:2.4rem;line-height:1;display:block;transform:scaleX(-1);animation:run .35s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.lane.idle .veh .emo{animation:breathe 1.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes run{from{translate:0 0}to{translate:0 -6px}}
@keyframes breathe{from{translate:0 0}to{translate:0 -2px}}
.start,.finish{position:absolute;bottom:0;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-weight:700}
.start{left:-30px}.finish{right:-34px}
.finish small,.start small{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--soft);white-space:nowrap}
.should{position:absolute;bottom:20px;width:0;border-left:2px dashed var(--red);height:72px;z-index:1}
.should span{position:absolute;top:-4px;left:4px;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--red);white-space:nowrap}
.should.flip span{left:auto;right:4px}
.pill{display:inline-block;margin:8px 0 6px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:800}
.pill.up{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--green) 22%,transparent);color:var(--green)}
.pill.mid{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--yellow) 35%,transparent);color:var(--ink)}
.pill.down{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--red) 18%,transparent);color:var(--red)}
.people{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(10,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;margin:14px 0 4px}
.person{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:clamp(.9rem,4vw,1.35rem);background:var(--empty);border:2px dashed var(--grey);transform:scale(.4);opacity:0;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1),opacity .3s}
.person.in{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}
.person.got{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--green) 25%,var(--panel));border:2px solid var(--green)}
.person.should-p{border-color:var(--red)}
.person:not(.got) .f{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.35}
.jarwrap{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;margin:12px 0 4px}
.jar{width:92px;flex:none;position:relative}
.jar svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.jar .liq{transition:y 1.8s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1),height 1.8s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1)}
.coin{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-6px;font-size:1.3rem;transform:translateX(-50%);opacity:0;animation:drop 2.4s ease-in infinite}
.coin:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.8s}.coin:nth-child(4){animation-delay:1.6s}
@keyframes drop{0%{opacity:0;top:-18px}15%{opacity:1}70%{opacity:1;top:58%}80%,100%{opacity:0;top:62%}}
.jarnum{font-weight:900;font-stretch:120%;font-size:2rem;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.jarnum small{display:block;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--soft);font-stretch:100%}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.road::after,.veh .wheel,.veh .drum,.veh .emo,.coin{animation:none}.veh,.road .done,.person,.jar .liq{transition:none}}
.tag.bot{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 18%,transparent);color:var(--blue)}
.hint{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--blue);font-weight:600}
.btn-call{background:var(--ink);color:var(--panel)}
.cot .amt2{font-weight:900;font-stretch:115%;font-size:1.3rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stock{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--red)}
#aviso{background:var(--panel);padding:14px;border-radius:12px;margin-top:16px;color:var(--ink)}
.skeleton{height:200px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--panel);margin-top:18px;animation:pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}

.card > p.big{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,10vw,4.2rem);color:var(--ink);margin:6px 0 2px}
[hidden]{display:none !important}
.toast{opacity:0}.toast.show{opacity:1}

.bag.done25{background:#6FB1F2}

.grp.down{color:var(--red)} .grp.up{color:var(--green);margin-top:14px}

.plan{margin-top:18px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.plan-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.plan-list{list-style:none;margin:12px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px;counter-reset:paso}

  opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .4s ease,transform .4s ease}

.clip{display:inline-block;animation:pop .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}

.tabs{display:inline-flex;margin-top:14px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:14px;padding:4px;gap:4px}

.adm-bono{margin-top:12px}

.adm-goals{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}

.adm-g{background:var(--panel);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;border-left:6px solid var(--c)}

const esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, m => ({"&":"&","<":"<",">":">",'"':""","'":"'"}[m]));
const titleCase = s => String(s || "").toLowerCase().replace(/(^|\s)\S/g, m => m.toUpperCase()).replace(/\bSa\b/g,"SA").replace(/\bDe\b/g,"de").replace(/\bCv\b/g,"CV");
const fechaCorta = iso => new Date(String(iso).slice(0,10)+"T12:00:00").toLocaleDateString("es-MX",{weekday:"short",day:"numeric",month:"short"});
function toast(t){ const el=$("#toast"); el.textContent=t; el.classList.add("show"); clearTimeout(el._t); el._t=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove("show"),2800); }
async function api(body){
  const r = await fetch(API, {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({k:K, perfil:PERFIL, ...body})});
  if(!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
  return r.json();
}
function countUp(el, to, f=money, ms=1100){
  if(reduce){ el.textContent = f(to); return; }
  const t0 = performance.now();
  (function step(t){ const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/ms), e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3); el.textContent=f(to*e); if(p<1) requestAnimationFrame(step); })(t0);
}

let D = null, demoId = null, showAll = false, vista = "semana", PERFIL = "", PF_ED = null;
const openPanels = new Set();
const RESULTADOS = [
  {id:"compra", t:"Va a comprar 🛒", dias:3},

  {id:"otro", t:"Compra en otro lado 🏪", dias:14},

];

/* ================= Carga ================= */
async function cargar(silencioso){
  if(!K){ aviso("Entra desde el sistema de ventas (pestaña Vendedor)."); return; }
  if(!silencioso && !D) $("#aviso").hidden = true;
  try {
    const r = await api({op:"datos", fecha: VFECHA});
    if(!r.ok){ aviso(r.msg || "No se pudieron cargar los datos."); return; }
    D = r; render();
  } catch(e){
    if(!D) aviso("No hay conexión con el sistema. Revisa el internet y toca Actualizar.");
    else toast("No se pudo actualizar; se muestran los últimos datos");
  }
}
function aviso(t){ const a=$("#aviso"); a.textContent=t; a.hidden=false; }
$("#recargar").onclick = () => cargar();
setInterval(() => { if(document.visibilityState === "visible") cargar(true); }, 10*60*1000);

function render(){
  $("#app").hidden = false; $("#aviso").hidden = true;

}

"" : " <small>(apagado)</small>"}<small>${esc(lista(p.almacenes).join(", ") || "todos los almacenes")} · ${esc(lista(p.grupos).join(", ") || "grupos del tablero")} · ${p.usuarios_ms ? "solo ventas de " + esc(p.usuarios_ms) : "todo el almacén (equipo)"}<br>Lo ve: ${esc(p.usuarios_web || "nadie todavía")}</small></div><button class="btn btn-ghost" type="button" data-pf="${esc(p.clave)}">Editar</button></div>`).join("") : `<p class="sub">Todavía no hay perfiles: todos ven el tablero completo de la empresa.</p>`;

  let h = filas + `<div class="actions" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn btn-main" type="button" id="pfNuevo">➕ Nuevo perfil</button></div>`;

      <label>Usuarios de Ventas web que ven este perfil<input id="pfUw" value="${esc(lista(e.usuarios_web).join(", "))}"></label>${chips("pfUw", O.usuarios_web || [], cur("usuarios_web"))}
      <label>Usuarios de Microsip cuyas ventas cuentan <small>(vacío = todo el almacén, meta de equipo; con usuarios = meta individual)</small><input id="pfUm" value="${esc(lista(e.usuarios_ms).join(", "))}"></label>${chips("pfUm", O.usuarios_ms || [], cur("usuarios_ms"))}

    </div>`;
  }
  $("#perfBody").innerHTML = h;
  const B = $("#perfBody");
  B.querySelectorAll(".pchip").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    const inp = $("#" + b.dataset.f), v = b.dataset.v, arr = lista(inp.value), i = arr.findIndex(x => x.toLowerCase() === v.toLowerCase());
    if(i >= 0) arr.splice(i, 1); else arr.push(v);

  B.querySelectorAll("[data-pf]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { PF_ED = b.dataset.pf; renderPerfiles(); });
  if($("#pfNuevo")) $("#pfNuevo").onclick = () => { PF_ED = ""; renderPerfiles(); };
  if($("#pfCancel")) $("#pfCancel").onclick = () => { PF_ED = null; renderPerfiles(); };

    } catch(x){ toast("No hay conexión; no se guardó"); }
  };
  if($("#pfDel")) $("#pfDel").onclick = async ev => {
    const b = ev.currentTarget;
    if(!b.dataset.seguro){ b.dataset.seguro = "1"; b.textContent = "¿Seguro? Toca otra vez"; return; }
    try {
      const r = await api({op:"perfil_borrar", clave: e.clave});
      if(!r.ok){ toast(r.msg || "No se pudo borrar"); return; }
      toast("Perfil borrado"); if(PERFIL === e.clave) PERFIL = ""; PF_ED = null; cargar(true);

const TRUCK = `<svg viewBox="0 0 96 56" aria-hidden="true">

</svg>`;
const cant = (v,u) => u === "money" ? money(v) : n(v);
const unidad = u => u === "money" ? "" : " " + u;
const corto = v => v >= 1e6 ? "$" + (v/1e6).toLocaleString("es-MX",{maximumFractionDigits:1}) + " M" : money(v);

function ritmo(pct){
  const E = vista === "semana" ? D.esperado_sem : D.esperado;
  if(pct >= 1) return "";
  if(pct >= E) return `<span class="pill up">¡Vas adelantado! 🚀</span>`;
  if(pct >= E * .75) return `<span class="pill mid">Casi al ritmo, apriétale 💪</span>`;
  return `<span class="pill down">Vas atrasado 🐢 hay que acelerar</span>`;
}
function fraseSemana(m){
  const nom = esc(D.vendedor), falta = Math.max(0, m.meta - m.lleva);
  if(falta === 0) return `<p class="msg">${nom}, ya cumpliste la semana: <b>${cant(m.lleva,m.u)}${unidad(m.u)}</b> de ${cant(m.meta,m.u)}. ¡Todo lo que sigas sumando te adelanta para el mes!</p>`;
  let hoyTxt = "";
  if(m.id === "clientes") hoyTxt = m.hoy > 0 ? ` Hoy volvieron ${n(m.hoy)}.` : " Revisa tus llamadas de abajo.";
  else { const obj = Math.ceil(m.obj_hoy); hoyTxt = ` <b>Hoy te tocan ${cant(obj,m.u)}${unidad(m.u)}</b> y llevas ${cant(m.hoy,m.u)}.`; }
  return `<p class="msg">${nom}, esta semana llevas <b>${cant(m.lleva,m.u)}</b> de ${cant(m.meta,m.u)}${unidad(m.u)}. Te faltan <b>${cant(falta,m.u)}</b>.${hoyTxt}</p>
    <p class="pace">Si cumples cada semana, llegas a la meta del mes.</p>`;
}
function frase(m){
  const falta = Math.max(0, m.meta - m.lleva), nom = esc(D.vendedor);
  if(falta === 0) return `<p class="msg">${nom}, llegaste a <b>${cant(m.meta,m.u)}${unidad(m.u)}</b>.</p>`;
  const hoy = m.hoy > 0
    ? (m.id === "monedero" ? `Hoy ya registraste ${n(m.hoy)}. ¡Sigue ofreciéndolo!`
      : m.id === "clientes" ? `Hoy volvieron ${n(m.hoy)}. ¡Sigue llamando!`
      : `Hoy llevas ${cant(m.hoy,m.u)}${unidad(m.u)}. ¡Sigue así!`)
    : (m.id === "clientes" ? "Hoy todavía no vuelve ninguno: revisa tus llamadas de abajo." : "Hoy todavía no llevas: ¡a darle!");
  const diario = Math.ceil(falta / Math.max(1, D.dias_rest));
  const desg = m.id === "cemento" && D.cemento_mes ? ` <span class="pace" style="display:block">En el mes: ${n(D.cemento_mes.b50)} de 50 kg y ${n(D.cemento_mes.b25)} de 25 kg (dos de 25 cuentan como uno).</span>` : "";
  return `<p class="msg">${nom}, llevas <b>${cant(m.lleva,m.u)}</b> de ${cant(m.meta,m.u)}${unidad(m.u)}. Te faltan <b>${cant(falta,m.u)}</b> para ganar el premio de ${m.premioDe}. ${hoy}${desg}</p>
    ${m.id === "clientes" ? "" : `<p class="pace">Para lograrlo: unos ${cant(diario,m.u)}${unidad(m.u)} por día entre semana y ${cant(Math.ceil(diario * D.peso_sabado),m.u)} el sábado.</p>`}`;
}
function visual(m, pct){
  const E = vista === "semana" ? D.esperado_sem : D.esperado, p = Math.min(1,pct) * 100, e = E * 100;
  const marca = pct < 1 ? `<div class="should${e > 70 ? " flip" : ""}" style="left:${e}%"><span>Hoy deberías ir aquí</span></div>` : "";
  if(m.vis === "truck" || m.vis === "runner"){
    const veh = m.vis === "truck" ? TRUCK : `<span class="emo" role="img" aria-label="corredor">🏃</span>`;
    const ini = m.vis === "truck" ? `🏪<small>Tienda</small>` : `🚩<small>Salida</small>`;
    const fin = m.vis === "truck" ? `🏗️<small>${n(m.meta)} bultos</small>` : `🏁<small>${corto(m.meta)}</small>`;

          <line x1="14" y1="${94 - 70*E}" x2="66" y2="${94 - 70*E}" stroke="var(--red)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/></g>
        <path d="M14 22 h52 v62 a10 10 0 0 1 -10 10 h-32 a10 10 0 0 1 -10 -10z" fill="none" stroke="var(--soft)" stroke-width="3"/>
        <path d="M22 30 v46" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.5)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </svg>
      ${m.hoy > 0 && pct < 1 ? '<span class="coin">🪙</span>'.repeat(Math.min(3, m.hoy)) : ""}
    </div><div class="jarnum">${n(m.lleva)}<small>de ${n(m.meta)} altas · la raya roja es donde deberías ir hoy</small></div></div>`;
}
function confetti(el){
  if(reduce) return;
  const box = document.createElement("div"); box.className = "confetti";
  const cols = ["var(--yellow)","var(--blue)","var(--green)","var(--red)"];
  for(let i=0;i<28;i++){ const c=document.createElement("i"); c.style.left=Math.random()*100+"%"; c.style.background=cols[i%4]; c.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*.3)+"s"; box.appendChild(c); }
  el.appendChild(box); setTimeout(() => box.remove(), 1900);
}
function renderPrize(){
  const BONO = D.bono || 0, sem = vista === "semana", BI = D.bono_info || {};

  document.querySelectorAll(".tabs button").forEach(t => t.setAttribute("aria-selected", t.dataset.v === vista));

    const mesDone = m.lleva >= m.meta;
    const parte = BONO * m.peso; if(mesDone) ganado += parte;
    const mm = {...base, lleva};
    const etiqueta = BONO ? (sem ? `<small>cuenta para</small> ${money(parte)}` : `${money(parte)} <small>· ${Math.round(m.peso*100)}% del bono</small>`) : `${Math.round(m.peso*100)}% <small>del bono</small>`;
    return `<div class="goal${done ? " done" : ""}">
